en.description: Activation centers on the token “Building”: it can refer to a building in an institutional address or form the connective expression “Building on.” It also occurs in the economic indicator “Building Permits” and the proper case name “Hospital Building Fund.”

patterns.name: Building after a proper name
patterns.context: The word appears as part of an institutional address or place name, or in the phrase “Building on”; at least two distinct uses occur, the former mainly in addresses and the latter as a connective in discussion
patterns.domain: Academic papers, addresses, legal citations, tables

patterns.name: Building name in an institutional address
patterns.context: Appears in author affiliations, department addresses, or institutional mailing addresses, often alongside a university, street, city, postal code, and similar details

patterns.name: Connective phrase in discussion
patterns.context: At the beginning or within a sentence, indicates further development based on existing results; followed by “these results,” “this,” and so on

patterns.name: Building permits in an energy calendar
patterns.context: An indicator name in an economic calendar, alongside dates, Capacity Utilization, Housing Starts, and other items

patterns.name: Building in a legal institution’s proper name
patterns.context: Appears in a case name as part of a proper name, not as an address or connective expression

0_230.description: 激活集中于 token “Building”：它可指机构地址中的建筑，也可组成“Building on”承接表达；另见经济指标“Building Permits”和判例专名“Hospital Building Fund”。

patterns.name: 专名后的 Building
patterns.context: 该词作为机构地址、地点名的一部分，或短语“Building on”中出现；至少两种不同用法，前者多为地址，后者为论述承接
patterns.domain: 学术论文、地址、法律引文、表格

patterns.name: 机构地址中的建筑名
patterns.trigger: “Building”及其前后相邻的专名或地址字段
patterns.context: 出现在作者单位、院系地址或机构邮寄地址中，常与大学、街道、城市、邮编等并列

patterns.name: 论述承接短语
patterns.context: 置于句首或句中，表示基于已有结果继续展开；后接“these results”“this”等

patterns.name: 能源日历中的建筑许可
patterns.context: 作为经济日历中的指标名称，与日期、Capacity Utilization、Housing Starts等项目并列

patterns.name: 法律机构专名中的 Building
patterns.context: 出现在判例名称中，是专名的一部分，并非地址或论述承接

en.concept: The word Building and its collocations
en.description: All snippets contain highly activating “Building”: this includes a building name in a university address, the academic idiom “Building on,” the economic indicator “Building Permits,” and the legal institution name “Hospital Building Fund”.

patterns.name: Building names
patterns.context: Appears in a building name, address, or institutional address; the trigger is the word Building, often near a proper name, building name, or address information.
patterns.domain: Academic paper addresses, paper body text, economic calendars, legal citations

patterns.name: Academic institutional addresses
patterns.context: The building term is embedded in an author address for a university, research institute, or department, usually adjacent to a location, postal code, or institution name.
patterns.domain: ArXiv author affiliations and mailing addresses

patterns.name: Continuation using a building metaphor or phrase in body text
patterns.context: The phrase “Building on” means continuing based on existing results or work, not a physical building address.

patterns.name: Building-permit category
patterns.context: Appears in an economic calendar’s indicator list, where Building modifies permits and refers to building permits.

patterns.name: Building fund in an institution name
patterns.context: Building is part of the name of a hospital fund involved in a legal case, not an address.

0_230.description: 所有片段都含有高激活的“Building”：既包括大学地址中的楼名，也包括“Building on”学术惯用语、经济指标“Building Permits”及法律机构名“Hospital Building Fund”。

patterns.name: 建筑物名称
patterns.context: 出现在建筑名称、地址或机构地址中；触发点是单词 Building，前后常有专名、楼名或地址信息。
patterns.domain: 学术论文地址、论文正文、经济日历、法律引文

patterns.name: 学术机构地址
patterns.context: 建筑词嵌在大学、研究所或院系的作者地址中，通常邻接地点、邮编或单位名称。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 作者单位与通讯地址

patterns.name: 正文中沿用建筑隐喻或短语
patterns.context: 短语“Building on”表示在既有结果或工作基础上继续推进，并非实体建筑地址。

patterns.name: 建筑许可类别
patterns.context: 出现在经济日历的指标列表中，Building 修饰 permits，指建筑许可。

patterns.name: 机构名称中的建筑基金
patterns.context: Building 是法律案件所涉医院基金名称的一部分，而非地址。

en.description: All snippets show the strongest activation on the token blessing; its modifiers and contexts vary, covering blessings, religious ceremonies or approval, as well as figurative uses such as “a blessing in disguise.”

patterns.name: Core word blessing
patterns.context: The target word blessing itself triggers across different syntactic and semantic contexts, such as “mixed blessing,” “a blessing,” “with thy blessing,” “bridal blessing,” “patriarchal blessing,” “organisation’s blessing,” and “an amazing blessing”.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; news, code comments, literature, encyclopedias, personal experiences, etc.

0_230.description: 所有片段均在 token blessing 上出现最强激活；其修饰语及语境多样，涵盖祝福、宗教仪式或许可，也包括“因祸得福”等比喻用法。

patterns.name: 核心词 blessing
patterns.context: 目标词 blessing 本身在各种句法和语义环境中触发：如“mixed blessing”“a blessing”“with thy blessing”“bridal blessing”“patriarchal blessing”“organisation’s blessing”“an amazing blessing”。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；新闻、代码注释、文学、百科、个人经历等

en.description: All snippets activate strongly on the word blessing. It covers general good fortune and favors and their common collocations, as well as blessings in weddings or religious ceremonies; activation seems driven by the word itself, while surrounding context determines the specific sense.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “a blessing”
patterns.context: Generally refers to something as a blessing, good fortune, or favor; also includes variants such as “mixed blessing” and “blessing in disguise”.
patterns.domain: Prose, reviews, web text, and conversation

patterns.name: Blessings in religious ceremonies
patterns.context: Refers to specific religious ceremonies or blessings in religious texts, such as bridal or patriarchal blessings.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic biographies, religion, and archival descriptions

0_230.description: 所有片段都在 blessing 一词处强烈激活。它涵盖一般的幸事、恩惠及其常见搭配，也涵盖婚礼或宗教仪式中的祝福；激活似乎由该词本身主导，周围语境决定具体义项。

patterns.name: 短语固定搭配“a blessing”
patterns.context: 泛指某事物是祝福、幸事或恩惠；也包括“mixed blessing”“blessing in disguise”等变体
patterns.domain: 散文、评论、网页文本及口语

patterns.name: 宗教仪式中的祝福
patterns.context: 指婚礼祝福或宗主教祝福等具体宗教仪式、宗教文献中的祝福
patterns.domain: 百科传记、宗教与档案说明

en.description: All snippets contain the activated contiguous letter substring “RM”, but its referent varies by domain: abbreviations in physics, sports, and health research; table fields, code identifiers, or comments; and a substring within hash strings.

patterns.name: RM in the abbreviation RMF
patterns.context: Appears in “relativistic mean field (RMF) theory,” where RM is part of a physics term abbreviation.

patterns.name: RM in the abbreviation Replica Method
patterns.context: RM is used in a title or body text as an abbreviation for Replica Method, often adjacent to “replica method”.

patterns.name: RM in the abbreviation Rotation Measure
patterns.context: RM refers to rotation measure in astrophysics, involving nebulae, the Galactic background, and Faraday rotation.

patterns.name: RM in the abbreviation Repetition Maximum
patterns.context: Appears in “Repetition Maximum” and RM value labels, referring to an exercise-training load metric.
patterns.domain: Sports science papers and personal blogs

patterns.name: RM field in a table cell
patterns.context: Appears as HTML table-cell content or a field label, adjacent to markup tags.

patterns.name: RM substring in an identifier
patterns.context: Embedded in the camel-case program identifier “signalRMessages,” forming an intra-word substring.

patterns.name: RM in the abbreviation Recovery Management
patterns.context: Appears in the abbreviation for “Recovery Management Checkups (RMCs)”.
patterns.domain: Addiction and social health research papers

patterns.name: RM substring in a comment
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of “RM: hack” in a code comment, possibly as an abbreviation or comment label.

patterns.name: RM substring in a checksum string
patterns.context: Embedded in a JSON dependency-integrity hash string, not functioning as an independent word or clear abbreviation.

0_230.description: 所有片段都包含激活的连续字母子串“RM”，但其所指因领域而异：物理、运动、健康研究中的缩写，表格字段、代码标识符或注释，以及哈希字符串内部子串。

patterns.name: RMF缩写中的RM
patterns.context: 出现在“relativistic mean field (RMF) theory”中，RM是物理术语缩写的一部分。

patterns.name: Replica Method缩写中的RM
patterns.context: 标题或正文中将 RM 用作 Replica Method 的缩写，常与“replica method”相邻。

patterns.name: Rotation Measure缩写中的RM
patterns.context: RM 指天体物理中的 rotation measure，涉及星云、银河背景及 Faraday rotation。

patterns.name: Repetition Maximum缩写中的RM
patterns.context: 出现在“Repetition Maximum”及 RM 数值标记中，表示运动训练负荷指标。
patterns.domain: 运动科学论文及个人博客

patterns.name: 表格单元格中的RM字段
patterns.context: 作为HTML表格单元格内容或字段标签出现，邻接标记语言标签。

patterns.name: 标识符中的RM子串
patterns.context: 嵌在驼峰式程序标识符“signalRMessages”中，形成词内子串。

patterns.name: Recovery Management缩写中的RM
patterns.context: 出现在“Recovery Management Checkups (RMCs)”的缩写中。
patterns.domain: 成瘾与社会健康研究论文

patterns.name: 注释中的RM子串
patterns.context: 作为代码注释中“RM: hack”的开头，可能是缩写或注释标签。

patterns.name: 校验字符串中的RM子串
patterns.context: 嵌在JSON依赖完整性哈希字符串中，不表现为独立词或明确缩写。

en.concept: Specific word forms and theorem markers
en.description: Activation concentrates on two salient markers: Lemma 10 in mathematical text (alongside other theorem-environment markers), and the word form communicated across different writing styles. Other mathematical terms, publication information, and subword fragments show weak and sporadic co-occurrence, making them difficult to group under a single trigger.

patterns.name: Lemma number marker
patterns.context: In a theorem environment or cross-reference, the number 10 follows the name of a mathematical statement; especially prominent in snippets 1, 2, 5, and 6.

patterns.name: communicated word form
patterns.context: The word means to convey, inform, or submit information, followed by to, in, etc.; surrounding meanings and sentence structures vary.
patterns.domain: Legal decisions, literary narration, history-of-science texts

patterns.name: Local triggers in mathematical texts
patterns.context: Mathematics papers discuss isomorphisms, fiber products, morphisms, and lemmas, but do not all contain an explicit Lemma 10 marker.

patterns.name: Mathematical analysis terminology
patterns.context: Discusses SGD error bounds and objective-function conditions; also contains theorem/lemma markers.

patterns.name: Isolated subword fragments and publication information
patterns.context: Conference extended abstracts and journal special-issue publication information; no clear Lemma 10 or communicated trigger word is present.

patterns.name: Graph-theoretic construction phrasing
patterns.context: Describes adjacency relations between vertices and sets U and W; this passage can be explained by the Lemma 10 marker, with no reliable trigger independent of that marker.

patterns.name: Names and other sporadic subword fragments
patterns.context: Sporadic subword activations in authors, paper titles, and abstracts, showing no stable independent semantic pattern.

0_230.description: 激活集中在两类醒目标记：数学文本里的 Lemma 10（并伴随其他定理环境标记），以及不同文体中词形 communicated。其余数学术语、出版信息和词片段呈弱而零散的共现，难以归为同一触发。

patterns.name: Lemma 编号标记
patterns.context: 定理环境或交叉引用中，数学陈述名称后紧跟编号 10；第 1、2、5、6 段尤为明显
patterns.domain: 数学论文、形式化定理标记

patterns.name: communicated 词形
patterns.context: 该词用于表示传达、告知或提交信息，后接 to、in 等；周围语义和句式各异
patterns.domain: 法律判决、文学叙述、科学史文本

patterns.name: 数学文本中的局部触发
patterns.context: 数学论文叙述同构、纤维积、态射与引理等内容，但不都出现显式的 Lemma 10 标记

patterns.name: 数学分析术语
patterns.context: 讨论 SGD 误差界与目标函数条件；同时含有定理/引理标记

patterns.name: 孤立的词片段与出版信息
patterns.context: 会议扩展摘要及期刊专刊出版信息；未见明确的 Lemma 10 或 communicated 触发词

patterns.name: 图论构造句式
patterns.context: 描述顶点与集合 U、W 的邻接关系；本段可由 Lemma 10 标记解释，未见独立于该标记的可靠触发

patterns.name: 人名及其他零散词片段
patterns.context: 作者、论文标题及摘要中的零散子词激活，未显示稳定的独立语义模式

en.concept: undefined in code and its contexts
en.description: Primarily responds to the literal undefined in code and contexts involving comparisons and type checks; it also responds to code indentation and sporadic JavaScript syntax fragments. CMake linker errors, questions about interface text, and documentation tokens also appear.

patterns.name: undefined literal and checks
patterns.context: In JavaScript code, undefined appears as a string, a type-check result, or part of a condition, usually surrounded by parentheses, comparison operators, or return/if.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code and StackExchange programming-question code

patterns.name: Indentation spaces and code formatting
patterns.context: Spaces appear at the beginning of code lines or between statements, reflecting indentation or layout; common in JavaScript snippets.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code and StackExchange code snippets

patterns.name: JavaScript syntax and identifier fragments
patterns.context: These code tokens appear in contexts such as variable assignment, function definitions, type checks, library calls, or regular expressions; activations are scattered and not all directly related to undefined checks.
patterns.domain: JavaScript source code, documentation examples, and programming questions

patterns.name: CMake build configuration and linker errors
patterns.context: CMake commands, variables, and build output appear in the same passage; undefined appears in linker error text rather than JavaScript type-checking code.

patterns.name: Natural-language question about interface text
patterns.context: The questioner asks how to remove text displayed in autocomplete; the word is a string shown in the interface, not a type check in code.

patterns.name: Formatting markers and local documentation tokens
patterns.context: Words appear in comments, JSDoc parameter descriptions, URLs, or code-formatting markers; activation is weaker and lacks a shared semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: GitHub comments, documentation, and formatted code

0_230.concept: 代码中的 undefined 及其上下文
0_230.description: 主要对代码中的 undefined 字面量及其比较、类型检查语境响应，也响应代码缩进和零散 JavaScript 语法片段；另见 CMake 链接错误、界面文字提问及文档 token。

patterns.name: undefined 字面量及其检查
patterns.trigger: «undefined»10；常与 typeof、!=、==、!== 或条件判断相邻
patterns.context: JavaScript 代码中将 undefined 作为字符串、类型检查结果或条件的一部分，周围通常有括号、比较运算符或 return/if。
patterns.domain: Github 源码与 StackExchange 编程问答代码

patterns.name: 缩进空格与代码格式
patterns.context: 空格出现在代码行首或语句之间，体现缩进或排版；多见于 JavaScript 代码片段。
patterns.domain: Github 源码与 StackExchange 代码片段

patterns.name: JavaScript 语法及标识符片段
patterns.context: 这些代码 token 出现在变量赋值、函数定义、类型判断、库调用或正则表达式等语境；激活点分散，不都与 undefined 检查直接相关。
patterns.domain: JavaScript 源码、文档示例与编程问答

patterns.name: CMake 构建配置与链接错误
patterns.context: CMake 命令、变量及构建输出出现在同一段；undefined 出现在链接器错误文本中，而非 JavaScript 的类型检查代码。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 上的 C++/CMake 构建问答

patterns.name: 自然语言中的界面文字问题
patterns.trigger: «undefined»10 出现在引号中的显示文本「undefined」
patterns.context: 提问者询问如何移除自动补全中显示的文字；该词是界面上出现的字符串，不是代码中的类型检查。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 自然语言编程问答

patterns.name: 格式标记与局部文档 token
patterns.context: 词语出现在注释、JSDoc 参数说明、URL 或代码格式标记中；激活较弱且缺少共同的语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: Github 注释、文档与格式化代码

en.description: All segments strongly activate on “unclear,” involving questions, reasons, relationships, effects, or rules that remain unclear. Syntax includes copular or continuing states, indirect questions, reason modification, and weakening by degree adverbs.

patterns.name: Uncertainty predicate
patterns.context: Used as a predicate complement or state predicate, often with “is,” “remains,” “has remained,” “has been,” or “making it,” indicating that a problem, relationship, rule, or effect remains unclear.
patterns.domain: Research status, discussion, and argumentation in academic papers

patterns.name: Unknown question introduced by unclear whether/how/what
patterns.context: unclear is followed by an indirect question introduced by whether, how, or what, indicating that it remains unknown whether model performance, a supervision signal, a conceptual correspondence, or a phenomenon holds.
patterns.domain: Problem statements and limitations in academic papers

patterns.name: unclear modifying reasons
patterns.context: unclear directly modifies reasons, indicating that the rationale for an assumption or practice is unspecified, rather than using the common copular predicate structure.
patterns.domain: Descriptions of methods or assumptions in physics papers

patterns.name: Degree adverb before unclear
patterns.context: The degree adverb somewhat softens the expression of uncertainty, describing an effect whose clarity is limited.
patterns.domain: Media and political analysis in academic papers

0_230.description: 所有段都强烈激活于“unclear”，涉及问题、原因、关系、影响或规则尚不清楚；句法包括系词/持续状态、间接疑问、原因修饰及程度副词弱化。

patterns.name: 不确定性谓语
patterns.context: 作为表语或状态谓语，常与“is”“remains”“has remained”“has been”或“making it”搭配，表示某问题、关系、规则或影响尚不清楚。
patterns.domain: 学术论文中的研究现状、讨论与论证

patterns.name: unclear whether/how/what 引出的未知问题
patterns.context: unclear 后接 whether、how 或 what 引出的间接疑问，指出模型表现、监督信号、概念对应或现象是否成立仍未知。
patterns.domain: 学术论文中的问题陈述与研究局限

patterns.name: unclear 修饰原因
patterns.context: unclear 直接修饰 reasons，表示某种假设或做法的理由未说明，而非使用常见的系词表语结构。
patterns.domain: 物理学论文中的方法或假设描述

patterns.name: unclear 前带程度副词
patterns.context: 程度副词 somewhat 弱化不确定判断，描述某项影响的清晰程度有限。
patterns.domain: 学术论文中的媒体与政治分析

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to “stranded” in hyphenated compounds: it describes the single- or double-stranded state of nucleic acids or the strand count of protein β-sheets; it also appears in “stranded costs” in energy emails.

patterns.name: Strand-count descriptions in nucleic acids
patterns.context: “stranded” appears in hyphenated compounds describing the strand state of RNA, DNA, viruses, or oligonucleotides; modifiers may include double or single.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology, virology, and biomedical papers

patterns.name: Strand-count descriptions in protein structures
patterns.context: “stranded” describes the number of strands in a β-sheet, appearing in descriptions of protein structures or domains.

patterns.name: “stranded costs” in energy contexts
patterns.context: “stranded” modifies costs, referring to costs already paid or stranded by electric utilities; this is not the biological use referring to strand structure.

0_230.description: 主要对连字符复合词中的“stranded”强烈响应：它描述核酸的单链/双链或蛋白β折叠的链数；另在能源邮件中出现“stranded costs”。

patterns.name: 核酸中的链数描述
patterns.context: “stranded”出现在连字符复合词中，描述 RNA、DNA、病毒或寡核苷酸的链状态；修饰词可为 double 或 single。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、病毒学及生物医学论文

patterns.name: 蛋白结构中的链数描述
patterns.context: “stranded”描述 β-sheet 中链的数目，出现在蛋白质结构或结构域的说明中。
patterns.domain: 蛋白质结构与生物化学论文

patterns.name: 能源语境中的 stranded costs
patterns.context: “stranded”修饰成本，指电力公司已支付或搁浅的成本；不是生物学中的链结构用法。

en.description: All segments show their strongest activation on the word stranded: it describes both single- and double-stranded RNA/DNA and β-sheets composed of multiple strands. The shared trigger is stranded, not limited to nucleic-acid contexts.

patterns.name: strand(ed) compounds
patterns.context: The word stranded occurs in compound modifiers describing the number of nucleic-acid strands or strands in a protein β-sheet; the preceding words single, double, and four may vary.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology, virology, structural biology, and related papers

0_230.description: 所有段均在 stranded 一词上出现最强激活：既描述单链、双链 RNA/DNA，也描述由多条链构成的β-折叠；共同触发点是 stranded，不限于核酸语境。

patterns.name: strand(ed)复合词
patterns.context: 词语 stranded 出现在描述核酸链数或蛋白质β-折叠链数的复合修饰语中；前置词 single、double、four 可不同。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、病毒学、结构生物学及相关论文

en.description: Activation falls mainly on tables/table and on tables in compound identifiers, links, or the phrase “round tables”; far also activates strongly in “So far” in a medical paper.

patterns.name: Phrase-final word in a medical article
patterns.context: In an academic sentence, means “to date” and is followed by a statement about progress in lncRNA research; strong activation falls on far in the phrase.

patterns.name: tables in code and identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in code, paths, identifiers, comments, or configuration text, as a plural word, capitalization variant, or part of a compound name.

patterns.name: Instruction tables documentation link
patterns.context: A PDF link to processor instruction information; the same passage also contains words such as optim and instruction.

patterns.name: Round tables as an event format
patterns.context: Listed alongside conference activities such as workshops, debates, poster presentations, and networking; refers to roundtable discussions.

0_230.description: 激活主要落在 tables/table 及其复合标识符、链接或“round tables”短语中的 tables；另在医学论文的“So far”中对 far 强烈激活。

patterns.name: 医学文章中的末尾词片段
patterns.context: 学术句子中表示“到目前为止”，后接关于 lncRNA 研究进展的陈述；高激活落在短语中的 far。

patterns.name: 代码与标识符中的 tables
patterns.context: 出现在代码、路径、标识符、注释或配置文本中，可为复数词、大小写变体或复合名称的一部分。

patterns.name: instruction tables 文档链接
patterns.context: 指向处理器指令信息的 PDF 链接；同段另有 optim、instruction 等词。

patterns.name: round tables 活动形式
patterns.context: 与研讨会、辩论、海报展示、交流等会议活动并列，指圆桌讨论。

en.description: The shared trigger is far: it appears in so far (meaning up to now or far from), spatial distance in far away, the far-infrared band, and the fixed phrase as far as.

patterns.name: so far construction
patterns.context: Sentence-initial or clause-initial “So far” means up to now; far also occurs in expressions such as “so far from a global solution”

patterns.name: Long distance or spatial location
patterns.context: far describes distance or spatial remoteness, as in far away; it does not mean “up to now” temporally

patterns.name: Far-infrared terminology
patterns.context: far combines with infrared to form the name of a wavelength band, appearing in descriptions of instruments or observation bands

patterns.name: Fixed phrase as far as
patterns.context: The fixed sentence-initial expression “as far as … is concerned” introduces a scope or topic of discussion

0_230.description: 共同触发词是 far：可构成 so far（迄今或远离）、far away 空间距离、far-infrared 波段，以及 as far as 固定搭配。

patterns.name: so far 句式
patterns.context: 句首或分句开头的“So far”，表达截至目前、迄今为止；也见于“so far from a global solution”一类表达中的 far

patterns.name: 远距离或空间位置
patterns.context: far 描述距离或空间上的遥远，如 far away；并非时间上的“迄今”

patterns.name: 远红外术语
patterns.context: far 与 infrared 组成波段名称，出现在仪器或观测波段描述中

patterns.name: as far as 固定搭配
patterns.context: 句首固定表达“as far as … is concerned”，引出讨论范围或话题

en.description: Activations cluster on far: they include so far (to date), far-IR, the distance sense of far in far away/from, and far in the construction as far as…is concerned.

patterns.name: far in the phrase so far
patterns.context: In academic discussion, means “to date”; often appears at the beginning or within a sentence. Paragraph 1 has “so far has not been used”; paragraphs 2, 4, 6, and 8 have “So/so far”.

patterns.name: far with a long-distance meaning
patterns.context: Far modifies a noun or combines with away/from to express far-infrared, spatial distance, or being far from a state; it does not mean “to date”.

patterns.name: Fixed construction as far as
patterns.context: Forms a topic-limiting construction with as…as…concerned, meaning “with regard to”.

0_230.description: 激活集中于 far：既包括 so far（迄今为止），也包括 far-IR、far away/from 的距离义，以及 as far as…is concerned 结构中的 far。

patterns.name: 短语 so far 的 far
patterns.context: 学术论述中表示“迄今为止”，常见于句首或句中；第 1 段为 “so far has not been used”，第 2、4、6、8 段为 “So/so far”。

patterns.name: 远距离含义的 far
patterns.context: far 修饰名词或与 away/from 搭配，表达远红外、空间距离或与某状态相距甚远；并非表示“迄今为止”。
patterns.domain: 天体物理、物理学及数学论文

patterns.name: as far as 固定结构
patterns.trigger: «far»10，处于 “As far as the - relation is concerned”
patterns.context: 与 as…as…concerned 构成话题限定结构，意为“就……而言”。
patterns.domain: 学术论文中的论述性表达

en.concept: The word far and its collocations
en.description: Activation centers on far: it appears in “so far” meaning up to now, as well as far-IR, far from, far away, and the fixed expression “as far as ... is concerned.”

patterns.name: far in the phrase “so far”
patterns.context: Means up to now, often used to summarize research progress or unresolved questions; it may also simply be a locally strongly activated word

patterns.name: Spatial sense of far
patterns.context: far means a long distance or forms far-infrared terminology; its meaning depends on adjacent words

patterns.name: “as far as” introducing a topic’s scope
patterns.context: The fixed expression “as far as ... is concerned” introduces the scope of discussion; it does not mean up to now or physical distance

0_230.description: 激活集中于 far：出现在“so far”表示迄今，也出现在 far-IR、far from、far away 等距离或远红外用法，并见于“as far as ... is concerned”固定表达。

patterns.name: 词组“so far”中的 far
patterns.context: 表示截至目前、迄今为止，常用于概述研究进展或未解决问题；但也可能只是局部强激活词

patterns.name: 空间距离义 far
patterns.context: far表示远距离，或构成远红外术语；语义由紧邻词决定
patterns.domain: 天体物理、物理学、量子信息

patterns.name: “as far as”引导话题范围
patterns.trigger: “As« far»10 as the - relation is concerned”
patterns.context: 固定表达“as far as ... is concerned”，引出讨论范围，不表示迄今或物理距离

en.description: Activations cluster on the word form far: they include so far (“to date”), the far-IR band, the spatial-distance sense of far, and the fixed collocation as far as; the common trigger is far.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation far + so far
patterns.context: Appears in “so far”, meaning “to date”; often follows a period or comma and precedes research progress, unresolved problems, or interim conclusions.

patterns.name: far-IR compound
patterns.context: Part of the name of an infrared band, contrasted with mid-/near-IR or listed alongside other observational bands.

patterns.name: Spatial-distance sense of far
patterns.context: Expresses physical distance or figuratively describes being far from a solution in terms of spatial distance.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation as far as
patterns.context: Introduces the topic delimiting the scope of discussion, followed by “the - relation is concerned”.

0_230.description: 激活集中于 far 的词形：既包括 so far“迄今为止”，也包括 far-IR 波段、空间距离义 far，以及 as far as 固定搭配；共同触发点是 far。

patterns.name: far + so far 固定搭配
patterns.trigger: «far»10；部分段落中为«So»7« far»10 或 «so»5« far»10
patterns.context: 出现在“so far”中，表示“迄今为止”；前面常有句号或逗号，后接研究进展、尚未解决的问题或阶段性结论。

patterns.name: far-IR 复合词
patterns.context: 作为红外波段名称的一部分，与 mid-/near-IR 对照，或与其他观测波段并列。

patterns.name: 空间距离意义的 far
patterns.context: 表示物理距离遥远，或以空间距离作比喻描述距离某个解答很远。

patterns.name: as far as 固定搭配
patterns.context: 引出限定讨论范围的话题，后接“the - relation is concerned”。
patterns.domain: 天文学论文中的论述性表达

en.description: Strong responses occur to the Spanish reflexive pronoun «sí» and the English word «far»; the latter spans “So far,” far-IR/far-infrared, and far from collocations. A Czech diacritic character fragment also activates and may represent an independent pattern.

patterns.name: Spanish reflexive pronoun sí
patterns.context: In Spanish, sí is used as a reflexive pronoun referring to the sentence subject; examples include “sí tenemos en cuenta” and “concebirse a sí mismo.”

patterns.name: far / far-infrared vocabulary
patterns.context: The English word far appears in “So far,” meaning “up to now,” in far-IR and far-infrared, meaning the far infrared, and in “far from,” expressing distance or degree.
patterns.domain: English academic papers on gravitational waves, astronomy, materials science, and theoretical physics

patterns.name: Diacritic fragment within a Czech word
patterns.context: In Czech text, activation falls on a character with a diacritic or a local word fragment split by tokenization; the context concerns member states, institutions, airport networks, and similar topics.

patterns.name: Segmented token in the English so far construction
patterns.context: At the beginning or within a sentence, So/so far means “up to now”; activation mainly falls on far, while So/so is also marked.

patterns.name: Non-temporal collocations of English far
patterns.context: far forms a compound with the name of an infrared band or combines with from to express distance or degree; this differs from “up to now” in so far.
patterns.domain: Academic papers in astronomy, astrophysics, and theoretical physics

0_230.concept: 局部词形／字符模式检测
0_230.description: 明显响应西班牙语反身代词«sí»，以及英语«far»；后者横跨“So far”和far-IR/far-infrared、far from等搭配。另有一段捷克语变音字符片段激活，可能是独立模式。

patterns.name: 西班牙语反身代词 sí
patterns.context: 西班牙语中 sí 用作反身代词，指向句子主语；可见于“sí tenemos en cuenta”和“concebirse a sí mismo”。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语议会文本、哲学文本

patterns.name: far / far-infrared 词汇
patterns.context: 英语中出现 far：既有“So far”表示“迄今”，也有 far-IR、far-infrared 表示远红外，还有“far from”表示距离或程度远。
patterns.domain: 英语学术论文，涉及引力波、天文学、材料科学、理论物理

patterns.name: 捷克语词内变音符号片段
patterns.context: 捷克语文本中，激活落在带变音符号的字符或被分词切开的局部词片段；上下文涉及成员国、机构、机场网络等。

patterns.name: 英语 so far 结构中的分段词元
patterns.context: 句首或句中以 So/so far 表示“迄今为止”；激活主要落在 far，So/so 也被标记。

patterns.name: 英语 far 的非时间性搭配
patterns.context: far 与红外波段名构成复合词，或与 from 构成距离／程度表达；不同于 so far 的“迄今”。
patterns.domain: 天文学、天体物理、理论物理学术论文

en.concept: String fragments and multilingual word forms
en.description: Activations mainly correspond to Spanish sí, English Far (especially Faraday, also Far East), and Czech character fragments with diacritics; they span languages and fields, with no unified semantics evident.

patterns.name: Spanish sí
patterns.context: In Spanish sentences, appears as an affirmative adverb (“yes/indeed”) or reflexive pronoun (“oneself”); spaces or emphatic constructions are common nearby.

patterns.name: Far string
patterns.context: The capitalized form Far appears in English text, mainly at the beginning of Faraday; it also occurs in the place name Far East. Some instances occur at different word boundaries or in markers.
patterns.domain: Physics and astronomy papers, mathematics papers, news emails

patterns.name: Czech fragment with diacritics
patterns.context: In Czech text, activation falls on characters with diacritics or fragments within words; this example includes content such as letištní síť.

0_230.concept: 字符串片段与多语种词形
0_230.description: 激活主要对应西语 sí、英语 Far（尤其 Faraday，也见 Far East），另有捷克语带变音符号的字符片段；跨语种、跨领域，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: 西班牙语中的 sí
patterns.context: 西班牙语句子中作为肯定副词（“是/确实”）或反身代词（“自己”）出现；附近常见空格或强调结构。

patterns.name: Far 字符串
patterns.context: 英语文本中出现大小写形式 Far，主要是 Faraday 的词首；也有 Far-East 地名中的 Far。若干实例位于不同词边界或标记中。
patterns.domain: 物理与天文学论文、数学论文、新闻邮件

patterns.name: 捷克语带变音符号的片段
patterns.context: 捷克语文本中，激活落在带变音符号的字符或词内片段；本例包含 letištní síť 等内容。

en.description: All segments strongly activate on nucleic in “nucleic acid(s),” spanning contexts involving nucleic-acid classification, detection, extraction, metabolism, staining, hybridization, vaccine encoding, plant expression, immune antigens, and diagnostic products.

patterns.name: Nucleic-acid terminology
patterns.context: In “nucleic acid,” refers to the nucleic acid itself or related procedures and properties; this term appears in every segment and triggers the strongest activation.

patterns.name: Nucleic-acid sequences and classification
patterns.context: Nucleic-acid sequences are used in fungal systematics and phylogenetic analysis.

patterns.name: Probe hybridization and chromosomal DNA
patterns.context: Fluorescently labeled probes recognize and hybridize to target chromosomal DNA through base pairing.

patterns.name: Nucleic-acid extraction and sequencing samples
patterns.context: RNA or nucleic acids are extracted from samples or bronchoalveolar lavage fluid and used in whole-genome sequencing workflows.

patterns.name: Nucleic-acid metabolism and physiological processes
patterns.context: Nucleic acids are listed alongside proteins, lipids, and carbohydrates as metabolism-related substances in a discussion of metal ions and physiological processes.

patterns.name: Nucleic-acid staining and separation
patterns.context: Discusses staining cell-like structures, DNA dyes, and experimental observations that nucleic acids cannot be separated.

patterns.name: Nucleic-acid hybridization diagnostics
patterns.context: Lists nucleic-acid hybridization and restriction enzyme analysis as clinical diagnostic testing techniques.

patterns.name: Nucleic-acid vaccine coding sequence
patterns.context: A nucleic-acid sequence encodes the respiratory syncytial virus fusion protein and is used in vaccine design.

patterns.name: Encoding cytotoxic molecules in plant cells
patterns.context: Nucleic acids encode cytotoxic molecules and are associated with expression in cells of plant male reproductive organs.

patterns.name: Category of foreign antigens
patterns.context: Nucleic acids are listed alongside proteins, polysaccharides, and other substances as foreign macromolecules or antigens in an immune defense context.

patterns.name: Nucleic-acid extraction diagnostic product
patterns.context: A nucleic-acid extraction cartridge is used in a rapid, simple, low-cost diagnostic system for sexually transmitted infection pathogens.

0_230.description: 所有段落均在“nucleic acid(s)”中的 nucleic 处强激活，覆盖核酸的分类、检测、提取、代谢、染色、杂交、疫苗编码、植物表达、免疫抗原及诊断产品语境。

patterns.name: 核酸术语
patterns.context: 在“nucleic acid”中，指核酸本身或核酸相关操作、性质；该词在全部段落都出现并触发最强激活。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、分子生物学、专利背景

patterns.name: 核酸序列与分类
patterns.context: 核酸序列用于真菌系统分类及系统发育分析。

patterns.name: 探针杂交与染色体DNA
patterns.context: 荧光标记探针通过碱基配对识别并杂交到目标染色体DNA。

patterns.name: 核酸提取与测序样本
patterns.context: 从样本或支气管肺泡灌洗液中提取RNA或核酸，并用于全基因组测序流程。
patterns.domain: 实验方法、临床样本处理

patterns.name: 核酸代谢与生理过程
patterns.context: 将核酸与蛋白质、脂质、碳水化合物并列为代谢相关物质，置于金属离子及生理过程讨论中。

patterns.name: 核酸染色与分离
patterns.context: 讨论细胞样结构的染色、DNA染料及核酸无法分离的实验观察。

patterns.name: 核酸杂交诊断
patterns.context: 将核酸杂交和限制性酶分析列作临床诊断检测技术。

patterns.name: 核酸疫苗编码序列
patterns.context: 核酸序列编码呼吸道合胞病毒融合蛋白，并用于疫苗设计。

patterns.name: 植物细胞毒性分子编码
patterns.context: 核酸编码细胞毒性分子并与植物雄性生殖器官细胞中的表达相关。
patterns.domain: 植物生物技术、专利背景

patterns.name: 外来抗原类别
patterns.context: 核酸与蛋白质、多糖等并列为外来大分子或抗原，置于免疫防御语境。

patterns.name: 核酸提取诊断产品
patterns.context: 将核酸提取卡匣用于快速、简便、低成本的性传播感染病原体诊断系统。

en.description: Strong activations cluster on the character fragment far: an in-word fragment in Swedish fortfarande, several Far- names or surnames, and English so-far; other trigger positions may also be mere orthographic matches.

patterns.name: Swedish adverb fortfar-
patterns.context: Occurs within the Swedish word «fortfarande», typically immediately following the prefix «fort»; the word means “still”.

patterns.name: Farah/Farak name or surname fragment
patterns.context: Embedded in names or surnames beginning with far, such as «far»10ahbakhsh, «far»10o, and «far»10rell; boundaries and spellings vary across texts.

patterns.name: Farber surname and citation
patterns.context: Appears in the surname of the topologist Farber, alongside academic citations to his work.

patterns.name: far meaning “to date/distant”
patterns.context: English phrase so-far, or the name of the cited physics author Farakos; the latter may be a coincidental orthographic match with the former.
patterns.domain: Dark matter research papers, theoretical physics citations

0_230.description: 强激活集中于字符片段 far：瑞典语 fortfarande 的词内片段、若干 Far- 姓名或姓氏、英文 so-far；其余触发位置也可能只是字形匹配。

patterns.name: 瑞典语副词 fortfar-
patterns.context: 出现在瑞典语单词 «fortfarande» 的词内，且通常紧接前缀 «fort»；该词意为“仍然”。

patterns.name: Farah/Farak 人名或姓氏片段
patterns.context: 嵌在以 far 开头的人名或姓氏中，如 «far»10ahbakhsh、«far»10o、«far»10rell；不同文本中的边界与拼写各异。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、电子邮件地址

patterns.name: Farber 姓氏及文献引用
patterns.context: 作为拓扑学家 Farber 的姓氏出现，并在上下文中伴随对其工作的学术引用。

patterns.name: far 表示“迄今／远”
patterns.context: 英文短语 so-far，或物理学引文作者名 Farakos；后者与前者可能只是字形巧合。
patterns.domain: 暗物质研究论文、理论物理引文

en.description: Primarily responds to the subword far: it commonly occurs in the Swedish word fortfarande and also in surnames such as Farber/Farah, so-far, citations, email domains, and author surnames. The trigger spans languages and genres, with its position within a word as the shared feature.

patterns.name: Fragment within Swedish word «fortfarande»
patterns.context: Activation falls on a subword fragment of the Swedish adverb fortfarande; it appears in policy statements, parliamentary speeches, and sentences about environmental or media issues.

patterns.name: Fragment in English surnames Farber/Farah
patterns.context: Appears in personal names or bibliographic author surnames Farber and Farah; surrounding text is paper body text or author information.

patterns.name: English far-related word forms or citation fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the English phrase so-far and in farakos in a bibliographic citation; it is not the Swedish adverb.

patterns.name: far in an email domain
patterns.context: Activation is located within the email address domain farrell.com.

patterns.name: Fragment within an antiquark term
patterns.context: The marked trigger occurs near a physics term such as Ant«iqu»ark« Bound», but the far marker in this segment actually appears within the author surname Al«far»o.
patterns.domain: English ArXiv paper titles and author affiliations

0_230.description: 主要响应子词 far：常见于瑞典语 fortfarande，也出现在 Farber/Farah 等姓氏、so-far、引用名、邮箱域名及作者姓中；触发跨语言和体裁，词内位置是共同点。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内的「fortfarande」片段
patterns.context: 激活落在瑞典语副词 fortfarande 的词内片段；出现在政策陈述、议会发言和环境或媒体议题的句子中。

patterns.name: 英文姓氏 Farber/Farah 片段
patterns.context: 出现在人名或文献作者姓氏 Farber、Farah 中；周边文本是论文正文或署名信息。
patterns.domain: 英文 ArXiv 学术文本

patterns.name: 英文 far 相关词形或引用片段
patterns.context: 出现在英文词组 so-far，以及文献引用中的 farakos；并非瑞典语副词。
patterns.domain: 英文 ArXiv 学术文本

patterns.name: 邮箱域名中的 far
patterns.context: 激活位于电子邮件地址域名 farrell.com 内。

patterns.name: 反夸克词内部片段
patterns.context: 触发标记处于 Ant«iqu»ark« Bound» 一类物理术语附近，但该段的 far 标记实际出现在作者姓氏 Al«far»o 内。
patterns.domain: 英文 ArXiv 论文标题与作者署名

en.description: All activate on the token “Far”, whether it belongs to Faraday, Far East, Far-Infrared, or a person or company name. Contexts span disciplines and meanings, with no other stable condition evident.

patterns.name: Faraday word fragment
patterns.context: The complete word Faraday is split into multiple tokens; contexts involve physical descriptions of rotation, rotation measures, or negligibility
patterns.domain: Astrophysics, radio astronomy, and electromagnetism papers

patterns.name: Far- geographic prefix
patterns.context: “Far” begins a compound or fixed geographic name, followed by a hyphen or East

patterns.name: Far stem as part of a proper name
patterns.context: Only a stem within a person’s name, company name, or case name; no apparent unified semantic or domain condition
patterns.domain: Acknowledgments in mathematics papers, legal cases, and commercial legal texts

0_230.description: 均激活于 token“Far”，无论它属于 Faraday、Far East、Far-Infrared，还是人名与公司名。上下文跨学科且语义多样，未见其他稳定条件。

patterns.name: Faraday 词项片段
patterns.context: Faraday 完整词被拆成多个 token；涉及旋转、旋转量、可忽略性等物理表述
patterns.domain: 天体物理、射电天文学与电磁学论文

patterns.name: Far- 前缀地理名称
patterns.context: “Far”作为复合词或固定地理名称的开头，后接连字符或 East

patterns.name: Far 词干的专名组成部分

0_1543.description: 多数段落在代码测试语境中包含大小写 Mock 标识符，尤其是 Mock 类、构造器、对象或框架名；另有 Mockup 专名，以及论文中的分类准确率词数和数学公式数字、运算符激活。

patterns.name: Mock 相关代码标识符
patterns.context: 大小写形式 Mock 出现在类名、函数/变量名、测试框架或类型标识符中，常与 test、mock、测试替身等代码语境相邻
patterns.domain: Github 代码及 StackExchange 编程问答

patterns.name: Mockup 产品/名称词
patterns.context: Mock 与 up 连写构成专名的一部分，谈论网站企业名称趋势；并非代码中的 mock 对象

patterns.name: 语言分类论文中的数字
patterns.context: 描述语言识别/分类实验及准确率，激活落在英语功能词和数值上，与代码中的 Mock 无明显联系

patterns.name: 数学公式中的数字与运算符
patterns.context: 多项式定义中的系数、幂运算及常数；没有 Mock 相关词

en.description: All passages activate on repay/repayment: this includes repaying money, bonds, debt, or other financial obligations, as well as repaying others’ kindness through actions; the common theme is repayment or reciprocation.

patterns.name: Repaying debt or money
patterns.context: repay is followed by a specific object or amount, such as money, bonds, debt, principal, or power generators; repayment of is also common. Concerns repaying loans, debts, advances, or financial obligations.
patterns.domain: Law, finance, news, and corporate email

patterns.name: Repaying a favor or kindness
patterns.context: The object of repay is kindness, meaning to return someone’s kindness through help or hospitality rather than to repay a monetary debt.

0_1543.description: 所有段都在 repay/repayment 上激活：既包括偿还金钱、债券、债务或其他财务义务，也包括以行动回报他人善意；共同点是偿还或回馈。

patterns.name: 偿还债务或款项
patterns.context: 在 repay 后接具体对象或款项，如 money、bonds、debt、principal、power generators；也常见 repayment of。涉及偿还借款、债务、垫款或财务义务。
patterns.domain: 法律、金融、新闻及企业邮件

patterns.name: 回报人情或善意
patterns.context: repay 的对象是 kindness，表示以帮忙或款待回报他人的善意，而非偿还金钱债务。

en.description: Activation occurs on word-internal or standalone fragments in multilingual text: German Ich is the clearest example; English scientific words, Swedish and Slovak word forms, and language names also activate. The pattern is difficult to reduce to a single meaning or part of speech.

patterns.name: German first-person ich
patterns.context: The German first-person pronoun Ich, including at the beginning of a sentence or in quoted speech

patterns.name: ich within or at the end of English words
patterns.context: Words or internal substrings containing the letter sequence ich appear in English scientific text; they need not be standalone pronouns

patterns.name: Specific word-form fragments in multilingual text
patterns.context: Word-internal fragments in Swedish or Slovak sentences, often in inflected words or words containing diacritics

patterns.name: Fragments within language names
patterns.context: Activation falls within language names when English text lists language pairs or translation languages

0_1543.description: 激活分布于多语种文本的词内或独立片段：德语 Ich 最明确；英语科学词、瑞典语和斯洛伐克语词形，以及语言名称也有激活。难以归结为单一语义或词类。

patterns.name: 德语第一人称 ich
patterns.context: 德语句中第一人称代词 Ich（含句首或引语中的发言）

patterns.name: 英语词尾或词中 ich
patterns.context: 英语科学文本中出现包含字母串 ich 的词或词内部子串；不要求是独立代词

patterns.name: 多语种文本中的特定词形片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语或斯洛伐克语句子中的词内片段，常见于屈折词或带变音符号的词

patterns.name: 语言名称中的词内片段
patterns.context: 英语文本列举语言对或翻译语言名称时，激活落在语言名称内部

en.description: The strongest surface patterns are Bulgarian “яв” within words and “Ich”; in two passages, the latter is the prefix of a quoted surname, while in one it is the German first-person pronoun. The languages and contexts are not consistent.

patterns.name: Bulgarian in-word fragment “яв”
patterns.context: The trigger occurs inside Bulgarian word forms, with varied prefixes, suffixes, and meanings, such as “за«яв»ява”, “установ«яв»ането”, and “на«яв»аме”.
patterns.domain: Bulgarian text in EuroParl and StackExchange

patterns.name: English proper-name fragment “Ich”
patterns.context: The trigger is at the beginning of an author surname in a bracketed citation: “[@«Ich»ii1987]”, “[@«Ich»imura97]”.

patterns.name: German word-initial “Ich”
patterns.context: The trigger is the standalone sentence-initial pronoun “«Ich» möchte”, not a quoted surname.

0_1543.description: 激活最强的表面模式有两种：保加利亚语词内“яв”，以及“Ich”；后者在两段是引用姓氏前缀，在一段是德语第一人称代词，语种和语境并不统一。

patterns.name: 保加利亚语词内片段“яв”
patterns.context: 触发点出现在保加利亚语词形内部，前后缀及词义差异很大，如“за«яв»ява”“установ«яв»ането”“на«яв»аме”。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 与 StackExchange 中的保加利亚语文本

patterns.name: 英文专名片段“Ich”
patterns.context: 触发点位于方括号引用中的作者姓氏开头：“[@«Ich»ii1987]”“[@«Ich»imura97]”。

patterns.name: 德语词首“Ich”
patterns.context: 触发点是句首独立代词“«Ich» möchte”，而非引用姓氏。

en.description: All passages strongly activate on the capitalized token “Of,” which often appears at the beginning of a sentence and introduces a following phrase; most commonly in Of course and Of + interest/note expressions, but also in other noun phrases and titles.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial “Of course”
patterns.context: A new sentence starts with capitalized Of after a period, forming the fixed phrase “Of course,” followed by a subject such as we

patterns.name: Sentence-initial expressions of interest
patterns.context: A new sentence starts with capitalized Of after a period, introducing a point of interest with “Of + descriptor + interest/note”

patterns.name: Of elsewhere in sentence openings or titles
patterns.context: Capitalized Of appears at the start of a sentence or in a title, followed by a noun phrase; it is not one of the fixed expressions above
patterns.domain: Academic paper body text, paper titles

0_1543.description: 所有段均强烈激活大写词元“Of”，多出现在句首并引出后续短语；最常见于 Of course 和 Of + interest/note 表达，也见于其他名词短语及标题。

patterns.name: 句首“Of course”
patterns.context: 句号后以大写 Of 开始新句，构成固定短语“Of course”，后接 we 等主语

patterns.name: 句首兴趣表达
patterns.trigger: «Of»10 particular interest；«Of»10 utmost interest；«Of»10 specific note
patterns.context: 句号后以大写 Of 开始新句，以“Of + 描述语 + interest/note”引出关注点

patterns.name: 其他句首或标题中的 Of
patterns.trigger: «Of»10 many applications；«Of»10 these；标题中的«Of»10 A
patterns.context: 大写 Of 位于句首或标题中，后接名词短语；不属于前述固定表达
patterns.domain: 学术论文正文、论文标题

en.description: All passages activate on capitalized Of: mostly in prepositional phrases at the beginning of academic body-text sentences, often introducing an evaluation, interest, scope, or example; once, it appears in a paper title.

patterns.name: Capitalized Of at sentence start
patterns.context: Often follows a period and is followed by a noun phrase or evaluative expression; in passage 10, it appears in a title.
patterns.domain: ArXiv academic paper body text and titles

patterns.name: Of followed by an interest or evaluation phrase
patterns.context: Of introduces an evaluation, scope, example, or referent; what follows is usually an expression of interest/evaluation or a qualifying phrase.

patterns.name: Of in a title
patterns.context: Forms part of a prepositional phrase in a title, connecting the title noun to a following qualifier.

0_1543.concept: 学术语境中的大写 Of
0_1543.description: 所有片段都在大写 Of 处激活：多为学术正文句首的介词短语，常引出评价、兴趣、范围或例示；另有一次出现在论文标题中。

patterns.name: 句中 Of 大写起始
patterns.trigger: « Of»10，出现在句首或句子承接处
patterns.context: 此前常以句号结束，随后接名词短语或评价性表达；在第10段则是标题中的 Of
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文的正文及标题

patterns.name: Of 后接兴趣或评价短语
patterns.trigger: “Of many applications”“Of course”“Of these”“Of particular interest”“Of utmost interest”“Of specific note”
patterns.context: Of 引出评价、范围、例示或指代对象，后续通常是兴趣/评价表达或限定短语

patterns.name: 标题中的 Of
patterns.context: 作为标题中介词短语的一部分，Of 连接标题名词与后续限定成分

en.description: All snippets activate on sentence-initial Of followed by an evaluative expression: Of many applications, Of course, Of these, Of particular interest, Of utmost interest, Of specific note, Of A Magnetic…; domains and topics vary.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Of followed by an evaluative phrase
patterns.context: The preposition Of at the beginning of a sentence introduces an evaluative or qualifying phrase, often “Of + noun/adjective + interest/note/course,” followed by further exposition.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, especially ArXiv scientific papers

0_1543.description: 全部片段都在句首激活 Of，后接评述性表达：Of many applications、Of course、Of these、Of particular interest、Of utmost interest、Of specific note、Of A Magnetic…；领域与主题各异。

patterns.name: 句首 Of 后接评述短语
patterns.context: 句首的介词 Of 引出评述或限定短语；多为“Of + 名词/形容词 + interest/note/course”，后续继续陈述。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，尤以 ArXiv 科学论文为主

en.description: All passages activate on capitalized Of; it appears at the start of academic text, in parenthetical phrases, fixed expressions of interest, other Of phrases, and titles, with varied following structures.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Of
patterns.context: Capitalized Of appears at the beginning of a sentence or clause, followed by a noun phrase or evaluative expression; common in transitions or additions after prior discussion.

patterns.name: Of course parenthetical
patterns.context: Of course appears as a sentence-initial parenthetical, often followed by a comma; it signals an authorial explanation, qualification, or addition.

patterns.name: Of particular interest
patterns.context: The fixed expression Of particular interest is followed by is/are to introduce a research subject or focus.
patterns.domain: Introducing research priorities in academic papers

patterns.name: Other Of + evaluative or quantitative phrase
patterns.context: Capitalized Of is followed by varied phrases: many applications, these, utmost interest, specific note; some are uncommon or incomplete expressions.

patterns.name: Of in a title
patterns.context: Of is followed by an article and noun in a title, using title case.

0_1543.description: 所有段都激活大写 Of；该词出现在学术文本句首、插入语、固定关注点表达、其他 Of 短语及标题中，具体后续结构各异。

patterns.name: 句首 Of
patterns.context: 句首或句中句界处出现大写 Of，后接名词短语或评价性表达；常见于前文讨论之后的转折或引出补充信息。

patterns.name: Of course 插入语
patterns.context: Of course 作为句首插入语，常后接逗号；语气上表示作者说明、限定或补充。

patterns.name: Of particular interest
patterns.context: 固定表达 Of particular interest，后接 is/are 引出研究对象或关注点。
patterns.domain: 学术论文中的研究重点介绍

patterns.name: 其他 Of + 评价或数量短语
patterns.trigger: « Of»10 many applications；« Of»10 these；« Of»10 utmost interest；« Of»10 specific note
patterns.context: 大写 Of 后接多种短语：many applications、these、utmost interest、specific note；部分为不常见或不完整的表达。

patterns.name: 标题中的 Of
patterns.context: 标题中 Of 后接冠词和名词，采用标题式大写。

en.description: All segments activate on sentence-initial Of, often forming phrases such as Of course, Of particular interest, and Of utmost interest that introduce commentary or emphasis; following forms vary, and the domain is not fixed.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Of phrases expressing emphasis or contrast
patterns.context: Capitalized Of appears at the beginning of a sentence, after a period or sentence boundary; the following phrase introduces commentary, a point of interest, or an example.
patterns.domain: Academic paper body text across physics, astronomy, materials science, cosmology, and other fields

0_1543.concept: 句首强调性 Of 短语
0_1543.description: 所有段都在句首激活 Of，常构成 Of course、Of particular interest、Of utmost interest 等引导评论或强调的短语；后接形式多样，领域也不固定。

patterns.name: 句首 Of 引导的强调或转折短语
patterns.trigger: «Of»10 后接 “course”“particular interest”“utmost interest”“specific note”“many applications” 或其他名词短语
patterns.context: 句首大写 Of，前面是句号或句子边界；后续短语引出评论、关注点或例子。
patterns.domain: 学术论文正文，跨物理、天文、材料、宇宙学等领域

en.description: The most stable signal is Of at the beginning of a clause or sentence in academic text, across disciplines; there are also a few In/we occurrences, in-word fragments in Portuguese, and sporadic stems that cannot be unified.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial preposition Of
patterns.context: Of at the beginning of a sentence or clause, often followed by a noun phrase; sometimes forms the fixed expression Of course, and sometimes precedes these, particular interest, and similar phrases.

patterns.name: In-word Portuguese fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls within Portuguese words such as “têm”, “descrição”, and “econômico”; the context discusses economic development.

patterns.name: English sentence-initial In and we
patterns.context: In begins an explanation or argument in the body of a paper, with we often nearby; these words are not marked in every passage.

patterns.name: Specific English stems and phrase fragments
patterns.context: Sporadically appear in proper names, technical terms, common words, or in-word fragments; there is no shared local syntactic condition, making them difficult to group into a stable trigger pattern.
patterns.domain: Mathematical physics, photosynthesis, cosmology, Portuguese text, and others

0_1543.description: 最稳定的信号是学术文本分句或句首的 Of，覆盖多学科论文；另有少量 In/we、葡萄牙语词内片段及分散词干激活，无法统一解释。

patterns.name: 句首介词 Of
patterns.context: 句首或分句开头的 Of，常接名词短语；有时构成固定表达 Of course，有时接 these、particular interest 等

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在葡萄牙语词内部，如 “têm”“descrição”“econômico”；语境讨论经济发展
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语哲学/跨学科文本

patterns.name: 英文句首 In 与 we
patterns.context: 论文正文中句首 In 引出说明或论述，附近常有 we；并非这些词在所有段落中都被标记

patterns.name: 特定英文词干与短语片段
patterns.context: 分散出现在专名、技术术语、普通词或词内片段中；缺乏共同的局部句法条件，难以归为一个稳定触发模式
patterns.domain: 数学物理、光合作用、宇宙学、葡萄牙语文本等

en.description: Primarily responds to the English anecdotal word family, which often refers to nonsystematic evidence from personal experience or observation in forums, medicine, and general discussion; also has one strong response to a morpheme in Portuguese económico.

patterns.name: anecdotal word family
patterns.context: anecdotal and its inflections appear, often when describing personal experience, observations, or evidence, and commonly alongside evidence, observations, example, note, and similar words.
patterns.domain: Technology forums, medical papers, and general discussion; both conversational and academic styles

patterns.name: Morpheme in an economics term
patterns.context: Morpheme segmentation of the Portuguese adjective económico; occurs in the phrase “desenvolvimento económico” (economic development).

0_1543.description: 主要响应英文 anecdotal 词族，在论坛、医学与一般论述中常指个人经验或观察所得、非系统性证据；另对葡语 económico 的词素有一次强响应。

patterns.name: anecdotal 词族
patterns.context: 出现 anecdotal 及其词形变化；多在描述个人经验、观察或证据时，常与 evidence、observations、example、note 等搭配。
patterns.domain: 科技论坛、医学论文及一般论述；对话和学术文体均有

patterns.name: 经济学术语中的词素
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语形容词 económico 的词素拆分；处于“desenvolvimento económico”（经济发展）这一短语中。
patterns.domain: 学术文献，葡萄牙语经济学论述

en.description: All passages activate on the anecdotal/anecdotally stem. Contexts range from acknowledging personal experience and non-scientific evidence to proposing hypotheses from anecdotal observations, reporting medical evidence, or adding individual cases; the core is material marked as non-systematic experience.

patterns.name: Lexical activation on anecdotal
patterns.context: The trigger is concentrated in the anecdotal/anecdotally stem and its suffixes; it appears mid-sentence, in quoted contexts, or in sentence-initial phrases.
patterns.domain: HackerNews discussions and PubMed academic text

patterns.name: Based on experience rather than systematic evidence
patterns.context: Observations, personal experiences, or evidence are explicitly labeled anecdotal/non-systematic; examples include qualified medical observations and technical experience.
patterns.domain: Forum experience sharing, medical research, and clinical studies

patterns.name: Anecdotal observations as a basis for hypotheses or explanations
patterns.context: Anecdotal observations are used to propose hypotheses, or the speaker acknowledges that a judgment reflects only personal knowledge or insufficient evidence.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions; speculation involving population differences or changes in outcomes

patterns.name: Using individual cases for illustration or evaluation
patterns.context: A single example, personal account, or experiential addition is used to illustrate a point; evidence quality is not necessarily discussed explicitly.

0_1543.description: 全部片段均在 anecdotal/anecdotally 词干处激活。语境从承认个人经验、非科学证据，到以轶事观察提出假设、报告医学证据或补充个例，核心是标记非系统性的经验性材料。

patterns.name: anecdotal 的词汇激活
patterns.context: 触发点集中在 anecdotal/anecdotally 的词干及其后缀；出现在句中、引述语境或句首短语中。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 讨论与 PubMed 学术文本

patterns.name: 以经验而非系统证据为依据
patterns.trigger: “all« anec»10«dot»2al from my experience”；“non-«scientific»3« anec»10«dot»2al evidence”；“« anec»10«dot»2al rather than hypothetical responses”；“provide« anec»10«dot»2al evidence”
patterns.context: 明确将观察、个人经历或证据标为轶事性／非系统性；包括带限定的医学观察和技术经验。
patterns.domain: 论坛经验分享、医学研究及临床研究

patterns.name: 轶事性观察作为假设或解释依据
patterns.trigger: “hypotheses based on« anec»10«dot»2al observations”；“« anec»10«dot»2al« I»5 know”
patterns.context: 将轶事观察用于提出假设，或承认判断只是个人所知、证据不足。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论；涉及人口差异或结果变化的推测

patterns.name: 以个例作说明或评价
patterns.trigger: “The« anec»10«dot»2al« example»”；“On an« anec»10«dot»2al note”；“just« anec»10«dot»2ally”
patterns.context: 用单个例子、个人见闻或经验性补充来说明观点；不一定显式谈论证据质量。

en.concept: Text boundaries and common subword fragments
en.description: High activations fall into two groups of corpora: split words/letter fragments in Greek parliamentary text, and sentence-initial In and Of, authorial we, and the preposition of in English ArXiv text; whitespace boundaries also commonly activate. The κ/Wall context in segment 5 and the Of context in segment 9 are harder to interpret.

patterns.name: Letters in Greek word stems
patterns.context: Activation falls within words in continuous Greek text, especially where letters are split across multiple subword tokens; it does not correspond only to a fixed word meaning.

patterns.name: English sentence-initial In
patterns.context: At the beginning of a sentence or new paragraph, followed by academic narration, as in “In this paper” or “In this note”.

patterns.name: English sentence-initial Of
patterns.context: Sentence-initial connective expressions, especially “Of course”; also appears in “Of many applications”.

patterns.name: English we
patterns.context: Paper authors use the first-person plural to introduce their work, assumptions, or understanding; common forms include “we will,” “we propose,” “we assume,” and “we understand”.

patterns.name: English of
patterns.context: The ordinary English preposition, appearing in academic phrases such as “composed of,” “example of,” “existence of,” and “generalisation of”.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial or discourse-transition position
patterns.context: Highly activating whitespace markers appear at sentence beginnings or transitions: for example, after a paragraph break, before sentence-initial “In/Of,” or before “Of course”; the exact boundary form varies.

patterns.name: Repeated triggers in Greek letter-by-letter encoding
patterns.context: In Greek, activation is distributed across split letters or subword fragments; it is unclear whether this shares an origin with the sentence-initial word pattern in English papers.

0_1543.concept: 文本边界与常见词片段
0_1543.description: 高激活分属两类语料：希腊语议会文本中的拆分词/字母片段，以及 ArXiv 英文中句首 In、Of、作者 we 和介词 of；空白边界也常激活。第5段的 κ/Wall 与第9段的 Of 语境较难解释。

patterns.name: 希腊语词干中的字母
patterns.context: 激活落在希腊语连续文本的词内，尤其是字母被分成多个子词 token 的位置；并非只对应某个固定词义。

patterns.name: 英语句首 In
patterns.context: 句首或新段落开头，后接论文叙述，如 “In this paper” 或 “In this note”。

patterns.name: 英语句首 Of
patterns.context: 句首转接表达，尤其是 “Of course”；也出现于 “Of many applications”。

patterns.name: 英语 we
patterns.context: 论文作者以第一人称复数介绍工作、假设或认识；常见于 “we will”“we propose”“we assume”“we understand”。

patterns.name: 英语 of
patterns.context: 普通英语介词，出现在 “composed of”“example of”“existence of”“generalisation of”等学术短语中。

patterns.name: 句首或话语转接位置
patterns.context: 高激活空白标记出现在句首/转接位置：如段落换行后、句首 “In/Of” 前，或 “Of course” 前；具体边界形式不完全一致。

patterns.name: 希腊语逐字母编码中的重复触发
patterns.context: 希腊语中激活分布在拆分后的字母或词片段上；与英语论文中的句首词模式是否同源无法确定。

en.description: Activations cluster around two distinct text patterns: accented “ώ” in Greek words and sentence-initial “Of” in English papers. The two differ in language, position, and context, with no evident shared semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Greek word-final/in-word syllable “ώ”
patterns.context: Words containing “ώ” are segmented in continuous Greek text; the target is the accented character “ώ”, regardless of specific meaning or syntactic function.

patterns.name: English sentence-initial Of
patterns.context: Of appears at the beginning of a sentence or clause in the body of an English paper; the following content varies and is not limited to a specific discipline.

0_1543.concept: 语言与位置特定的词形片段
0_1543.description: 激活集中在两类不同文本模式：希腊语词中带重音的「ώ」，以及英文论文中的句首「Of」。两者语言、位置和语境不同，未见共同语义模式。

patterns.name: 希腊语词尾/词内音节「ώ」
patterns.context: 希腊语连续文本中，含有「ώ」的词被拆分标注；目标位置为重音字符「ώ」，不要求特定词义或句法功能

patterns.name: 英文句首 Of
patterns.context: 英文论文正文中，句首或分句句首出现 Of；各例后接不同内容，不限具体学科

en.description: All segments activate on the stem anec in anecdotal or anecdotally, often qualifying a basis as personal experience, observation, or informal evidence; contexts span forum comments and medical papers, with varied surrounding topics.

patterns.name: Stem of anecdotal
patterns.context: Trigger points all fall within anecdotal/anecdotally; the word can be an adjective or adverb modifying evidence, observations, notes, examples, or experience.
patterns.domain: Hacker News discussions and PubMed academic medical text

0_1543.description: 所有片段都在 anecdotal 或 anecdotally 的词干 anec 上激活，常用于限定依据来自个人经验、观察或非正式证据；跨论坛评论和医学论文，周围主题各异。

patterns.name: anecdotal 一词的词干
patterns.context: 触发点都位于 anecdotal/anecdotally 一词内部；可作形容词或副词，修饰 evidence、observations、note、例子或经验。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 讨论与 PubMed 学术医学文本

en.description: All passages strongly activate on the anecdotal/anecdotally root; it marks personal experience or informal observation, and also qualifies evidence as anecdotal, informal, or non-hypothetical material. Domains include forum comments and medical papers.

patterns.name: anecdote root
patterns.context: The root appears in anecdotal or anecdotally; this is the shared core trigger across all passages.
patterns.domain: HackerNews comments and PubMed academic text

patterns.name: Anecdotal evidence or observations
patterns.context: Material is explicitly called anecdotal evidence, observation, or experience; often linked to evidentiary strength or the reliability of inferences.

patterns.name: Personal experience or anecdotal statements
patterns.context: Statements are introduced through personal experience, informal observation, or an anecdotal framing, without necessarily mentioning evidence explicitly.
patterns.domain: HackerNews personal comments, PubMed clinical study abstracts

0_1543.description: 所有片段都强烈激活于 anecdotal/anecdotally 词根；既用于标示个人经验或非正式观察，也用于限定证据为轶事性、非正式或非假设性的材料，领域涵盖论坛评论与医学论文。

patterns.name: anecdote 词根
patterns.context: 词根出现在 anecdotal 或 anecdotally 中；这是所有片段共同的核心触发
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论与 PubMed 学术文本

patterns.name: 基于轶事的证据或观察
patterns.context: 明确把材料称为轶事性证据、观察或经验；常与证据强度或推论可靠性相连

patterns.name: 个人经验或轶事式陈述
patterns.context: 以个人经历、非正式观察或轶事方式引入陈述，不一定明确提及 evidence
patterns.domain: HackerNews 个人评论、PubMed 临床研究摘要

en.description: All segments contain anecdotal or anecdotally, with activation concentrated on the tokenized fragment «anec»; in personal comments the word qualifies anecdotes, observations, or experience, while in medical papers it qualifies case-based data, associations, or evidence, often implying nonsystematic or limited evidence.

patterns.name: Anecdotal forms and qualification of evidence
patterns.context: The core trigger is the stem of anecdotal; it can function as an adjective or adverb qualifying experience, observations, evidence, or accounts, often implying informality, case-specificity, or lack of scientific rigor.
patterns.domain: HackerNews discussions and medical research papers

patterns.name: Contrast between informal experience and scientific evidence
patterns.context: Anecdotal evidence is contrasted with scientific evidence, systematic results, or reliable conclusions, or the argument is acknowledged to be based only on personal experience.
patterns.domain: HackerNews personal experience and technology discussions

patterns.name: Anecdotal data or evidence in research
patterns.context: In medical or scientific research, indicates that data come from respondents’ experiences, observed associations, or limited cases rather than strong causal proof.

patterns.name: Introducing a point or example with a personal anecdote
patterns.context: The word anecdotal introduces personal observations, individual examples, or experience-based commentary, followed by a personal experience or specific case.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within anecdotal
patterns.context: Activation falls on an intraword fragment produced by tokenization, rather than being triggered only by surrounding semantics; in every segment, the fragment occurs within anecdotal or anecdotally.

0_1543.description: 所有段都含 anecdotal 或 anecdotally，激活集中于分词片段 «anec»；该词在个人评论中限定轶事、观察或经验，在医学论文中限定个案性资料、关联或证据，常隐含非系统性或证据有限。

patterns.name: anecdotal 词形及证据限定
patterns.trigger: «anec»10dotal、«anec»10dotally；常见搭配有 «anec»10dotal «evidence»2、«anec»10dotal rather than hypothetical responses、On an «anec»10dotal note
patterns.context: 触发核心是 anecdotal 的词干；可作形容词或副词，用来限定经验、观察、证据或叙述，常暗示非正式、个案性或非科学性。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 讨论及医学研究论文

patterns.name: 非正式经验与科学性对比
patterns.context: 将轶闻式证据与科学证据、系统结果或可靠结论对照，或承认论据仅来自个人经验。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 个人经验与技术讨论

patterns.name: 研究中的轶闻性资料或证据
patterns.context: 在医学或科学研究语境中，说明资料来自受访者经验、观察到的关联或有限案例，而非强因果证明。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 医学研究论文

patterns.name: 以个人轶事引出观点或例子
patterns.trigger: The «anec»10dotal example；On an «anec»10dotal note；«anec»10dotally, all «of»1 my
patterns.context: 用 anecdotal 一词引入个人见闻、个别例子或基于经验的评论，后接个人经历或具体案例。

patterns.name: anecdotal 邻近的词形片段
patterns.trigger: «anec»10 与后续 dotal/dotally 组合成完整词
patterns.context: 激活落在分词后的词内片段，而非仅由周围语义触发；各段中该片段均处于 anecdotal 或 anecdotally。

en.concept: In-word fragments and the anecdotal stem
en.description: Strongly responds primarily to the English anecdotal/anecdotally stem, appearing in forums and medical papers; also responds to the in-word Greek fragment πό and a few isolated fragments. An empty-token activation marker may be a formatting anomaly and cannot be confirmed as a genuine trigger.

patterns.name: anecdotal stem
patterns.context: In English contexts, anecdotal / anecdotally appears, with activation concentrated on the stem anec; word forms and following collocations vary.
patterns.domain: HackerNews discussions and PubMed academic texts

patterns.name: In-word Greek fragment
patterns.context: A token fragment inside Greek words, appearing in different forms meaning “exercise/work,” “from,” and “next”; the visible fragment πό is shared, but meanings and syntactic functions differ.

patterns.name: Literal marker anomaly in tokenization
patterns.context: A Greek token annotation contains an activation marker with empty content, embedded after the tokenized sequence for “Ευρωπαϊκής”; it cannot be confirmed as a genuine lexical trigger.
patterns.domain: EuroParl Greek texts and annotation format

patterns.name: Independent subword-fragment triggers
patterns.context: These fragments each occur in different word forms, with no evidence of repetition across passages, so they cannot reliably be grouped into the same semantic pattern.
patterns.domain: English forums and Greek parliamentary texts

0_1543.concept: 词内片段与 anecdotal 词干
0_1543.description: 主要强烈响应英语 anecdotal/anecdotally 词干，跨论坛和医学论文出现；另有希腊语 πό 相关词内片段，以及少数孤立片段。空 token 标记可能是格式异常，不能确定为真实触发。

patterns.name: anecdotal 词干
patterns.context: 英语语境中出现 anecdotal / anecdotally，激活集中于词干 anec；词形及后续搭配不同。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 讨论与 PubMed 学术文本

patterns.name: 希腊语词内片段
patterns.context: 希腊语单词内部的分词片段，分别出现在“锻炼/工作”“从……起”及“接下来的”等不同词形中；共享的可见片段为 πό，但词义和句法功能并不一致。

patterns.name: 分词 token 的字面标记异常
patterns.context: 希腊语 token 标注中出现内容为空的激活标记，嵌在“Ευρωπαϊκής”一词的分词序列后；无法确认是否代表真实词汇触发。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 希腊语文本及标注格式

patterns.name: 独立的词片段触发
patterns.context: 这些片段各自出现在不同词形中，缺少跨段重复证据，不能可靠归并为同一语义模式。
patterns.domain: 英语论坛与希腊语议会文本

en.description: All segments highlight Of; it often introduces an additional topic, evaluation, or scope phrase after a sentence boundary, especially Of course and Of … interest, and also appears in referential, quantitative, and title usages.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial prepositional phrase introduced by Of
patterns.context: Follows a period, comma, or sentence/paragraph boundary, then a noun phrase forms a contrastive, connective, or topic-introducing “Of X, …” or “Of X …” construction; common continuations include “course,” “particular interest,” and “these”.
patterns.domain: ArXiv academic paper body text and titles

patterns.name: Fixed expression Of course
patterns.context: Of is immediately followed by course, often followed by a subject such as we, introducing an author’s elaboration, qualification, or concession.

patterns.name: Evaluative expression Of particular interest
patterns.context: Of is followed by particular interest, then identifies an object or issue worth attention.

patterns.name: Evaluative expression Of utmost interest
patterns.context: Of is followed by utmost interest, emphasizing the importance of the following topic.

patterns.name: Evaluative expression Of specific note
patterns.context: Of is followed by specific note, introducing a finding or fact worth particular mention.

patterns.name: Of these referring to a preceding set
patterns.context: Of these follows a description of a quantity or set, then gives further details about its members.

patterns.name: Of many introducing scope or quantity
patterns.context: Of is followed by many applications, then continues with examples among them; the expression is somewhat atypical here and may depend on the preceding sentence.

patterns.name: Of in titles
patterns.context: Appears in a paper title, where Of connects title elements rather than serving as a conventional sentence-initial expression in body text.

0_1543.concept: 学术语境中的 Of 短语
0_1543.description: 所有片段都突出 Of；它多在句界后引出补充话题、评价或范围短语，尤常见 Of course 与 Of … interest，也见指代、数量及标题用法。

patterns.name: Of 引导的句首介词短语
patterns.context: 前面是句号、逗号或句子/段落边界，随后接名词短语，构成 “Of X, …” 或 “Of X …” 的转折、承接或话题引入；常见后续为 “course”“particular interest”“these”。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文正文及标题

patterns.name: Of course 固定表达
patterns.context: Of 后紧接 course，后续常接 we 等主语，引出作者的补充、限定或让步说明。

patterns.name: Of particular interest 评价表达
patterns.context: Of 后接 particular interest，后续说明值得关注的对象或问题。

patterns.name: Of utmost interest 评价表达
patterns.context: Of 后接 utmost interest，强调后续主题的重要性。

patterns.name: Of specific note 评价表达
patterns.context: Of 后接 specific note，引出值得特别指出的发现或事实。

patterns.name: Of these 指代前文集合
patterns.context: Of these 位于前文数量或集合描述之后，后接对其中成员的进一步说明。

patterns.name: Of many 引入范围或数量
patterns.context: Of 后接 many applications，后续继续谈其中的例子；该处表达略不典型，可能依赖前句。

patterns.name: 标题中的 Of
patterns.context: 出现在论文标题中，Of 连接标题成分，而非正文句子中的常规句首表达。

en.description: All passages highlight none: including none of, nonequilibrium, none-classicality, and independent pronoun uses. It spans multiple academic fields; the core trigger may be the subword token none rather than a single meaning or domain.

patterns.name: Independent activation of none
patterns.context: The token none occurs in different morphological and syntactic environments: as the ordinary pronoun in none of, as a determiner before a noun, and as an in-word fragment in nonequilibrium and none-classicality; in passage [2] it immediately follows We study, and most other passages are also in academic discourse.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase none of
patterns.context: none is followed by of, meaning “not one” or “no,” and then by noun phrases such as approaches, reports, efforts/models.
patterns.domain: Academic argumentation and statements of research findings

patterns.name: Initial fragment in nonequilibrium
patterns.context: none is the contiguous initial part of nonequilibrium, a none + equilibrium term for a nonequilibrium state.
patterns.domain: Academic papers in physics, materials science, active systems, and related fields

patterns.name: Initial fragment in none-classicality
patterns.context: none- combines with classicality in a hyphenated term describing the nonclassicality of quantum correlations.

patterns.name: Isolated use of none
patterns.context: none directly serves as the subject, followed by show, meaning no galaxies exhibit a particular feature; this is neither a none of construction nor a compound term.

0_1543.description: 所有片段都突出 none：包括 none of、nonequilibrium、none-classicality，以及独立代词用法。它跨越多种学术领域，核心触发形式可能是子词 token none，而非单一语义或领域。

patterns.name: none 的独立激活
patterns.context: token none 出现在不同构词与句法环境中：作为普通代词 none of、名词前限定词，以及 nonequilibrium、none-classicality 的词内片段；在片段 [2] 中紧接 We study，其他多数段也处于学术论述中。

patterns.name: none of 固定搭配
patterns.context: none 后接 of，表达“没有一个/没有任何”，后续接 approaches、reports、efforts/models 等名词短语。
patterns.domain: 学术论证与研究结果陈述

patterns.name: nonequilibrium 词首片段
patterns.context: none 是 nonequilibrium 的连续词首部分，出现在 none 与 equilibrium 连写的非平衡术语中。
patterns.domain: 物理、材料、主动系统等学术论文

patterns.name: none-classicality 词首片段
patterns.context: none- 与 classicality 构成连字符术语，描述量子关联的非经典性。
patterns.domain: 量子物理思想实验论述

patterns.name: 孤立的 none 用法
patterns.context: none 直接作主语，后接 show，表示没有星系显示某种特征；不是 none of 结构或复合术语。

en.concept: Greek subword fragments and code markers
en.description: Strong activation occurs primarily on the Greek in-word fragment «ρί»; code samples also activate on the block-comment terminator */, the uint type in Go structs, and the Addr field. The corpora and trigger forms belong to distinct patterns.

patterns.name: High-response token inside Greek words
patterns.context: In Greek text, token «ρί» is followed by more text; it appears in different forms such as «κυρίως», «γνωρίζετε», and «περί», often inside longer words.

patterns.name: Code comment or documentation block terminator
patterns.context: At the end of a block comment or documentation comment in code, usually followed by a blank line or code.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code and license/documentation comments

patterns.name: Type marker in Go struct fields
patterns.context: The uint type appears after field names in Go struct declarations; multiple adjacent fields repeat this type.

patterns.name: Go network address field identifier
patterns.context: In a RawSockaddrInet struct, the Addr field is followed by a fixed-length byte array and an in_addr comment.

0_1543.concept: 希腊语词片段与代码标记
0_1543.description: 主要在希腊语词内「ρί」片段强烈激活；代码样本中另对块注释结束符 */、Go 结构体的 uint 类型及 Addr 字段激活，语料与触发形式分属不同模式。

patterns.name: 希腊语词内的高响应 token
patterns.context: 希腊语文本中 token «ρί» 后接续词语；在「κυρίως」「γνωρίζετε」「περί」等不同词形中出现，常位于较长词内部。

patterns.name: 代码注释或文档块结束符
patterns.context: 代码中的块注释或文档注释结束位置，通常后接空行或代码。
patterns.domain: GitHub 源代码及许可证、文档注释

patterns.name: Go 结构体字段的类型标记
patterns.context: Go struct 字段声明中，字段名后出现 uint 类型；多个相邻字段重复该类型。

patterns.name: Go 网络地址字段标识
patterns.context: RawSockaddrInet 结构体内，Addr 字段后跟定长字节数组及 in_addr 注释。

en.concept: The none substring and local word forms
en.description: Primarily responds to the none substring, covering none of, nonequilibrium, and none-classicality; also has sporadic responses to fragments within hydrodynamics, Experience, externally driven, hysteretic, downstream, spite, and gedanken, as well as one punctuation string.

patterns.name: none and negative constructions
patterns.context: Appears in negative expressions: 'In none of', 'nonequilibrium', 'none of the reports/models', 'none show', and 'none-classicality'. The trigger is the substring none across multiple meanings and syntactic contexts.

patterns.name: nonequilibrium terminology
patterns.context: none is immediately followed by quilibrium, forming nonequilibrium; contexts involve nonequilibrium properties, coupling, thermodynamic potentials, phase transitions, or Green’s functions.
patterns.domain: Academic writing in physics, materials science, active systems, and related fields

patterns.name: Hydrodynamics-related words
patterns.context: The triggered fragment is hydro; it occurs in physics contexts related to flow or dynamics. Activation also involves subword fragments of hydrodynamics.
patterns.domain: Heavy-ion physics, fluid research, and glass transition studies

patterns.name: Affix fragment in an experience word
patterns.context: Exper and ience are segmented markers that combine to form Experience; the sentence discusses experience gained through modeling.

patterns.name: Phrase for externally driven systems
patterns.context: Two consecutive marked tokens form externally driven, modifying systems.
patterns.domain: Nonequilibrium thermodynamics or systems modeling papers

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in hysteretic
patterns.context: The triggered prefix fragment is hyste in hysteretic; it occurs in the same sentence as discussion of doping suppression and chemical redox.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in downstream
patterns.context: Appears in a description of a downstream shock and reacceleration in a jet.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in spite
patterns.context: Appears in the fixed expression 'In spite of', introducing a concession despite extensive prior efforts.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in gedanken
patterns.context: Triggers the letter fragment ank in gedanken; occurs in a discussion of quantum correlations in a thought experiment.

patterns.name: Highly activating punctuation or structural marker
patterns.context: The segment begins with marked wards and a special punctuation string; the surrounding text discusses spin-valve torque. Its relationship to the main activation pattern is difficult to determine from context alone.
patterns.domain: Citations or formula typesetting in ArXiv papers

0_1543.description: 主要响应 none 子串，涵盖 none of、nonequilibrium 与 none-classicality；另对水动力学、Experience、externally driven、hysteretic、downstream、spite、gedanken 内部片段及一处标点串有零散响应。

patterns.name: none 与否定结构
patterns.context: 出现在否定表达中：'In none of'、'nonequilibrium'、'none of the reports/models'、'none show'、'none-classicality'。触发跨越多个词义和句法环境的 none 子串。

patterns.name: nonequilibrium 术语
patterns.context: none 紧接 quilibrium，构成 nonequilibrium；涉及非平衡性质、耦合、热力学势、相变或格林函数等。
patterns.domain: 物理、材料科学、主动系统等学术文体

patterns.name: 水动力学相关词
patterns.context: 触发片段 hydro；出现在 flow 或 dynamics 相关的物理语境中。激活还涉及 hydrodynamics 的子词片段。
patterns.domain: 重离子物理、流体与玻璃转变研究

patterns.name: 经验词中的词缀片段
patterns.context: Exper 与 ience 分段标记，合成 Experience；句中谈及建模所得经验。

patterns.name: 外部驱动系统短语
patterns.context: 两个连续标记词组成 externally driven，修饰 systems。
patterns.domain: 非平衡热力学或系统建模论文

patterns.name: 迟滞词内片段
patterns.context: 触发 hysteretic 的前缀片段 hyste；与掺杂抑制及化学氧化还原讨论同句。

patterns.name: 下游词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在 jet 下游激波及再加速的描述中。

patterns.name: spite 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在固定表达 'In spite of' 中，引出尽管已有大量努力的让步语境。

patterns.name: gedanken 词内片段
patterns.context: 触发 gedanken 中的字母片段 ank；处于 thought experiment 的量子相关性讨论中。

patterns.name: 高强度标点或结构性标记
patterns.context: 片段开头出现被标记的 wards 与特殊标点串，附近讨论自旋阀转矩；仅凭上下文难以确定其与主激活模式的关系。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文中的引用或公式排版

en.concept: Boundaries and identifiers in source code
en.description: The most stable shared trigger is the source-code block-comment terminator `*/`; there is also activation on file headers, declarations, identifiers, and code fragments in various languages, involving licenses, network structures, buffer handling, API documentation, and embedded functionality. No single content topic spans all passages.

patterns.name: Block-comment terminator
