patterns.domain: 天体物理、数学、粒子物理及语料中的词形片段

patterns.name: 实验材料与过程词
patterns.context: 出现在各自论文的实验或物理描述中；这些词之间没有可见的共同触发环境
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理、材料科学及实验论文

patterns.name: 数据集术语“clip(s)”
patterns.context: 描述语音数据集样本及训练、验证集划分
patterns.domain: 语音处理或机器学习论文

en.description: All snippets strongly activate on the heading “RESULTS” in the results section of a paper; a few weaker activations are scattered across nearby body-text words and heading-structure markers, with no stable independent semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Results section heading
patterns.context: An uppercase standalone heading, usually surrounded by line breaks and followed by an equals-sign separator
patterns.domain: Academic papers, especially the results sections of research papers

patterns.name: Formatting variants of the Results heading
patterns.context: Document-structure markers in Markdown or other formats follow the heading; the heading word itself remains RESULTS
patterns.domain: ArXiv or PMC structured paper text

patterns.name: Sporadic technical-term activations in body text
patterns.context: Scattered through experimental, statistical, medical, or narrative body text near the Results heading; mostly isolated, low-strength activations, with no consistent word sense or local collocation
patterns.domain: Materials science, statistical analysis, and medical and biomedical paper body text

0_1561.concept: 学术论文结果章节标题
0_1561.description: 所有片段都强烈激活于论文结果部分的标题“RESULTS”；少量较弱激活分散于邻近正文词语及标题结构标记，未见稳定的独立语义模式。

patterns.name: 结果章节标题
patterns.context: 作为大写独立标题，通常前后带换行，后接等号分隔线
patterns.domain: 学术论文，尤其是研究论文的结果部分

patterns.name: 结果标题的格式变体
patterns.context: 标题后附 Markdown/文档结构标记；标题词本身仍为 RESULTS
patterns.domain: ArXiv 或 PMC 的结构化论文文本

patterns.name: 正文中零散术语激活
patterns.context: 散布在结果标题附近的实验、统计、医学或叙述性正文中；多为单次低强度激活，未显示一致的词义或局部搭配
patterns.domain: 材料科学、统计分析、医学与生物医学论文正文

en.description: Activation is concentrated on “Results” headings marking results sections in papers and their heading dividers; it also occurs in “Results and Discussion” headings and, more weakly, on results in body text or section cross-references. The specific trigger differences are not fully explained.

patterns.name: Research paper results section heading
patterns.context: Used as a standalone section heading or anchored section heading in ArXiv papers, usually after a line break; capitalization and heading format may vary.

patterns.name: Extended results section heading
patterns.context: The results section heading is extended to “Results and Discussion”; capitalization and activation strength of Discussion vary.

patterns.name: Use of results in body text
patterns.context: results appears as an ordinary word in the body or in a cross-reference to the paper’s results section; it is not a standalone section heading.
patterns.domain: Academic paper body text and cross-references

0_1561.concept: 学术论文结果章节标记
0_1561.description: 激活主要集中在论文中表示结果章节的“Results”标题及其标题分隔符；也见于“Results and Discussion”标题，并较弱地涉及正文中的results或章节交叉引用。具体触发差异未完全解释。

patterns.name: 论文结果章节标题
patterns.context: ArXiv论文中作为独立章节标题或带锚点的章节标题，通常位于换行之后；大小写和标题格式可变
patterns.domain: 学术论文，尤其是 Markdown/Pandoc 转写的论文

patterns.name: 结果章节标题扩展
patterns.context: 结果章节标题扩展为“Results and Discussion”，Discussion大小写、激活强度有所不同

patterns.name: 正文中的 results 用词
patterns.trigger: «results»4；«Results»10 出现在«Results»等章节名的引用中
patterns.context: results作为普通正文词，或出现在指向论文结果章节的交叉引用中；不是独立章节标题
patterns.domain: 学术论文正文与交叉引用

en.description: All snippets contain a marked Results heading, usually with an underline; some snippets also mark results in body text or substrings within other words. The main pattern is recognition of paper results section headings, including their formatting.

patterns.name: Results section heading
patterns.context: Appears as a section or subsection heading in an academic paper, often accompanied by a line break and a Markdown/plain-text underline separator (e.g., «=======», «-------»); sometimes the heading includes and Discussion.

patterns.name: Heading separator line
patterns.context: Immediately follows a Results heading as a Markdown-style heading underline; this pattern relates to heading formatting, but the separator itself is also marked

patterns.name: Body-text use of results
patterns.context: Appears in lowercase in body text to refer to paper findings, or in compound expressions and cross-references, rather than as a section heading; for example, “Some of the results”“to the results”“tab:observations”
patterns.domain: Academic paper body text and cross-references

patterns.name: Split marking of the string results
patterns.context: The marked span falls within longer words or across subword fragments; this is more likely activation on local word forms/substrings in body text than an independent heading signal

0_1561.concept: 学术论文的 Results 标题
0_1561.description: 所有片段都出现被标记的 Results 标题，通常带章节下划线；部分片段还标记了正文中的 results 或其他词内子串。主模式是识别论文结果章节标题，兼及其排版格式。

patterns.name: 章节标题 Results
patterns.context: 学术论文中作为章节标题或小节标题出现，常伴随换行及 Markdown/纯文本下划线分隔符（如 «=======»、«-------»），有时标题包含 and Discussion。

patterns.name: 标题分隔线
patterns.context: 紧接 Results 标题，用于 Markdown 风格的标题下划线；此模式与标题格式相关，但分隔符本身也被标记。

patterns.name: 结果词的正文用法
patterns.context: 正文中以小写形式指论文结果，或出现在复合表达、交叉引用中，并非章节标题；例如 “Some of the results”“to the results”“tab:observations”等。
patterns.domain: 学术论文正文及交叉引用

patterns.name: results 字符串被拆分标记
patterns.context: 标记落在更长单词内部或跨接词片段；更像正文中局部词形/子串的激活，而非独立的标题信号。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to the “Results” section heading in paper structure and its formatting markers; it also responds to the word results in body text and section cross-references containing that word. All examples come from academic papers.

patterns.name: Results section heading
patterns.context: The heading “Results” or “Results and Discussion” appears in paper body text or section markers, often with a Markdown separator, section anchor, or heading formatting; activation sometimes falls on the heading word itself and sometimes on part of a token in the heading
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper section headings and structural markers

patterns.name: The word results in body text
patterns.context: Body text mentions research findings or uses “results” as an ordinary noun; it is not a section heading.

patterns.name: Results label in an in-text reference
patterns.context: The section label itself contains Results when cross-referencing a section.

0_1561.concept: 学术论文 Results 章节标记
0_1561.description: 主要对论文结构中的“Results”章节标题及其格式标记强烈反应，也会响应正文中的 results 一词和含该词的章节交叉引用；各例均来自学术论文。

patterns.name: 结果章节标题
patterns.context: 论文正文或章节标记中出现标题“Results”或“Results and Discussion”，常伴随 Markdown 分隔线、章节锚点或标题格式；激活有时落在标题词本身，有时落在标题中的 token 部分。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文的章节标题与结构标记

patterns.name: 正文中的 results 词
patterns.context: 正文提到研究结果，或以“results”作为普通名词；不是章节标题。

patterns.name: 文内引用中的 Results 标签
patterns.context: 交叉引用章节时，章节标签本身含有 Results。
patterns.domain: 学术论文的 LaTeX/Markdown 交叉引用

en.description: All snippets contain references to or headings for supplementary materials; most are biomedical papers, with crystallography also represented. Other trigger words relate respectively to results comparisons, experimental conditions, data files, protein localization, structural parameters, and clinical information.

patterns.name: Supplementary-material reference
patterns.context: The body text points to supplementary figures, tables, or materials using parentheses or links; numbering and citation markers often appear nearby.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, especially biomedical and scientific publications

patterns.name: Scientific results and sample comparisons
patterns.context: Reports experimental or clinical results and compares samples, groups, disease states, or treatment conditions; detailed results are often referenced in supplementary materials.

patterns.name: Experimental methods and reagent conditions
patterns.context: Describes observations from staining or labeling experiments and specifies reagents and reaction conditions.

patterns.name: Dataset and analysis-file descriptions
patterns.context: Explains the relationship between a dataset and existing publications, as well as raw files and analysis-output files.

patterns.name: Protein localization and tag descriptions
patterns.context: Describes colocalization between proteins and identifies protein tags or localization signals.

patterns.name: Crystallography supplementary-material heading
patterns.context: Supplementary materials begin with a heading and separator line, followed by content on crystal structures or structural parameters.

patterns.name: Crystal structure parameters
patterns.context: Lists geometric parameters in crystal-structure refinement; no obvious positive-activation trigger word is marked in this passage, and activation is adjacent to the supplementary-material heading.

patterns.name: Clinical device cohort information
patterns.context: Describes a clinical patient cohort and baseline and demographic information collected at device implantation, and cites online supplementary material.

0_1561.concept: 学术论文中的补充材料标记
0_1561.description: 所有片段都出现补充材料引用或标题；多为生物医学论文，也涵盖晶体学。其余触发词分别涉及结果比较、实验条件、数据文件、蛋白定位、结构参数和临床资料。

patterns.name: 补充材料引用
patterns.context: 正文中以括号或链接形式指向补充图、表或材料；周围常有编号和引用标记。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，尤其生物医学与科学出版物

patterns.name: 科学结果与样本比较
patterns.context: 报告实验或临床结果，并比较样本、组别、疾病状态或处理条件；常以补充材料指向详细结果。

patterns.name: 实验方法与试剂条件
patterns.context: 描述染色或标记实验的观察结果，并说明试剂和反应条件。

patterns.name: 数据集与分析文件说明
patterns.context: 说明数据集与既有出版物的关系，以及原始文件和分析输出文件。
patterns.domain: 蛋白质组学或数据资源论文

patterns.name: 蛋白定位与标签描述
patterns.context: 描述蛋白质之间的共定位，并指出蛋白标签或定位信号。

patterns.name: 晶体学补充材料标题
patterns.context: 补充材料以标题和分隔线开头，后续涉及晶体结构或结构参数。

patterns.name: 晶体结构参数
patterns.context: 列出晶体结构精修中的几何参数；本段未标出明显的正激活触发词，激活与补充材料标题相邻。

patterns.name: 临床设备队列资料
patterns.context: 描述临床患者队列、设备植入时收集的基线与人口学资料，并引用在线补充材料。

en.description: All segments contain Results headings in paper structure; a few also contain results in body text or cross-references, and heading dividers also activate.

patterns.name: Results section heading
patterns.context: Appears as a section heading or heading text in the paper body, often accompanied by a Markdown heading divider or section reference.

patterns.name: Body-text use of results
patterns.context: The lowercase form appears in descriptions of experimental or theoretical findings, rather than in a heading.

patterns.name: Heading and structural-marker co-activation
patterns.context: Markdown/formatting divider lines near Results headings also activate.

0_1561.concept: 学术论文的 Results 标题
0_1561.description: 所有段都在论文结构中出现 Results 标题；少数段还在正文或交叉引用中出现 results，标题分隔符也有激活。

patterns.name: 章节标题 Results
patterns.context: 论文正文中作为章节标题或标题文本出现，常伴随 Markdown 标题分隔符或章节引用

patterns.name: 结果一词的正文用法
patterns.context: 小写形式出现在对实验或理论结果的正文叙述中，而非标题

patterns.name: 标题及结构标记伴随模式
patterns.context: Results 标题附近的 Markdown/排版分隔线也有激活

en.description: All passages strongly activate on the word Additional, regardless of capitalization; it appears in supplementary information, materials, files, evidence, options, or table-column headings. Subsequent words and domains vary, and weaker activation patterns are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Additional information heading
patterns.context: Appears in a heading, description, or table-column label, usually followed by “Information”“Options”“evidence” or “intervention”; the shared strong trigger substring across all passages
patterns.domain: Web text, scientific papers, and tables

patterns.name: Supplementary-material description
patterns.context: “Additional supplementary materials” introduces supplementary materials, often followed by crystallographic information and file links.

patterns.name: Supplementary file link
patterns.context: “Additional file” is followed by a link marker to a supplementary file.

patterns.name: Additional as a table-column heading
patterns.context: Appears in a column heading of a clinical intervention summary table, followed by “intervention”.

patterns.name: Additional Options page heading
patterns.context: Used as an options-category heading on a CAPTCHA page, followed by “Miscellaneous Options”.

patterns.name: Additional Information game entry
patterns.context: A supplementary-information subheading following a game skill description.

patterns.name: Additional evidence paper phrasing
patterns.context: The phrase “Additional evidence” appears in a paper discussion preceded by discussion of sparsity and separation performance.

0_1561.description: 所有段均强烈激活于大小写为 Additional 的词；它出现在补充信息、材料、文件、证据、选项或表格列标题中。后续词与领域多样，弱激活模式不一致。

patterns.name: Additional 信息标题
patterns.context: 出现在标题、说明或表格列名中，通常后接“Information”“Options”“evidence”或“intervention”等；是所有段落共同的强触发子串。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、科学论文及表格

patterns.name: 补充材料说明
patterns.context: “Additional supplementary materials”用于引出补充材料，常跟随晶体学信息及文件链接。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及晶体学论文

patterns.name: 补充文件链接
patterns.context: “Additional file”后带有指向补充文件的链接标记。

patterns.name: Additional 作表格列标题
patterns.context: 位于临床干预汇总表的列标题中，后接“intervention”。
patterns.domain: 外周血管手术论文表格

patterns.name: Additional Options 页面标题
patterns.context: 验证码页面中作为选项类别标题，后接“Miscellaneous Options”。

patterns.name: Additional Information 游戏条目
patterns.context: 游戏技能描述之后作为补充信息小标题。

patterns.name: Additional evidence 论文表述
patterns.context: 作为论文论述中的“Additional evidence”短语，前文讨论稀疏性及分离性能。

en.description: All passages contain strongly marked Results, most commonly as a paper section heading, often underlined or followed by body text; a few are combined headings or words in figure captions or cross-references, and lowercase results also appears. Activation does not depend on a specific research field.

patterns.name: Results section heading
patterns.context: Appears as a standalone heading or at the beginning of a heading; it may also occur in figure captions, cross-references, or other non-heading positions.

patterns.name: Section content following a Results heading
patterns.context: After the section heading, the content shifts to results, discussion, or a subsequent section; some examples use the heading «Results and Discussion».
patterns.domain: Academic paper formatting and section organization

patterns.name: Results as an ordinary body-text word
patterns.context: Not a section heading in the current document, but part of a figure caption, reference, or section cross-reference.
patterns.domain: Academic paper body text, figure captions, and references

patterns.name: Combined Results and Discussion heading
patterns.context: The heading combines results and discussion; capitalization varies.

patterns.name: Ordinary results-related word forms
patterns.context: Appears in ordinary sentences to refer to research findings rather than Results in a heading.

patterns.name: Formatting markers in a Results heading
patterns.context: Repeated symbols immediately follow a standalone Results heading to mark the heading level; they are not semantic body text.

0_1561.description: 所有段都含有被强烈标记的 Results，最常见的是论文章节标题，常带下划线或接正文；少数是合并标题、图注或交叉引用中的词，也出现小写 results。激活不依赖具体研究领域。

patterns.name: 章节标题 Results
patterns.context: 作为独立标题或标题开头；也可能出现在图注、交叉引用等非标题位置。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文的 Markdown/类 Markdown 章节结构

patterns.name: Results 标题后的章节内容
patterns.trigger: «Results»10 后接换行、标题下划线或正文
patterns.context: 章节标题结束后转入结果、讨论或后续章节内容；部分样例标题是 «Results and Discussion»。
patterns.domain: 学术论文排版与章节组织

patterns.name: Results 作为普通正文词
patterns.trigger: «Results» 出现在句内或图注中，例如 “gFact«Results»10” 和 “\[SEC:«Results»10\]”
patterns.context: 不是当前文档的章节标题，而是图注、文献或章节交叉引用的一部分。
patterns.domain: 学术论文正文、图注和引用

patterns.name: Results 与 Discussion 联合标题
patterns.context: 标题把结果与讨论合并；词语大小写并不固定。

patterns.name: 结果相关普通词形
patterns.context: 出现在普通句子中，指研究结果，而非标题中的 Results。

patterns.name: Results 标题中的格式标记
patterns.context: 紧随独立的 Results 标题，用重复符号标记标题层级；不是语义正文。

en.concept: Results section markers in academic papers
en.description: The strongest and most consistent trigger across passages is “Results” in paper headings or section cross-references; a few body-text words also activate, without a consistent semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Results heading
patterns.context: Appears as a section or subsection heading in paper body text, usually on a separate line and followed by a Markdown heading line or section content; includes the Results part of Results and Discussion headings.

patterns.name: Results cross-reference
patterns.context: The body text uses a labeled bracketed reference to the paper’s Results section rather than a heading.

patterns.name: Other local activations
patterns.context: Appear in ordinary body text in several scientific paper sentences, near Results headings or references, but show no stable shared semantic trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Academic body text in physics, astronomy, materials science, and other fields

0_1561.concept: 学术论文中的 Results 章节标记
0_1561.description: 最强且跨段稳定的触发是论文中标题或章节交叉引用里的“Results”；另有少量正文词语激活，缺乏统一语义模式。

patterns.name: Results 标题
patterns.context: 论文正文中作为章节标题或小节标题出现，通常单独成行，后接 Markdown 标题线或章节内容；包括 Results and Discussion 标题中 Results 部分。

patterns.name: Results 交叉引用
patterns.context: 正文中以带标签的方括号引用论文的 Results 章节，而非标题。

patterns.name: 其他局部激活
patterns.context: 出现在若干科学论文句子的普通正文中，与 Results 标题或引用相邻，但未见稳定的共同语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 物理、天文学、材料科学等学术正文

en.description: All segments contain a Results section heading or a marker related to the results section; other activations are spread across disciplinary terms, body-text vocabulary, and formatting markers, and are difficult to group into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Results section heading
patterns.context: Results section heading in the paper body, commonly in Markdown/text-extraction format; sometimes the heading is “Results and Discussion”, or Results occurs in a section cross-reference.

patterns.name: Results-related phrasing
patterns.context: The paragraph reports, introduces, or cross-references research results; apart from headings, activation words are scattered across results paragraphs or citations, with no unified lexical pattern observed.

patterns.name: Sporadic domain-vocabulary activations
patterns.context: Each word activates only near specific research content, terminology, literature markers, or table markers; they show no clear shared local semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Various fields, including mathematics, physics, materials science, speech, astronomy, and document markers

0_1561.concept: 论文 Results 章节标记
0_1561.description: 所有片段都含 Results 章节标题或结果章节相关标记；其余激活分散在不同学科术语、正文词汇及排版标记中，难以归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: 章节标题 Results
patterns.context: 论文正文中 Results 章节标题，常见 Markdown/文本抽取格式；有时标题为“Results and Discussion”，或 Results 出现在章节交叉引用中。

patterns.name: 结果相关表述
patterns.context: 段落正在报告、引出或交叉引用研究结果；除标题外的激活词分散在结果段落或引用中，未见统一的词法模式。

patterns.name: 零散领域词汇激活
patterns.context: 各词只在特定研究内容、术语、文献标记或表格标记附近激活；彼此未呈现明显共同的局部语义条件。
patterns.domain: 数学、物理、材料、语音、天文学及文档标记等不同领域

en.description: All snippets contain results section headings or results-related body text; the most stable shared cue is the Results heading and its marked structure. Several scattered body-text words, proper-name fragments, and formula symbols also activate, without a consistent semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Paper results section heading
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a new section or subsection, often with a Markdown heading separator, numbering, or cross-reference; capitalization varies
patterns.domain: ArXiv papers and their Markdown/converted text

patterns.name: Ordinary use of results in body text
patterns.context: results appears in sentence body text, heading cross-references, or figure/table labels, and does not necessarily indicate a section heading
patterns.domain: Academic paper body text and cross-references

patterns.name: Formatting structure around results headings
patterns.context: Adjacent to a results section heading or located in tables and figure-caption markers near a results section; the trigger may be the marker symbols themselves or the heading structure

patterns.name: Local academic phrasing in results sections
patterns.context: These words are marked in the contexts of results sections in different papers; there is no evidence that they share a uniform local semantic condition. Some may be incidental co-occurrences or subword fragments
patterns.domain: Cross-disciplinary academic papers: molecular dynamics, magnetism, graphene, speech recognition, particle physics, astrophysics, and theoretical physics

patterns.name: Substring within a proper name
patterns.context: Located within an author name or proper name in astronomy time-delay literature, not as an independent word

patterns.name: Mathematical symbol fragment in a formula

en.description: The core response word is signed (also sign): used for signing agreements, contracts, treaties, bills, and medical records; also appears in signed up for registration or subscription. It is not limited to affirmative or negative contexts, or to completed versus pending signatures.

patterns.name: Signing business/international agreements
patterns.context: An agreement, acquisition, or partnership arrangement appears as the object; includes both agreements about to be signed and those already signed.
patterns.domain: Corporate news, energy, and international cooperation

patterns.name: Signing status of legal contracts
patterns.context: A contract or proposed contract is signed, unsigned, or attributed to a signer; the context often involves parties, lawyers, and contract disputes.

patterns.name: Treaty or member-state commitment
patterns.context: An international organization or member state is the subject, joining or signing a commitment; the document is not explicitly named in the passage.

patterns.name: Bill signed into law
patterns.context: A bill is signed by a governor after passing through the legislature, and subsequently takes effect.

patterns.name: Signing medical records
patterns.context: A doctor is the signer of a medical history or medical record.

patterns.name: Registration or subscription
patterns.context: The phrase “signed up for” means that a user registered for or subscribed to a service, rather than signing a physical document.

patterns.name: Accompanying sporadic subword-fragment activations
patterns.context: These fragments occur sporadically in different passages and do not show a consistent cross-passage semantic condition of their own; they may be incidental activations within passages and do not establish another stable pattern.

0_1719.description: 核心响应词是 signed（另有 sign）：用于协议、合同、条约、法案和医疗记录的签署，也见于 signed up 的注册订阅；不限制肯定或否定、已签或待签。

en.concept: Upload substring and sporadic formula notation

0_1940.description: 所有片段都激活于 coordinator 一词；其指涉随语境变化，包括能源调度、软件组件、体育教练、研究人员、行政负责人及标准协调机构。

patterns.name: coordinator 词的直接触发
patterns.context: 核心触发词是 coordinator；出现在不同句法位置，常指负责协调或管理的人，也可作为软件中的对象、属性或变量名。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：邮件、代码、新闻、医学、标准文件

patterns.name: 能源业务协调员
patterns.context: Enron 相关业务语境中，指有权使用设施或承担调度协调职责的实体。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件、能源业务法律或合同文本

patterns.name: 软件协调器对象
patterns.context: 代码中作为类名或变量名，指协调 epoch、交易或应用流程的程序组件；周围可见 EpochCoordinator、SendPaxCoordinator 等标识符。

patterns.name: 体育教练职位
patterns.context: 与球队、head coach、进攻或特勤组等词共现，指教练团队中的协调员职位。

patterns.name: 研究项目协调员
patterns.context: 研究或临床研究组织中，指负责研究执行、参与者或跨机构协调的人员。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、研究管理文件

patterns.name: 行政区域协调员
patterns.context: 与分区、州、地方政府及办公室层级相连，指区域或州级负责人。

patterns.name: 标准制定协调机构
patterns.context: 与 ANSI、clearing house、national standards 等词共现，描述组织在国家标准体系中的协调角色。
patterns.domain: 专利背景或标准化文件

en.description: The strongest and most consistent trigger is the founder identity word “founder,” especially in the hyphenated form “co-founder,” including line-break splits; contexts usually introduce a person and their company, position, or entrepreneurial experience. The word also appears in segment 1, but the activation marker falls on “founder”.

patterns.name: Compound word co-founder
patterns.context: The hyphenated prefix “co-” precedes “founder,” sometimes separated by a line break; appears in descriptions of a person's identity or byline.
patterns.domain: Startups, technology and business coverage, biographies

patterns.name: Introduction of founder identity
patterns.context: Identifies someone as a co-founder of an organization, company, or project; includes position formats such as “co-founder & CTO”.
patterns.domain: Business coverage, technology forums, events, and company descriptions

0_1940.description: 最强且一致的触发是创始人身份词“founder”，尤其是连字符形式“co-founder”，包括跨行拆分；上下文多为介绍人物与其公司、职位或创业经历。第1段也出现该词，但激活标记落在“founder”上。

patterns.name: co-founder 复合词
patterns.context: “founder”前有连字符前缀“co-”，有时因换行分开；出现在人物身份或署名介绍中。
patterns.domain: 创业公司、科技与商业报道、人物介绍

patterns.name: 创始人身份介绍
patterns.context: 将某人标为组织、公司或项目的共同创始人；包括“co-founder & CTO”等职位格式。
patterns.domain: 商业报道、科技论坛、活动与公司介绍

en.description: All fragments activate on founder in the word “co-founder”, across contexts involving technology companies, business figures, coffee brands, media, and event organizers. The neuron appears to identify the co-founder title rather than a specific industry.

patterns.name: Founder title
patterns.context: Appears in “co-founder”, usually referring to a company’s or organization’s co-founder; sometimes split across a line break as “co-↵«founder»”.
patterns.domain: Startups, technology, business reporting, and biographies

0_1940.description: 所有片段都在“co-founder”一词的 founder 上激活，涉及科技公司、商业人物、咖啡品牌、媒体及活动组织等语境；神经元似乎识别联合创始人称谓，而非特定行业。

patterns.name: 创始人称谓
patterns.context: 出现在“co-founder”中，通常指公司或组织的联合创始人；有时被换行拆分为“co-↵«founder»”。
patterns.domain: 创业公司、科技行业、商业报道及人物介绍

en.description: All segments strongly activate on founder within the designation “co-founder”; contexts include entrepreneurs' first-person accounts, company descriptions, and business event coverage. Domains and styles vary, but the trigger word is consistent.

patterns.name: Co-founder designation
patterns.context: Appears in “co-founder,” denoting someone who jointly founded an organization; may refer to the speaker or a person being introduced, often followed by a name, position, or company
patterns.domain: Startups, technology companies, and business coverage/forum discussions

0_1940.description: 所有段落都在“co-founder”称谓中强烈激活 founder；上下文涵盖创业者自述、公司介绍及商业活动报道，领域和文体各异，但触发词一致。

patterns.name: 联合创始人称谓
patterns.context: 出现在表示共同创办者的“co-founder”中；可指代说话者本人或被介绍的人，常接姓名、职位或所属公司
patterns.domain: 创业、科技公司及商业报道/论坛讨论

en.description: Strong activation falls on the letter sequence orers, across different words such as laborers, book-borers, restorers, and snorers. It commonly occurs at the end of plural agent nouns; specific meanings and domains vary widely.

patterns.name: Laborers in legal corpora
patterns.context: Appears at the end of laborers, often referring to workers in labor, union, or public works contexts; capitalization varies, and the stem lab- is unmarked
patterns.domain: Legal judgments; also historical descriptions of labor

patterns.name: Book borers
patterns.context: Appears in a compound describing insects that bore into books

patterns.name: Restorers in organization names
patterns.context: Appears in the name of a nongovernmental organization, referring to people who restore things

patterns.name: Snorers
patterns.context: Appears in medical descriptions of sleep apnea, snoring symptoms, or anti-snoring devices; strong activation falls on the end of a plural agent noun

patterns.name: Workers in a fantasy setting
patterns.context: Refers to ordinary workers in an agricultural community, without a fantasy identity

0_1940.description: 强激活都落在 orers 这一字母串上：涵盖 laborers、book-borers、restorers、snorers 等不同词，常见于复数施事名词末尾；具体语义与领域差异很大。

patterns.name: 法律语料中的 laborers
patterns.trigger: «Lab»? 原文实际触发片段为 «orers»10（如 lab«orers»10、Lab«orers»10）
patterns.context: 出现在 laborers 一词末尾，常指劳动者、工会或公共工程中的工人；大小写不定，词干 lab- 未标记
patterns.domain: 法律判决；另有历史劳动描述

patterns.name: 书籍蛀虫
patterns.context: 出现在描述蛀书虫的复合词中

patterns.name: 组织名称中的 restorers
patterns.context: 出现在非政府组织名称中，指修复人员
patterns.domain: 百科条目、机构名称列表

patterns.name: 打鼾者
patterns.context: 出现在睡眠呼吸暂停、打鼾症状或止鼾装置的医学描述中；强激活落在复数施事名词末尾

patterns.name: 奇幻设定中的劳工
patterns.context: 指农业社区中普通、无奇幻身份的劳动者
patterns.domain: 奇幻小说设定或社区介绍

en.description: All segments strongly activate on the word ending -orers, covering laborers, borers, snorers, and restorers; meanings and domains vary considerably. laborers is most common in legal texts, while similar forms such as snore and snoring activate only weakly.

patterns.name: Occupational or agent nouns containing -orers
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending of English nouns ending in -orers; in legal texts it is often lab«orers», while other corpora include book borers and people who snore.
patterns.domain: Law, historical narrative, fantasy/popular writing, encyclopedias, medical abstracts

patterns.name: laborers in legal texts
patterns.context: laborers appears in discussions of labor organizations, unions, construction projects, public works bonds, or related cases; activation concentrates on the ending of laborers.
patterns.domain: U.S. court decisions and legal citations

patterns.name: Historical term for workers
patterns.context: Appears in comparisons of working hours across historical periods, outside legal discussion.

patterns.name: Workers in a fantasy setting
patterns.context: Describes an agricultural community, using laborers for ordinary, unremarkable workers, contrasted with a fantasy setting involving a hidden prince or princess.

patterns.name: Book borers
patterns.context: Discusses insects that bore into books and their larvae; the word ending has a similar segmentation to laborers, but its meaning is unrelated to labor.

patterns.name: Snorers
patterns.context: snorer appears in research on sleep apnea symptoms or anti-snoring devices; activation falls on the -orers ending of snorers, while snoring and snore have only weak markers.

patterns.name: Compound word ending in an organization name
patterns.context: In the name of a European restorers' organization, activation falls on the ending of restorers; it shares spelling with laborers and snorers, but differs in meaning and context.

0_1940.description: 所有段都在词尾 -orers 上强激活，覆盖 laborers、borers、snorers、restorers；语义与领域差异很大，法律中的 laborers 最常见，snore、snoring 等近形词仅弱激活。

patterns.name: 含 -orers 的职业或施事名词
patterns.context: 激活部分落在以 -orers 结尾的英语名词词尾；在法律文本中多为 lab«orers»，其他语料中也有书籍蛀虫和打鼾者。
patterns.domain: 法律、历史叙述、奇幻/通俗文字、百科、医学摘要

patterns.name: 法律文本中的 laborers
patterns.trigger: «Wis»1consin Lab«orers»10 District；Construction Lab«orers»10；« lab«orers»10 and material«men»2；Lab«orers»10' Int'l Union
patterns.context: 劳工组织、工会、建筑工程、公共工程担保或相关判例讨论中出现 laborers；激活集中在 laborers 的词尾。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决与法律引文

patterns.name: 历史劳动者称谓
patterns.context: 比较历史时期劳动者的工作时长时出现，非法律论述。

patterns.name: 奇幻设定中的劳动者
patterns.context: 农耕社区的描述中以 laborers 指普通、平淡的劳动者，与隐藏王子/公主的幻想设定相对。

patterns.name: 书籍蛀虫
patterns.context: 讨论会蛀书的昆虫及其幼虫；词尾切分与 laborers 相似，但语义不是劳动者。

patterns.name: 打鼾者
patterns.context: 睡眠呼吸暂停症状或防打鼾设备研究中出现 snorer；激活落在 snorers 的 -orers 词尾，而 snoring、snore 只有较弱标记。

patterns.name: 组织名称中的复合词尾
patterns.context: 欧洲修复师组织名称中，激活落在 restorers 的词尾；与 laborers、snorers 等共享字形，但语义和语境不同。

en.description: All fragments activate in consumer-related contexts, with consumers as the core trigger. The groups referred to are associated with prices, goods and services, consumer rights, fraud, payment, market supply, or purchasing behavior.

patterns.name: Consumers as affected parties
patterns.context: Consumers are the group affected by a policy, legal dispute, business practice, or market condition, or are the protected parties or purchasers.

patterns.name: Consumer-related objects or markets
patterns.context: The surrounding context involves consumer goods or services, prices, payments, intellectual property, fraud, or sales; the specific context may be positive or negative.
patterns.domain: Energy policy, the European Parliament, court judgments, technology, and consumer commentary

0_1940.description: 所有片段均在消费者相关语境中激活，核心触发词是 consumers；其所指群体涉及价格、商品服务、权益保护、欺诈、支付、市场供给或购买行为。

patterns.name: 消费者作为受影响者
patterns.context: 消费者是某种政策、法律争议、商业行为或市场状况的受影响群体、受保护对象或购买者。

patterns.name: 消费者相关对象或市场
patterns.context: 周围涉及面向消费者的商品、服务、价格、支付、知识产权、欺诈或销售；具体语境可正可负。
patterns.domain: 能源政策、欧盟议会、法院判决、科技与消费评论

en.description: All fragments activate near the consumer/consumers word forms, with especially stable concentration on umers in the split spelling « Cons»«umers»; singular and plural forms, capitalization variants, and generic or organization-name contexts all occur.

patterns.name: Consumers subword boundary
patterns.context: High activation concentrates on umers in the two space-separated parts Cons and umers; the preceding Cons is often capitalized, together forming Consumers. Occurs in legal, review, email, patent, and other texts.

patterns.name: consumer(s) variants
patterns.context: The same root appears as lowercase singular or uppercase singular, without a clear Cons/umers subword boundary; related contexts still refer to consumers or consumer groups.
patterns.domain: News reviews, legal and policy emails, patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Consumer as part of an organization name
patterns.context: Consumer(s) is part of an organization name rather than a generic reference to consumers; activation still falls on the ending umers.

patterns.name: Consumers referring generically to consumers
patterns.context: Consumers as a plural group appear as sentence subjects or affiliated groups, in discussions of their awareness, responsibility, preferences, electricity use, or device use.
patterns.domain: Online reviews, news emails, patent backgrounds

0_1940.description: 所有片段都在 consumer/consumers 词形附近激活，尤其稳定集中于被拆分书写的 « Cons»«umers» 中的 umers；单复数、大小写及泛指或机构名语境均有出现。

patterns.name: Consumers 的分词边界
patterns.context: 高激活集中在被空格分开的 Cons 与 umers 两部分中的 umers；前面的 Cons 常大写，整体组成 Consumers。出现在法律、评论、邮件、专利等多种文本中。

patterns.name: consumer(s) 的变体
patterns.context: 同一词根以小写单数或大写单数出现，但没有明显的 Cons/umers 分词边界；相关上下文仍指消费者或消费者团体。
patterns.domain: 新闻评论、法律与政策邮件、专利背景

patterns.name: Consumer 作为组织名组成部分
patterns.context: Consumer(s) 是机构名称的一部分，而非泛指消费者；激活仍落在词尾 umers 上。

patterns.name: Consumers 泛指消费者
patterns.context: 复数消费者作为句子主语或所属群体，讨论其意识、责任、偏好、用电或设备使用。
patterns.domain: 网络评论、新闻邮件、专利背景

en.description: All fragments activate on investors, in contexts involving financial markets, investor risks and performance, corporate financing and capital relationships, as well as investor classification policies and specific contexts such as real estate investors.

patterns.name: Investor group label
patterns.context: The word form investors appears in discussions of markets, stocks, corporate financing, legal allegations, or policy; the context typically treats them as people participating in investment or capital arrangements.
patterns.domain: Finance, business, legal, and internet discussion

patterns.name: Investment risk and market performance
patterns.context: Investors are associated with market volatility, stock or bank performance, investment strategies, and risk.

patterns.name: Corporate financing and capital transactions
patterns.context: A company or project seeks funding or arranges investment, or the discussion concerns corporate structure, acquisitions, or the relationship between investors and the board.
patterns.domain: Startups, corporate governance, business, and law

patterns.name: Investor classification and access policies
patterns.context: Discusses securities regulation and the eligibility, investment opportunities, or market access of different investor groups.

patterns.name: Participants in specific asset markets
patterns.context: Investors are specifically identified as real estate investors and connected with opportunities in the UK market and sellers’ circumstances.

0_1940.description: 所有片段都在 investors 上激活，涉及金融市场、投资者风险与表现、公司融资和资本关系，也包括投资者分类政策及房地产投资者等具体语境。

patterns.name: 投资者群体称谓

patterns.domain: 金融、商业、法律及网络讨论

patterns.name: 投资风险与市场表现
patterns.context: 投资者与市场波动、股票或银行表现、投资策略及风险相关联。

patterns.name: 公司融资与资本运作
patterns.trigger: «raise» enough … cash from «investors»；«finance» … with the major «investors»；«Corp» … get «investors»；«board» and «investors»
patterns.context: 公司或项目寻求资金、安排投资，或讨论公司结构、收购及投资者与董事会的关系。
patterns.domain: 创业、公司治理、商业与法律

patterns.name: 投资者分类与准入政策
patterns.context: 讨论证券监管及不同投资者群体的资格、投资机会或市场准入。

patterns.name: 特定资产市场参与者
patterns.context: 投资者被具体限定为房地产投资者，并与英国市场机会及卖方处境相联系。

en.description: Activation concentrates on the word consumer and its singular form, especially consumers as parties to market transactions, buyers, or groups needing protection; contexts span legal, policy, business, and technology discussions.

patterns.name: Consumers as purchasers of goods or services
patterns.context: Consumers are the parties who buy or use goods or services, often appearing in discussions of transactions, payments, markets, or products
patterns.domain: Legal, policy, business, and technology discussions

patterns.name: Consumer protection and victim contexts
patterns.context: Consumers are described as a group needing protection or potentially affected by fraud or infringement
patterns.domain: Legal rulings, regulatory texts, and EU policy texts

patterns.name: Sales or market supply aimed at consumers
patterns.context: Discusses businesses providing products, services, or payment methods to consumers, or selling products to them

0_1940.description: 激活集中在消费者一词及其单数形式，尤其是消费者作为市场交易对象、购买者或需受保护群体；语境横跨法律、政策、商业与科技讨论。

patterns.name: 消费者作为商品或服务购买者

patterns.name: 消费者保护与受害者语境

patterns.name: 面向消费者的销售或市场供给
patterns.context: 谈及企业向消费者提供产品、服务、支付方式，或把产品卖给消费者

en.description: The strongest response is to the word consumers. Contexts include consumer protection, litigation and rights, as well as purchasing goods and services, payment, market sales, and consumption behavior. The corpus spans legal, policy, business, and internet discussion.

patterns.name: Consumers as transaction participants
patterns.context: Consumers appear in contexts involving the purchase or use of goods or services, payment, market sales, or consumer protection; [1] also concerns electricity consumers and price certainty

0_1940.description: 对 consumers 一词反应最强：语境涵盖消费者保护、诉讼与权利，也包括购买商品服务、支付、市场销售和消费行为；语料横跨法律、政策、商业及网络讨论。

en.description: The most stable trigger is subscribers, present across all fragments; subscriber, subscription, and split word forms also occur in subscription contexts. A few neighboring words activate sporadically, with no confirmed shared pattern.

patterns.name: Prefix adjacent to subscribers
patterns.context: The word itself is marked as the strongest activation; preceding text may include modifiers such as “community for,” “paying,” or “one hundred and fifty,” and it may appear mid-sentence or at the end.
patterns.domain: Subscription services, publishing, communications, gaming, and business texts

patterns.name: Singular subscriber variant
patterns.context: The singular form appears in a description of subscribers having multiple roles.

patterns.name: Nearby subscription word form
patterns.context: Occurs with fee in a patent background describing how users gain access to a voice messaging system; the activation token is subscribers, not subscription.

patterns.name: sub as an internal subword fragment
patterns.context: The term news site is split into sub and scription; the immediately following subscribers is marked, possibly due to subscription semantics or word form.

patterns.name: Other activated words adjacent to subscribers
patterns.context: These marked words occur in a few fragments and concern event promotions, basketball games, gaming, code, advertising, text-message subscriptions, or customer-service privacy; they do not recur consistently across fragments and are mostly adjacent to core subscriber contexts.
patterns.domain: Emails, patents, games, code, news, and customer service texts

0_1940.description: 最稳定的触发是 subscribers，覆盖全部片段；subscriber、subscription 及拆分词形也出现于订阅语境。少数相邻词激活零散，无法确认是同一规律。

patterns.name: subscribers 紧邻前缀
patterns.context: 该词本身被标记为最强激活；前文可有“community for”“paying”“one hundred and fifty”等修饰，也可位于句中或句末。
patterns.domain: 订阅服务、出版、通信、游戏及商业文本

patterns.name: 单数 subscriber 变体
patterns.context: 单数形式出现在订户拥有多个角色的说明中。

patterns.name: subscription 词形邻近
patterns.context: 与 fee 连用，出现在说明用户如何获得语音消息系统访问权的专利背景中；激活 token 是 subscribers，而非 subscription。

patterns.name: sub 作为词内分片
patterns.context: news site 一词被拆分为 sub 与 scription；紧接着的 subscribers 被标记，可能与订阅语义或词形有关。

en.concept: Source Code Comment Separators and Documentation Markers
en.description: Strongly responds to slash-based comment markers and separators in source code, especially /// documentation comments and the descriptions that follow; common in file headers, C# namespace documentation sections, and Swift/Objective-C code block markers, sometimes accompanied by copyright, license, or disclaimer text.

patterns.name: Repeated Comment Slashes
patterns.context: At the start of comments or documentation comments in code, often before file headers, member descriptions, or method descriptions; slash separators sometimes directly precede copyright or disclaimer text
patterns.domain: Source and documentation comments in multiple languages

patterns.name: Documentation Comment Marker

patterns.name: Copyright and License Header

patterns.name: C# Namespace Documentation Comment
patterns.context: Near a namespace declaration and braces in a C# file, followed by an XML documentation comment

patterns.name: Objective-C Method Block Marker

patterns.name: General Slash Comments in Code
patterns.context: Ordinary line comments in source code, possibly describing a member block or copyright information; XML documentation structure is not required

0_1940.concept: 源码注释分隔与文档标记

patterns.domain: 多种语言的源码注释与文档注释

patterns.name: 版权与许可头部

patterns.name: 代码中的一般斜线注释

en.concept: Slash comment markers in code and markup
en.description: Primarily responds strongly to the double-slash sequence “//”: this includes both code comments and HTML declarations or slashes in garbled text. Also responds to the Java documentation comment opener “/**”; the commonality is that slashes form comment or markup symbols.

patterns.name: Double-slash comment opener
patterns.context: Appears at the start of double-slash comments in code or documents; the following content may be ordinary explanation, labels, or comment text.
patterns.domain: Github source code, configuration, and documentation

patterns.name: Double slashes in an HTML declaration
patterns.context: Located in the PUBLIC identifier of an HTML doctype declaration, as part of a W3C identifier rather than a code comment.

patterns.name: Slashes in anomalous or corrupted text
patterns.context: Appears in hard-to-read, possibly garbled or malformed text; no identifiable comment or markup context.

patterns.name: Javadoc documentation comment
patterns.context: At the start of a documentation comment before a Java method, followed by @see, a method description, and @Override.

0_1940.concept: 代码与标记中的斜线注释符

patterns.name: 双斜线注释起始符

patterns.name: 异常或损坏文本中的斜线

patterns.name: Javadoc 文档注释
patterns.context: 位于 Java 方法前的文档注释开头，后接 @see、方法说明及 @Override。

en.description: Activation is concentrated on the double slash “//”: primarily a code comment prefix, but also found in path-like fragments and double slashes in HTML DOCTYPE identifiers.

patterns.name: Double-Slash Comment Prefix
patterns.context: Double slashes appear in code or documentation as a comment prefix; what follows may be a description, copyright notice, or license information

patterns.name: Double Slash in HTML DOCTYPE
patterns.context: Appears in a DOCTYPE public identifier as part of the identifier text, not as a code comment

0_1940.description: 激活集中于双斜线“//”：主要是代码注释起始符，也包括路径样式片段和 HTML DOCTYPE 标识符中的双斜线。

There is also sporadic activation on Go/CGo fragments, code identifiers, and a few ordinary words, with no unified semantics.

patterns.context: The comment marker is followed by system call descriptions, newline hints, license identifiers, or copyright information.

patterns.name: Path- or URL-Like Slash Sequences

patterns.name: Go-Related Identifiers

patterns.name: Code Keyword and Identifier Fragments

0_1940.concept: 代码中的双斜杠及邻近词片段
0_1940.description: 激活最稳定地落在代码中的双斜杠“//”，尤其是注释起始符，也见于HTML声明和噪声文本；此外还零散激活Go/CGo词片段、代码标识符及少量普通词，缺乏统一语义。

patterns.name: 双斜杠注释起始符

patterns.name: 代码注释中的特定内容

patterns.name: 路径或网址样式的斜杠序列

patterns.name: Go 相关标识符

patterns.name: 代码关键字与标识符片段

patterns.name: 其他局部词片段
patterns.context: 代码局部变量、普通英文词或被切分的解析函数名，未显示稳定的共同上下文。

patterns.name: HTML 声明标记
patterns.context: 位于文档开头的 HTML doctype 声明。

en.description: Activation is most consistently associated with comment/declaration boundaries, especially // in code, and also with /** documentation comments and <!DOCTYPE; there are also license comments and several unexplained within-word fragments.

patterns.name: Code Comment Prefix
patterns.context: A double slash appears as a comment prefix, possibly followed by documentation, a description, or code-generation information.

patterns.name: C-Style Documentation Comment Prefix

patterns.name: Angle-Bracket Exclamation Marker

patterns.name: Comment Content Markers in Code
patterns.context: Copyright, license, and SPDX identifiers are declared in comments.
patterns.domain: Source code license and copyright headers

patterns.name: Code Descriptions in Comments
patterns.context: A short implementation or behavior description follows the double slash.

patterns.name: Unclear Within-Word Fragments
patterns.context: The marker occurs inside incomplete, garbled, or ordinary identifiers, and the context does not establish a distinct semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: Legal text fragments and identifiers in multiple programming languages

0_1940.concept: 代码注释与标记起始符
0_1940.description: 激活最稳定地对应注释/声明边界，尤其是代码中的 //，也见于 /** 文档注释和 <!DOCTYPE；另有许可证注释及若干无法解释的词内片段。

patterns.name: C风格文档注释起始符

patterns.name: 尖括号感叹号标记
patterns.context: HTML 文档类型声明开头，后接 DOCTYPE。

patterns.name: 代码中的注释内容标记
patterns.context: 注释中声明版权、许可证及 SPDX 标识符。

patterns.name: 注释中的代码说明
patterns.context: 双斜线后接简短实现说明或行为注释。

patterns.name: 不明确的词内片段
patterns.context: 标记落在残缺、乱码或普通标识符内部，无法从上下文确定独立语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 法律文本片段与多种代码标识符

en.description: Primarily activates on consecutive double slashes «//»: these most often appear as line-comment prefixes in GitHub source code, and also in HTML DOCTYPE identifiers and a noisy legal-text passage; other marked tokens are scattered and show no stable shared pattern.

patterns.name: Double-Slash Comment Prefix
patterns.context: Two consecutive slashes occur in source code or markup fragments, often as a line-comment prefix; in [1], they appear in a mixed character sequence, so their function is uncertain.

patterns.name: Double Slash in HTML DOCTYPE
patterns.context: Appears in the public identifier of an HTML 4 document type declaration as part of URL/identifier syntax, not as a comment.

patterns.name: Other Marked Source Tokens
patterns.context: These words or fragments are scattered across different code contexts, with no recurring shared trigger substring other than the double slash; activation may involve word fragments, punctuation, or code formatting.
patterns.domain: Mixed-language source code, license headers, documentation comments, and a legal text passage

0_1940.description: 主要对连续双斜杠 «//» 激活：它多出现在 GitHub 源码的行注释起始，也见于 HTML doctype 标识符及一段噪声法律文本；其余标记词分散且无稳定共同规律。

patterns.name: 双斜杠注释起始
patterns.context: 两个连续斜杠出现在源码或标记语言片段中，常作为行注释起始；[1] 中它位于混杂字符序列内，作用不确定。

patterns.name: HTML doctype 中的双斜杠
patterns.context: 出现在 HTML 4 文档类型声明的公共标识符中，是 URL/标识符语法的一部分，而非注释。

patterns.name: 其他被标记的源码 token
patterns.context: 这些词或碎片分散在不同代码语境中，没有一个除双斜杠外反复出现的共同触发子串；激活可能涉及词形碎片、标点或代码格式。
patterns.domain: 混合编程语言源码、许可证头、文档注释及一段法律文本

en.description: The most stable cue is the double slash // in source code or markup text, usually as a comment opener; it also occurs in HTML public identifiers. A few subword fragments appear sporadically and are difficult to explain within the main pattern.

patterns.name: Double-slash comment opener
patterns.context: Double slashes appear in code or markup, often as a comment opener; they may also be embedded in the public identifier of an HTML doctype.

patterns.name: Slashes in an HTML public identifier
patterns.context: Appears in the public identifier of an HTML 4 document type declaration, not as a comment.

patterns.name: Sporadic code subword fragments
patterns.context: These subword fragments each occur in different code identifiers or syntax structures; beyond co-occurring with double slashes, they show no clear shared trigger.
patterns.domain: Legal texts and source code in multiple programming languages

0_1940.description: 最稳定的线索是源码或标记文本中的双斜杠 //，多作注释起始符；另有 HTML 公共标识中的 //。少数词片段分散出现，难与主模式统一解释。

patterns.name: 双斜杠注释起始符
patterns.context: 代码或标记语言中出现双斜杠，常作为注释起始符；也可能嵌在 HTML doctype 的公共标识中。

patterns.name: HTML 公共标识中的斜杠
patterns.context: 出现在 HTML 4 文档类型声明的公共标识中，不是注释。

patterns.name: 零散代码词片段
patterns.context: 这些词片段各自处于不同代码标识符或语法结构中；除与双斜杠共现外，没有明显一致的触发条件。
patterns.domain: 法律文本及多种编程语言源码

en.concept: Source Code Comments and Structural Markers
en.description: Primarily responds to the /// documentation comment marker in code, as well as slash separators and copyright notices in file headers; it also covers C# namespaces and collection paths, language-specific markers or import syntax, and a few API description words and compiler option descriptions.

patterns.name: Documentation Comment Marker
patterns.context: Appears in code documentation comments or API descriptions, often followed by <summary>, descriptive text, or a separator; usually near a declaration.
patterns.domain: Source code and API documentation in multiple programming languages

patterns.name: Comment Separator
patterns.context: A horizontal separator made of repeated slashes, often near the top of a file and adjacent to a copyright or disclaimer comment.

patterns.name: Namespace Declaration
patterns.context: In a C# file, after using directives and before a type declaration, followed by a namespace identifier.

patterns.name: C# Collection-Related Identifier
patterns.context: Appears as part of the System.Collections.Generic namespace path in a using directive.

patterns.name: Shell Command Terminology
patterns.context: Appears in namespace or command-related identifiers in the Microsoft Intune PowerShell SDK.

patterns.name: Compiler Option Description
patterns.context: A string argument in a cl::desc call, describing a command-line option.

patterns.name: Swift Member and Initialization Comments
patterns.context: In a Swift type definition, MARK comments divide member-variable and initialization sections, and AWS client/config properties are declared.

patterns.name: Objective-C Import and Marker
patterns.context: In an Objective-C implementation file, a header is imported, followed by a pragma mark identifying the initialization section.

patterns.name: Copyright and Disclaimer Wording
patterns.context: Near a copyright notice or disclaimer at the top of a file, usually adjacent to a slash-comment separator.

patterns.name: Type or Entity Description Words
patterns.context: Ordinary English words describing the role of a class or entity in an XML documentation comment summary.

0_1940.concept: 源代码注释与结构标记
0_1940.description: 主要响应代码中的 /// 文档注释标记，也响应文件头部的斜线分隔线与版权声明；此外覆盖 C# 命名空间和集合路径、各语言特有的标记或导入语法，以及少数 API 描述词和编译器选项说明。

patterns.name: 文档注释标记

patterns.name: 注释分隔线

patterns.name: 命名空间声明
patterns.context: C# 文件中，位于 using 指令之后、类型声明之前，后接命名空间标识符。

patterns.name: C# 集合相关标识符
patterns.context: 作为 System.Collections.Generic 命名空间路径的一部分，出现在 using 指令中。

patterns.name: Shell 命令术语
patterns.context: 出现在 Microsoft Intune PowerShell SDK 的命名空间或命令相关标识符中。

patterns.name: 编译器选项说明
patterns.context: 出现在 cl::desc 调用中，用于说明命令行选项的字符串参数。

patterns.name: Swift 成员与初始化注释
patterns.context: Swift 类型定义中以 MARK 注释划分成员变量和初始化部分，并声明 AWS client/config 属性。

patterns.name: Objective-C 导入与标记
patterns.context: Objective-C 实现文件中导入头文件，随后以 pragma mark 标示初始化部分。

patterns.name: 版权与免责声明用语

patterns.name: 类型或实体描述词
patterns.context: 出现在 XML 文档注释的 summary 描述中，用普通英文说明类或实体的作用。

en.concept: Double-Slash Symbol and Its Code Contexts
en.description: Primarily highly sensitive to the double slash //: commonly found in code line comments, license or copyright comments, and compiler directives; it can also appear in HTML DOCTYPE identifiers and mixed text. There is also one activation on a JavaDoc prefix.

patterns.name: Double-Slash Comment Prefix
patterns.context: The double slash appears at the beginning of a code or comment line, followed by a description, copyright, license, compiler directive, or comment text; it also occurs at inline comment positions.
patterns.domain: Github source code and code comments

patterns.name: Double Slash in HTML Public Identifier
patterns.context: In an HTML DOCTYPE PUBLIC identifier, the double slash appears as part of the identifier string, not as a comment prefix.

patterns.name: Double Slash in Garbled or Mixed Text
patterns.context: The surrounding text is difficult to recognize and lacks an obvious code-comment or identifier context.

patterns.name: JavaDoc Comment Prefix
patterns.context: A documentation comment before a Java method declaration; the passage also contains a more strongly activating double-slash line comment.

0_1940.concept: 双斜杠符号及其代码语境
0_1940.description: 主要对双斜杠 // 高度敏感：常见于代码行注释、许可证或版权注释及编译指令，也能出现在 HTML DOCTYPE 标识符和混杂文本中；另有一次 JavaDoc 起始符激活。

patterns.name: 双斜杠注释前缀

patterns.name: HTML 公共标识符中的双斜杠

patterns.name: 乱码或混杂文本中的双斜杠

patterns.name: JavaDoc 注释起始符
patterns.context: Java 方法声明前的文档注释；该段同时含有激活更强的双斜杠行注释。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to double-slash comment prefixes in source code and code documentation; in one garbled passage, it also activates on repeated “^^” and symbol strings, with their relationship unclear.

patterns.name: Double-Slash Comment Marker
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on `//` in code, mainly as a line-comment prefix; it also occurs at the start of an end-of-line comment.

patterns.name: Anomalous Marker Symbol

patterns.name: Mixed Symbol Noise

0_1940.description: 主要对源码及代码文档中的双斜杠注释起始符作强烈反应；另在一段乱码中对重复的“^^”和符号串激活，二者关系不明。

patterns.name: 双斜杠注释符
patterns.context: 激活集中在代码中的 `//`，主要是行注释起始符；也出现在代码行末的注释起始处。
patterns.domain: 多种编程语言的源码及代码文档

patterns.name: 异常标记符号

patterns.name: 混合符号乱码
patterns.context: 注释符号后接无明显语义的符号串和文本，未能从局部上下文确定具体功能。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 语料中的乱码/损坏文本

en.description: All fragments strongly activate on Users or users, referring to groups of people who use something; syntactic roles and domains vary, and uses in product names and email labels also occur. Neighboring words vary and show no stable additional trigger.

patterns.name: Users as the head noun

patterns.domain: Cross-domain expository text, news, technical documentation, and emails

patterns.name: Users as subjects or agents
patterns.context: Users is followed by a modal or linking verb, describing what users can, may, must, or are permitted to do.
patterns.domain: Technical documentation, patent backgrounds, software documentation

patterns.name: User groups and customer relationships
patterns.context: Users refers to groups using a particular product, service, or experiment; it can also describe churn or user categories.

patterns.name: Users in a brand or product name
patterns.context: Users is part of a proper name or product label, appearing in HTML/XML-style code.

patterns.name: Mailing list or recipient label
patterns.context: Users appears as a brief salutation or category label in email body text.

patterns.name: Lowercase users form

patterns.name: Adjacent words or formatting may affect activation
patterns.context: These words appear next to the target in individual fragments but are inconsistent across fragments; they may reflect local contextual effects and do not establish an independent trigger pattern.

0_1940.description: 所有片段都强烈激活于 Users 或 users，指人的用户群体；句法角色和领域多样，另见产品名、邮件标签等用法。邻近词各异，未显示稳定的额外触发词。

patterns.name: Users 作名词中心词

patterns.name: 用户作为主语或行动者

patterns.name: 用户群体及客户关系

patterns.domain: 论坛、商务邮件、科研文本

patterns.name: 品牌或产品名中的 Users

patterns.name: 邮件列表或收件人标签

patterns.name: 小写 users 形式

patterns.name: 相邻词或格式可能影响激活

en.description: All fragments strongly activate on Users/users; other activated words vary by context and involve virtual services, control and configuration, business email, code permissions, HTML markup, and research users, with no stable shared semantics so far.

patterns.name: Within-Word Space Tokenization of Users
patterns.context: Strong activation is concentrated on the word Users/users, especially the capitalized form preceded by a space; meaning and syntactic position vary considerably.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text: HackerNews, ArXiv, patents, email, code, StackExchange, NIH

patterns.name: User-Related Expressions and Product Context

patterns.name: Control Systems and Resource Modules

patterns.name: Virtual Worlds and Connections

patterns.name: Email Unsubscribe and Link Markers

patterns.name: Qualified Primary Users and Experiment Plans
patterns.context: Seven qualified primary users describe the experiment plan in detail.

0_1940.description: 所有片段都强烈激活于 Users/users；其余激活词随语境变化，涉及虚拟服务、控制与配置、商业邮件、代码权限、HTML标记及科研用户，暂无稳定的共同语义。

patterns.name: Users 的词内空格分词
patterns.context: 强激活集中在 Users/users 这个词，尤其是前面带空格、首字母大写的形式；词义和句法位置变化较大。

patterns.name: 用户相关表达及产品语境

patterns.name: 虚拟世界及连接

patterns.name: 商业客户与主用户

patterns.name: 邮件退订与链接标记

0_2238.description: 所有段都在 tele- 字符串上激活，既包括 teleportation、telecommunication、telephony、telegram、teletype，也包括匈牙利语 telepíthetünk；领域和语义各异。

patterns.name: teleportation（量子/物理）

patterns.name: telecommunication
patterns.context: 以 tele- 开头的远距离通信术语，涉及光纤传感或卫星移动通信。

patterns.name: tele-词首片段
patterns.context: 出现在匈牙利语“telepíthetünk”（安装）和葡萄牙语“telegrama”（电报）中；这里只能确认激活落在拼写片段 tele 上，未见共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会发言，匈牙利语、葡萄牙语

patterns.name: teletype
patterns.context: 法律叙述中，执法机关向监狱管理局发送 teletype。

en.description: All segments activate in words containing tele: in quantum contexts, usually teleportation/teleported; in communications contexts, telecommunication/telephony; also unrelated words such as telepíthetünk, telegram, and teletype.

patterns.name: Quantum entanglement and teleportation
patterns.context: Contains a tele stem in contexts involving quantum information, entanglement, and teleportation; also appears in a list discussing decoherence and quantum applications.
patterns.domain: Quantum physics and quantum information papers

patterns.name: Telecommunications and communications equipment
patterns.context: The beginning of a communications-related compound; context discusses fiber-optic sensing, mobile satellite telephony, or communications services.

patterns.name: Other words with the tele- stem
patterns.context: The tele substring occurs in words unrelated to quantum teleportation or telecommunications; these concern placement/construction, correspondence, or a teletype machine.
patterns.domain: Hungarian parliamentary text, Portuguese parliamentary speech, legal text

0_2238.description: 各段都在含 tele 的词中激活：量子语境多为 teleportation/teleported，通信语境为 telecommunication/telephony，另有 telepíthetünk、telegram、teletype 等无关词。

patterns.name: 量子纠缠与传态
patterns.context: 在量子信息、纠缠、传态等语境中，包含 tele 的词干；也出现于讨论退相干和量子应用的列举中
patterns.domain: 量子物理与量子信息论文

patterns.name: 电信与通信设备
patterns.context: 作为通信相关复合词的开头；上下文谈光纤传感、卫星移动电话或通信服务
patterns.domain: 光学通信论文、广告文本

patterns.name: tele-词干的其他词
patterns.context: tele 子串出现在与量子传态或电信无关的词中；分别涉及安置/建设、信件或电传打字机
patterns.domain: 匈牙利语议会文本、葡萄牙语议会发言、法律文本

en.description: All segments highlight the word-internal substring «tele»; it appears in both quantum teleportation and telecommunications, satellite phones, and other tele-containing words in multiple languages. The trigger seems primarily orthographic/subword-based rather than tied to a unified meaning or domain.

patterns.name: tele- in teleportation terminology
patterns.context: Refers to quantum teleportation in quantum information/entanglement contexts; there is also a non-physical model of a particle being instantly sent back to its origin.

patterns.name: tele- in telecommunication terminology
patterns.context: The initial fragment of telecommunications-related compounds, involving fiber-optic sensing and satellite phones.

patterns.name: Other tele- words
patterns.context: A Hungarian word containing tele-, Portuguese telegrama, and English teletype; activation falls on the same letter sequence within words, though meanings and syntax differ.
patterns.domain: EuroParl multilingual texts, FreeLaw legal texts

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: All visible highlights are the word-internal «tele», but the segmentation, meanings, and contexts differ considerably across languages, so it is unclear whether all examples are explained by the same substring feature.

0_2238.description: 所有片段都高亮词内子串«tele»；既出现在量子隐形传态，也出现在电信、卫星电话及多语种其他含 tele 的词中。触发似乎主要是字符/词片段，而非统一语义或领域。

patterns.name: teleportation 术语中的 tele-
patterns.context: 量子信息/纠缠语境中指量子隐形传态；另有粒子被瞬时送回原点的非物理模型。

patterns.name: telecommunication 术语中的 tele-
patterns.context: 作为电信相关复合词的词首片段，涉及光纤传感、卫星电话。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 技术论文、Enron 广告

patterns.name: 其他 tele- 词汇
patterns.context: 匈牙利语中含 tele- 的词、葡萄牙语 telegrama、英语 teletype；激活落在词内相同字母片段，语义和句法各异。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 多语种文本、FreeLaw 法律文本

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.trigger: 无可确认的独立触发模式
patterns.context: 可见的高亮均为词内 «tele»，但不同语言的切分、词义和上下文差异较大，无法确定这些例子是否都由同一子串特征解释。

en.description: Activations concentrate on the tele character sequence/prefix: especially teleportation in quantum contexts; also covers teleported, telecommunication, telephony, telepíthetünk, telegrama, and teletype.

patterns.name: Quantum information and entanglement
patterns.context: In contexts involving quantum entanglement, quantum information processing, or quantum technology, especially alongside or related to teleportation, cryptography, and superdense coding.

patterns.name: Ordinary verb use of teleport

patterns.name: Telecommunication-related words
patterns.context: The tele- prefix occurs in communications vocabulary, referring to telecommunications or satellite telephony.

patterns.name: Non-English words with the tele- prefix
patterns.context: The tele substring occurs in Hungarian word forms (installation/establishment) and Portuguese for “telegram”.
patterns.domain: European Parliament speeches, Hungarian and Portuguese

patterns.name: Teletype
patterns.context: Legal accounts mention a law-enforcement agency sending a teletype message to a prison bureau.

patterns.name: 量子信息与量子纠缠
patterns.context: 量子纠缠、量子信息处理或量子技术的语境中，尤与传态、密码学、超密编码并列或相关

patterns.name: teleport 的普通动词用法

patterns.name: telecommunication 相关词

patterns.name: tele- 词首的非英语词

en.description: Activation centers on the tele string: quantum teleportation, particle teleportation, communications, satellite phones, and Hungarian telepíthetünk, Portuguese telegrama, and English teletype. The commonality is more likely a word-form fragment than a single meaning.

patterns.name: Quantum teleportation terminology
patterns.context: In contexts involving quantum information, entanglement, quantum computing, or decoherence, “quantum teleportation” or related application lists appear; in some examples, tele is marked within the term.

patterns.name: Teleporting a particle
patterns.context: Describes a non-physical model in which a particle instantly returns to its origin after being reset.

patterns.name: Fiber-optic communications
patterns.context: Co-occurs with words such as optical fiber, sensing, and light, referring to methods from telecommunications.

patterns.name: Satellite phones
patterns.context: Describes mobile satellite phone service in an advertising context.

patterns.name: Hungarian tele- fragment
patterns.context: In a Hungarian sentence, activation falls at the beginning of the word telepíthetünk; the word means “can install/set up” and is not English teleportation.

patterns.name: Portuguese telegram
patterns.context: A parliamentary speech mentions a telegram.

patterns.name: Teletype in legal texts
patterns.context: Describes a marshal’s office sending a teletype to the prison administration.

0_2238.description: 激活集中在 tele 字符串上：量子传态、粒子传送、通信、卫星电话，以及匈牙利语 telepíthetünk、葡萄牙语 telegrama、英语 teletype。共同点更像词形片段，而非单一语义。

patterns.name: 量子传态术语
patterns.context: 量子信息、纠缠、量子计算或退相干的上下文中，出现“quantum teleportation”或相关应用列表；部分实例在术语内部标记 tele。
patterns.domain: 量子物理、量子信息论文

patterns.name: 传送粒子
patterns.context: 描述粒子重置后瞬时返回原点的非物理模型。

patterns.name: 光纤通信
patterns.context: 与 optical fiber、sensing、light 等词共现，指电信领域的方法。

patterns.name: 卫星电话
patterns.context: 广告语境中描述移动卫星电话服务。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语 tele- 词段
patterns.context: 匈牙利语句子中，激活落在 telepíthetünk 这一词的开头；该词意为“可以安装/设立”，并非英语 teleportation。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会匈牙利语文本

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语电报
patterns.context: 议会发言中提到一封电报。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语文本

patterns.name: 法律文本中的电传
patterns.context: 描述法警办公室向监狱管理局发送电传。

en.concept: Structured content in mathematical and technical texts
en.description: Activation spans instructions, numerical lists, and symbolic equations in various math problems, as well as measurement descriptions, experimental reports, and theorem citations in scientific papers; no single stable lexical meaning or domain trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Instructions and questions in math problems
patterns.context: Appears in short, solver-oriented math problems or instructions; often adjacent to a question mark, period, or line break.

patterns.name: Derivative problem phrasing
patterns.context: Asks for the third derivative of a given polynomial or function, with the formula often immediately adjacent to the instruction.

patterns.name: Number-base conversion
patterns.context: Asks to convert a number with its original base specified to another base.

patterns.name: Integer arithmetic exercises
patterns.context: Exercises consist of integer division expressions followed by answers or subsequent problems on new lines.

patterns.name: Sorting and selecting extrema
patterns.context: Provides answer choices or a list of integers and asks for comparison, sorting, or a value at a specified rank.
patterns.domain: Numerical comparison problems from DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Arithmetic structure in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: In calculation text dense with formulas, activation falls near numbers, operators, and expressions; it is not clearly a natural-language problem instruction here.
patterns.domain: Symbolic calculation text from DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Measurement and physics terminology in scientific papers
patterns.context: Paper passages discuss spectral absorption, vibrational bands, and measurements such as wavenumbers or wavelengths.
patterns.domain: ArXiv scientific papers on CO spectroscopy

patterns.name: Experiments and citations in condensed-matter papers
patterns.context: Reports measurement results and includes citations to journal papers and ArXiv works.

patterns.name: Theorem statements and citations in mathematical papers
patterns.context: The paper body presents conditional conclusions supported by mathematical citations.

0_2490.concept: 数学与技术文本中的结构化内容
0_2490.description: 激活既覆盖多种数学题的指令、数值列表与符号算式，也出现在科学论文的测量叙述、实验报告和定理引文中；看不出单一稳定的词义或领域触发条件。

patterns.name: 数学题目中的指令与问句
patterns.context: 出现在简短、面向求解者的数学题目或指令中；常与问号、句号或换行相邻。

patterns.name: 导数题措辞
patterns.context: 要求对给定多项式或函数求三阶导数，公式常紧邻题目指令。

patterns.name: 数字进制转换
patterns.context: 询问将带有原进制标注的数转换到另一进制。

patterns.name: 整数运算练习
patterns.context: 以整数除法算式和换行后的答案或后续题目构成练习序列。

patterns.name: 排序与极值选择
patterns.trigger: “smallest value”, “second biggest”, “in decreasing order”, “in ascending order”
patterns.context: 给出选项或整数列表，要求比较、排序或找出特定次序的数值。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的数值比较题

patterns.name: 数学公式中的算式结构
patterns.trigger: “Expand”以及多项式、乘法和指数表达式，如“(3*2q**5 - 7*2q**5 + q**5)”
patterns.context: 公式密集的计算文本中，激活落在数字、运算符和算式附近；此处不明显是自然语言题目指令。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的符号计算文本

patterns.name: 科学论文中的测量与物理术语
patterns.context: 论文叙述光谱吸收、振动带及波数/波长等测量。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 科学论文，涉及 CO 光谱

patterns.name: 凝聚态论文中的实验与引文
patterns.context: 陈述测量结果，并附期刊论文和 ArXiv 文献引用。

patterns.name: 数学论文中的定理陈述与引用
patterns.trigger: “geometrically finite”, “strict inequality”, “holds by a result of”
patterns.context: 论文正文给出条件性结论，并以数学文献引用支持。

en.concept: Structured symbols and terminology in mathematical and scientific texts
en.description: Strong activations cover math-problem instructions and numerical/symbolic operations, and also appear in inequalities in a mathematics paper and terminology, experimental descriptions, and citations in two physics papers; there is no clear, consistent local trigger word.

patterns.name: Math-problem instructions and answers
patterns.context: The prompt asks to calculate, convert, differentiate, compare, or sort, often immediately followed by a brief numerical answer; also includes algebraic expressions and operators

patterns.name: Specific symbols and number fragments in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Appears in algebraic operations such as expansion, with token activations scattered across coefficients, variables, and operators; the trigger relationship is less clear than for problem instructions

patterns.name: Physical chemistry terminology and measurement descriptions
patterns.context: Discusses CO absorption in water ice and detection of vibrational bands; activations fall on scientific terminology, property contrasts, and measured values

patterns.name: Condensed-matter physics abbreviations and experimental citations
patterns.context: Describes a class of states previously measured using spin-resolved ARPES experiments, accompanied by paper citations

patterns.name: Inequalities and citations in a mathematics paper
patterns.context: Theorem-style statements give conditions and strict inequalities, with citations to mathematical literature

0_2490.concept: 数学与科学文本中的结构化符号和术语
0_2490.description: 强激活覆盖数学题指令与数值/符号运算，也见于数学论文不等式，以及两段物理论文中的术语、实验描述和引文；没有明显统一的局部触发词。

patterns.name: 数学题指令及答案
patterns.trigger: “What is”“Convert”“Calculate”“Find”“Sort”，以及“smallest value”“second biggest”“in ascending order”“divided by”
patterns.context: 题目要求计算、换算、求导、比较或排序，常紧邻简短数值答案；也包括代数表达式和运算符

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的特定符号与数字片段
patterns.context: 出现在展开等代数运算式中，token 激活分散于系数、变量和运算符；触发关系不如题目指令清晰

patterns.name: 物理化学术语及测量表述
patterns.context: 讨论 CO 在水冰中的吸收及振动带检测，激活落在科学术语、性质对举和测量数值上
patterns.domain: ArXiv 天体物理/光谱学论文

patterns.name: 凝聚态物理缩写与实验文献引用
patterns.context: 介绍已通过自旋分辨 ARPES 实验测量某类态，伴随论文引用

patterns.name: 数学论文中的不等式与引文
patterns.context: 定理式论述给出条件与严格不等式，并以数学文献引证

en.concept: Symbols, numbers, and mathematical computation text
en.description: Activations mainly cover minus signs, numbers, and mathematical expression symbols, and also occur in instruction words for calculations, base conversion, differentiation, and sorting; there are also three paper contexts involving spectral measurements, ARPES, and geometric inequalities, with activations on the respective terminology and numerical values.

patterns.name: Minus signs and subtraction notation
patterns.context: The minus sign occurs next to negative numbers, negative exponents, or algebraic expressions; this is a recurring activation point across multiple passages, especially common in arithmetic problems
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics: numerical computation, algebraic expressions, sorting problems

patterns.name: Numbers and digit strings
patterns.context: Activations fall on numbers, integer fragments, or scientific measurements; appearing alone does not identify a particular operation

patterns.name: Mathematical operators and expression symbols
patterns.context: Symbols occur in formal expressions such as polynomials, fractions, or inequalities

patterns.name: Problem instructions and operation terms
patterns.context: Brief instructions pose calculation, base-conversion, differentiation, or sorting tasks; activations occur on instruction words and related operation terms
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics: exercises or Q&A-style math data

patterns.name: Powers and derivative expressions
patterns.context: A variable power expression is adjacent to an instruction to “find the third derivative”; both the exponent symbol and derivative wording activate
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics: symbolic algebra and calculus problems

patterns.name: Base-conversion context
patterns.context: Asks or performs conversion of a number from one base to another; the base numeral following base also activates

patterns.name: Sorting and magnitude comparisons
patterns.context: Asks to order values or compare the magnitudes of options; related words and numerical options occur together
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics: sorting and comparison problems

patterns.name: Division calculations
patterns.context: Asks to divide two numbers, or writes a fraction using a slash; the passage may also contain negative numbers and digit strings

patterns.name: Spectroscopy vocabulary and measurements in scientific papers
patterns.context: Discusses CO absorption or vibrational bands in water ice and gives measurements such as wavenumbers/wavelengths

patterns.name: Abbreviations and citations in physics materials research
patterns.context: Spin-resolved ARPES measurements of topological insulator surface states, surrounded by literature citations

patterns.name: Geometric group theory terminology and inequalities
patterns.context: States a strict inequality under geometric finiteness conditions and cites a mathematical result

0_2490.concept: 符号、数字与数学计算文本
0_2490.description: 激活主要覆盖负号、数字及数学表达式符号，也分布于计算、进制转换、求导和排序题的指令词；另有三段论文语境，分别涉及光谱测量、ARPES与几何不等式，激活具体落在各自术语和数值上。

patterns.name: 负号与减法记号
patterns.context: 负号紧邻负数、负指数或代数表达式；这是多段中反复出现的激活点，尤其常见于运算题
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics：数值计算、代数式、排序题

patterns.name: 数字及数字串
patterns.context: 激活落在数字、整数片段或科学计量数值上；单独出现并不足以限定某一种运算

patterns.name: 数学运算符及表达式符号
patterns.context: 符号位于多项式、分数或不等式等形式化表达式中

patterns.name: 题目指令与运算关系词
patterns.context: 以简短指令提出计算、进制转换、求导或排序任务，激活分布于指令词及相关运算词
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics：练习题或问答式数学数据

patterns.name: 幂与求导表达式
patterns.context: 变量的幂表达式与“求三阶导数”指令相邻；幂符号和导数措辞均有激活
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics：符号代数与微积分题

patterns.name: 进制转换语境
patterns.context: 询问或执行一个数从某进制转换到另一进制；base 后的进制数也激活

patterns.name: 排序及大小比较
patterns.context: 要求排列数值或比较选项的大小；相关词与数字选项同时出现

patterns.name: 除法计算
patterns.context: 要求两个数相除，或以斜线书写分数；段中还可能伴随负数和数字串

patterns.name: 科学论文中的谱学词汇与测量数值
patterns.context: 讨论水冰中 CO 的吸收或振动带，并给出波数/波长等测量值

patterns.name: 物理材料研究缩写与文献引文
patterns.context: 关于拓扑绝缘体表面态的自旋分辨 ARPES 测量，周围是文献引用

patterns.name: 几何群论术语及不等式
patterns.context: 陈述几何有限条件下的严格不等式，并引用数学结果

en.concept: Numbers, operations, and symbols in mathematical and scientific texts
en.description: Primarily responds to numbers, operators, and operation instructions in mathematical calculations and problems: polynomial differentiation, base conversion, division, sorting, and extrema. It also covers symbols and citations in mathematical papers, as well as terminology and citations in two types of physics papers.

patterns.name: Formula and polynomial notation
patterns.context: Operators, variables, and powers occur in formulas or algebraic expressions; activation often falls on symbols and adjacent numbers.

patterns.name: Base-conversion questions and answers
patterns.context: Asks to convert a negative number or integer between bases, interleaving numbers with base notation.

patterns.name: Large-number division and quotient
patterns.context: Requests division of large integers, often followed immediately by an answer.

patterns.name: Numerical sorting problems
patterns.context: Provides a list of positive and negative numbers and asks for ascending or descending order.

patterns.name: Magnitude comparison problems
patterns.context: Lists candidate values labeled with letters and asks for an extremum or second-largest value.

patterns.name: Third-derivative problems
patterns.context: Asks for the third derivative of a polynomial or function with respect to a variable, followed by a formula or result.

patterns.name: Numbers in mathematical symbols and citations
patterns.context: Proofs contain inequalities, theorem citations, and numbering; activation is distributed near symbols and numbers.

patterns.name: Physics spectroscopy terminology
patterns.context: Discusses experimental results on CO absorption or vibrational bands in water ice.

patterns.name: Condensed-matter physics abbreviations and citations
patterns.context: Introduces measurements of topological-insulator surface states alongside paper citations and reference numbers.

patterns.name: Numerical and formatting fragments
patterns.context: Expression fragments lack a complete problem statement and mix numbers, symbols, and parentheses; their relationship to other problem types is unclear.

0_2490.concept: 数学与科学文本中的数字运算及符号
0_2490.description: 主要响应数学计算与题目中的数字、运算符及操作指令：多项式求导、进制转换、除法、排序和极值；也覆盖数学论文符号/引文，以及两类物理论文的术语和引用。

patterns.name: 公式及多项式符号
patterns.context: 公式或代数表达式中出现运算符、变量和幂次；激活常落在符号及相邻数字上。

patterns.name: 进制转换问答
patterns.context: 询问负数或整数在不同进制间转换，数字与进制说明交错出现。

patterns.name: 大数除法与商

patterns.context: 出现在科学论文片段中，包括天体/分子光谱、凝聚态物理和数学定理；未见统一的语义触发词

patterns.name: 物理文献引文与实验缩写

en.description: Activation spans two kinds of material: physics experiments and mathematical theorem statements in ArXiv; and DM Mathematics problems involving expansion, base conversion, differentiation, division, extrema comparison, and sorting. Triggers are scattered across passages, with no stable shared token or structure.

patterns.name: CO vibrational absorption spectrum
patterns.context: Discusses CO absorption or vibrational bands in water ice and reports measured wavenumbers.

patterns.name: ARPES and spin-resolved measurements
patterns.context: Discusses measurements of TSS and TIs and related paper citations.

patterns.name: Geometric finiteness and strict inequalities
patterns.context: Given that G is geometrically finite, states inequalities between delta quantities and cites mathematical results.

patterns.name: Symbolic algebra expansion
patterns.context: A product with coefficients, variables, and powers appears, with an expansion requested or shown.

patterns.name: Base-conversion problems

patterns.name: Differentiation exercises

patterns.name: Integer division calculations

patterns.name: Selecting extrema from options

patterns.name: Integer sorting
patterns.context: Provides a list of positive and negative integers and asks for ascending or descending order.

0_2490.description: 激活覆盖两类材料：ArXiv 中物理实验与数学定理表述；DM Mathematics 中展开、进制转换、求导、除法、极值比较和排序等题目。各段触发词分散，未见稳定的共同词项或结构。

patterns.name: CO 振动吸收谱

patterns.context: 讨论 CO 在 water-ice 中的吸收或振动带，并报告测量波数。

patterns.name: ARPES 与自旋分辨测量
patterns.context: 谈论 TSS、TIs 的测量及相关论文引用。

patterns.name: 几何有限性与严格不等式
patterns.context: 给定 G 几何有限，陈述 delta 量之间的不等式并引用数学结果。

patterns.name: 符号代数展开
patterns.context: 出现带系数、变量和幂次的乘积，要求或展示展开式。

patterns.name: 进制转换题
patterns.context: 给出以某进制表示的整数，询问转换到另一进制。

patterns.name: 求导练习
patterns.context: 给出关于变量的多项式或函数，要求求三阶导数；也可能紧接答案。

patterns.name: 整数除法计算
patterns.context: 逐题要求计算整数除法，常伴随负数及答案行。

patterns.name: 从选项中找极值
patterns.trigger: « smallest» value?；« What» is the second « biggest»
