patterns.name: 整数排序
patterns.trigger: « in» decreasing « order»；«Sort» ... « in» ascending « order»
patterns.context: 给出含正负整数的列表，要求升序或降序排列。

en.description: Activation spans two kinds of text: formulas, technical terminology, and citations in papers; and dense numbers and operators in math exercises. The exercises also repeatedly contain calculation, conversion, sorting, and differentiation instructions, along with ordinal, magnitude-comparison, and ranking terms.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols in scientific literature and citations
patterns.context: Appears in paper text, formulas, or references; activation falls on terminology, formula symbols, and numeric/citation fragments.

patterns.name: Operators and values in arithmetic problems
patterns.context: Dense numbers, arithmetic expressions, or calculation problems, often with minus signs, multiplication/division symbols, and digit strings; also includes base-conversion problems.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics exercises or generated problems

patterns.name: Problem instructions and mathematical operation words
patterns.context: Appears in problem prompts asking for calculation, conversion, sorting, or differentiation.

patterns.name: Ordinal, comparison, and sorting vocabulary
patterns.context: Appears when a problem asks for a rank, magnitude, or derivative order.

0_2490.concept: 数学符号与数学任务文本
0_2490.description: 激活覆盖两类文本：论文中的公式、专业术语与引文；以及数学练习中的密集数字和运算符。练习题还反复出现计算、转换、排序、求导指令及序数、大小比较词。

patterns.name: 科学文献与引文中的数学符号
patterns.context: 出现在论文正文、公式或文献引用中；激活落在术语、公式符号及数字/引用片段上。

patterns.name: 算术题中的运算符与数值
patterns.context: 密集数字、算术表达式或计算题中，常伴随负号、乘除符号和数字串；也包括数制转换题。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 数学练习或生成式题目

patterns.name: 题目指令与数学操作词
patterns.trigger: “What is”, “Convert”, “Calculate”, “Find”, “divided by”, “in ascending order”, “decreasing order”, “third derivative”
patterns.context: 出现在要求计算、转换、排序或求导的题目提示中。

patterns.name: 序数及比较、排序语汇
patterns.context: 题目要求确定次序、大小或导数阶数时出现。

en.description: Primarily responds to instructions and phrasing about sorting and differentiation in math exercises, alongside digit strings, minus signs, and operators. A few activations occur in paper citation numbers, inequality statements, and spectroscopy values; no single trigger word explains all passages.

patterns.name: Mathematical problem instructions
patterns.context: Triggered by natural-language instructions or questions in math problems, especially sentences asking for calculation, conversion, sorting, or differentiation; often at the beginning or end of a task.
patterns.domain: Arithmetic and algebra exercises from DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Ordinal and ranking expressions
patterns.context: Occurs when a math task specifies a rank, order, or extremal ranking; usually co-occurs with calculation or sorting instructions.
patterns.domain: Differentiation, sorting, and comparison problems from DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Minus signs and negative-number operations
patterns.context: A minus sign is adjacent to a number or algebraic term, appearing in base conversion, division, polynomials, and sorting tasks; activation may overlap with instruction patterns.
patterns.domain: Arithmetic and algebra problems from DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and expression fragments
patterns.context: Operators, variables, and powers occur in formulas or calculation expressions; often adjacent to natural-language problems, but sometimes the expression itself is long.
patterns.domain: Symbolic calculation problems from DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Numbers and numerical strings
patterns.context: Dense digit strings occur in problem statements, input values, or near answers; also appear in expressions and sorting data.

patterns.name: Numbers/ordinal fragments in citation markers
patterns.context: Numbers are embedded in bracketed references or arXiv identifiers rather than mathematical instructions; observed only in this passage.

patterns.name: Inequalities and geometric terminology in mathematical papers
patterns.context: The body of a mathematical discussion presents conditions and conclusions, including inequalities and citations; it does not have the instruction style of an exercise.

patterns.name: Measurement values in spectroscopy papers
patterns.context: Values and units occur in descriptions of CO vibrational-band detection and absorption spectra.

0_2490.description: 主要响应数学练习题中的指令与排序、求导等表达，也伴随数字串、负号和运算符；少数激活落在论文引文编号、不等式论述及光谱数值中，未见能统一解释全部片段的单一触发词。

patterns.name: 数学题指令用语

patterns.name: 序数与排名表达

patterns.name: 负号及负数运算

patterns.name: 数学符号与表达式片段
patterns.context: 公式或计算表达式中出现运算符、变量及幂；经常邻接自然语言题目，但也有长表达式本身。

patterns.name: 数字与数值串

patterns.name: 引文标识中的数字/序号片段

patterns.name: 数学论文中的不等式与几何术语

patterns.name: 光谱论文中的测量数值
patterns.context: 数值和单位出现在 CO 振动带的检测及吸收谱描述中。

en.concept: Mathematical symbols and formal scientific text
en.description: Activation spans two clearly distinct kinds of text: terminology, conditions, and inequalities in ArXiv scientific papers; and numbers, operators, and problem instructions in math exercises involving algebra, bases, differentiation, division, comparison, and sorting. No single shared trigger word is apparent.

patterns.name: CO spectroscopy and astrophysical measurements
patterns.context: Describes CO absorption in water ice, polar/nonpolar band profiles, and vibrational-band positions.

patterns.name: Topological-insulator surface states and ARPES
patterns.context: Mentions spin-resolved ARPES measurements of topological-insulator surface states and references.

patterns.name: Geometrically finite groups and strict inequalities
patterns.context: A mathematical paper states a strict inequality under a geometrical-finiteness condition and cites a theorem result.

patterns.name: Operators and numbers in algebraic expansion
patterns.context: Dense polynomial products or power expressions appear alongside the Expand instruction; activation falls on operators, coefficients, and numbers.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, symbolic algebra problems and answers

patterns.name: Base-conversion questions and answers
patterns.context: Asks for a number's representation in one base and requests conversion to another base.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, elementary number theory exercises

patterns.name: Polynomial differentiation problems
patterns.context: Asks for the third derivative of a given polynomial, whose expression contains variables, coefficients, and powers.

patterns.name: Integer division exercises
patterns.context: Calculates integer division in a question-and-answer or exercise format, often with the answer on a new line.

patterns.name: Multiple-choice sorting and comparison
patterns.context: Provides letter-labeled numerical options and asks for the minimum or second-largest number.

patterns.name: Ascending or descending integer order

0_2490.concept: 数学符号与形式化科学文本
0_2490.description: 激活覆盖两类明显不同文本：ArXiv 科学论文中的术语、条件与不等式表述；以及数学练习中的数字、运算符和题目指令，涉及代数、进制、求导、除法、比较与排序。未见单一共同触发词。

patterns.name: CO 光谱与天体物理测量

patterns.name: 拓扑绝缘体表面态与 ARPES

patterns.name: 几何有限群与严格不等式

patterns.context: 密集的多项式乘积或幂表达式，伴随 Expand 指令；激活落在运算符、系数和数字上。

patterns.name: 进制转换问答

patterns.context: 要求对给定多项式求三阶导数，表达式中有变量、系数和幂。

patterns.name: 整数除法练习
patterns.context: 以问答或练习形式计算整数相除，常带换行的答案。

patterns.name: 选择题式排序比较

en.concept: Bulgarian word endings and miscellaneous fragments
en.description: Most activations occur on the Bulgarian endings “ане/то”, commonly in nominalizations or verb forms. Other isolated activations occur on the Russian “Заранее”, an initial letter in a template word, and mathematical number fragments, with no unified explanation.

patterns.name: Bulgarian verb ending “ане”
patterns.context: Appears near the endings of Bulgarian nouns or gerunds, typically forming names of actions, processes, or states; sometimes marks a span across subword fragments.
patterns.domain: Bulgarian European Parliament text; also seen in Russian Q&A

patterns.name: Bulgarian inflectional ending “то”
patterns.context: Appears at the end of Bulgarian verb forms, forming neuter singular forms; examples relate to “постигането” and “гласуването”.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of Russian “заранее”
patterns.context: In a Russian StackExchange sentence, the complete word “Заранее” is marked across multiple subword fragments, suggesting the word itself rather than only the “ане” ending.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in a Russian technical word
patterns.context: Activation falls on the initial letters of the Russian technical word “шаблона”; the surrounding text discusses template length and the location found.

patterns.name: Number fragments in numerical or mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments of digit sequences, decimal numbers, or numbers in multiplication problems; there is no apparent connection to the Bulgarian morphology pattern.

0_2490.concept: 保加利亚语词尾及杂项片段
0_2490.description: 多数激活位于保加利亚语的「ане/то」词尾，常见于名词化过程或动词形式；另有俄语「Заранее」、模板词首字母及数学数字片段的孤立激活，未能统一解释。

patterns.name: 保加利亚语动词词尾「ане」

patterns.domain: 欧洲议会保加利亚语文本；另见俄语问答

patterns.name: 保加利亚语屈折词尾「то」
patterns.context: 出现在保加利亚语动词形式的词尾，构成中性单数形式；例中分别与「постигането」「гласуването」有关。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会保加利亚语文本

patterns.name: 俄语「заранее」词内片段

patterns.name: 俄语技术词中的内部片段

patterns.name: 数字或数学表达中的数字片段
patterns.context: 激活落在数字序列、十进制数或乘积题目中的数字片段；与保加利亚语形态模式没有明显联系。

en.description: The most consistent trigger is the hyphen “.-”: it occurs both in author-name initials and in PACS classification codes. Other activations occur at quotation boundaries in author names, abbreviation letters, and a few punctuation marks, numbers, and word fragments.

patterns.name: Author-name initials before a hyphen
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated in initials in names, especially period-hyphen combinations between first or middle initials; the surrounding text is typically an author list.

patterns.name: Hyphens in PACS/subject classification codes
patterns.context: Occurs after the decimal point in a numeric classification code and before a letter classification symbol; passages usually contain PACS numbers or similar subject classification codes.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper metadata and physics classification

patterns.name: Apostrophes and quotation boundaries in author lists
patterns.context: An apostrophe occurs immediately after the end of an author name, often in an author entry enclosed in quotation marks; the activation is weaker but recurs.

patterns.name: Initials and name fragments in author lists
patterns.context: Appears in initials, spelling fragments of names, and author lists; not always accompanied by a hyphen, and the exact activation location varies.

patterns.name: Comma punctuation
patterns.context: Occurs after commas in titles, abstract-like text, and PACS code lists; activation is weak, with no consistent semantic context.
patterns.domain: Punctuation in paper metadata and technical text

patterns.name: Specific number fragments
patterns.context: Occasionally occurs in figure scales, citation page numbers, or classification codes, with no stable shared context.
patterns.domain: Numbers and identifiers in scientific papers

patterns.name: Rare letters or word-ending fragments
patterns.context: Sporadically occurs in body-text words or classification codes, without a consistent local trigger.
patterns.domain: Scientific paper body text and metadata

0_2490.concept: 点号连字符及元数据格式
0_2490.description: 最稳定触发是连字符“.-”：既见于作者姓名缩写，也见于PACS分类码；此外有作者姓名引号边界、缩写字母和少量标点、数字及词片段激活。

patterns.name: 连字符前的作者名缩写
patterns.context: 激活集中出现在姓名缩写中，尤其是名字或中间名缩写之间的句点连字符组合；周围通常是作者列表。

patterns.name: PACS/学科分类代码中的连字符
patterns.context: 出现在数字分类代码的小数点之后、字母分类符之前；段落通常包含PACS号码或类似学科分类代码。
patterns.domain: ArXiv论文元数据与物理学分类

patterns.name: 作者列表中的撇号与引号边界
patterns.context: 作者姓名末尾紧邻撇号，常见于以引号包围的作者条目；虽非最强激活，但反复出现。

patterns.name: 作者列表中的字母缩写与姓名片段
patterns.trigger: «H»5、«S»2、«R»1、«D»1等被标记的单字母或姓名片段
patterns.context: 出现在姓名缩写、姓名拼写片段及作者列表中；不总伴随连字符，具体激活位置不一。

patterns.name: 逗号标点
patterns.context: 出现在标题、摘要式文本及PACS代码列表的逗号后；激活较弱，语义上下文不统一。
patterns.domain: 论文元数据及科技文本标点

patterns.name: 特定数字片段
patterns.context: 偶见于图示刻度、引文页码或分类代码，未见稳定共同语境。
patterns.domain: 科技论文中的数字与编号

patterns.name: 稀有字母或词尾片段
patterns.context: 零散出现在正文词语或分类代码中，缺乏一致的局部触发条件。
patterns.domain: 科技论文正文与元数据

en.description: Every passage contains mathematical or scientific formulas, with activations distributed across LaTeX formatting markers, variables/indices, equations, summations, and probability or matrix symbols; the specific mathematical objects and fields vary widely.

patterns.name: Formula notation in matrix factorization
patterns.context: When a mathematics paper introduces factorization and writes matrix or operator equations, activations concentrate on formula-structure markers and some variables and operators.

patterns.name: Parameterized summation identity
patterns.context: A formula contains a T function with multiple parameters and a finite sum; activations fall on parameter symbols, punctuation, and equation/summation structures.
patterns.domain: Combinatorial or special-function formulas in mathematics papers

patterns.name: Probability model and product constraint
patterns.context: Probability expressions, indicator functions, and products/sums over indexed variables occur together.

patterns.name: Matrix powers and typesetting environments
patterns.context: In a derivation involving matrix powers, activations cover LaTeX matrix environments, line-break/alignment symbols, and matrix entries.

patterns.name: Algebraic simplification of finite sums
patterns.context: A finite sum over index k is transformed and simplified through equations; activations occur on the index, plus sign, and summation structure.

patterns.name: Probability tail bound and error function
patterns.context: A probability expression is derived from an exponential distribution/tail probability and the result is expressed using erf.

patterns.name: Probability inequalities and random variables
patterns.context: Inequality relations between random variables are used to write an equation or bound for event probabilities.

patterns.name: Physical formula involving angle-related quantities
patterns.context: The formula contains an azimuthal angle and angle variables with experimental detector labels; activations mainly fall on formula delimiters and variable symbols.

patterns.name: Density bound and radical inequality
patterns.context: First states an upper bound containing a radical, then gives a lower bound on density and its label.

patterns.name: Operator summation with spin indices
patterns.context: An expression in quantum many-body or condensed-matter physics contains indexed creation/annihilation operators, parameters, and a double sum.

0_2490.description: 各段都含数学或科学公式，激活分布在 LaTeX 排版标记、变量/指标、等式、求和及概率或矩阵等符号上；具体数学对象和领域差异很大。

patterns.name: 矩阵分解中的公式标记
patterns.context: 数学论文中引出因子分解并书写矩阵或算子等式时，激活集中在公式结构标记及部分变量、运算符上。

patterns.name: 带参数的求和恒等式
patterns.context: 公式中出现带多个参数的 T 函数及有限求和，激活落在参数符号、标点和等式/求和结构上。
patterns.domain: 数学论文中的组合或特殊函数公式

patterns.name: 概率模型与乘积约束
patterns.context: 概率表达式、指示函数和对索引变量的乘积/求和并列出现。

patterns.name: 矩阵幂与排版环境
patterns.context: 矩阵乘幂的推导中，激活覆盖 LaTeX 矩阵环境、换行/对齐符号及矩阵元素。

patterns.name: 有限和的代数化简
patterns.context: 对含索引 k 的有限和进行等式变形与化简，激活索引、加号和求和结构。

patterns.name: 概率尾界与误差函数
patterns.context: 由指数形式的分布/尾概率推导概率表达式，并使用 erf 表示结果。

patterns.name: 概率不等式与随机变量
patterns.context: 利用随机变量间的不等式关系，写出事件概率的等式或界。

patterns.name: 角度相关量的物理公式
patterns.context: 公式包含方位角及带实验探测器标记的角度变量；激活主要落在公式分隔符和变量符号上。

patterns.name: 密度界与根式不等式
patterns.context: 先陈述包含根式的上界，再给出密度下界及其标签。

patterns.name: 带自旋指标的算符求和
patterns.context: 量子多体或凝聚态表达式中，带指标的产生/湮灭算符、参数及双重求和同时出现。

en.description: All ten passages activate on the same letter substring sam. It occurs in different words, including samizdat, samplers, sammanhållningen, samtyckt, samarbete, samtid, samråder, and samen, across languages, domains, and styles, with no consistent semantic or grammatical condition.

patterns.name: sam subword fragment
patterns.context: The highlighted span is the consecutive letters sam inside a word; it need not be a complete word. In English examples, the following letters form different words.
patterns.domain: Multilingual text, including ArXiv and European Parliament text

0_2490.description: 全部十段都激活同一字母子串 sam；它出现在 samizdat、samplers、sammanhållningen、samtyckt、samarbete、samtid、samråder、samen 等不同词中，跨语言、领域和文体，未见一致的语义或语法条件。

patterns.name: sam 子词片段
patterns.context: 高亮的是单词内部连续字母 sam，并不要求它是完整词；在英语实例中，后续字母组成不同词语。
patterns.domain: 多语种文本，含 ArXiv 与欧洲议会文本

en.description: The core trigger words are gay, homosexual, and lesbian, often referring to homosexual people, communities, and related rights, legal, or health issues; in a few older literary contexts, gay means joyful or lively.

patterns.name: Terms for homosexual identity or sexual orientation
patterns.context: Triggered when referring to homosexual people, gay men or women, or homosexual groups; includes noun, adjective, and compound-word uses.
patterns.domain: Social issues, law, news commentary, online discussion

patterns.name: Gay as a descriptor of a place or atmosphere
patterns.context: Gay modifies a place to convey liveliness, joy, or a related venue meaning, rather than explicitly referring to sexual orientation.

patterns.name: Rights, communities, and public policy related to homosexuality
patterns.context: Gay or lesbian appears in expressions about rights, advocacy groups, comparisons between communities, or political positions.

patterns.name: Homosexuality and AIDS or prevention
patterns.context: Appears in discussions of historical associations with AIDS, infection awareness, or prevention methods for gay men.

patterns.name: Legal penalties and persecution targeting homosexual people
patterns.context: The terms occur in contexts involving punishment, duties to report, or oppressive laws targeting homosexual people and their families.

patterns.name: Homosexual identity as a personal condition or recommended audience
patterns.context: Addresses gay readers directly or limits recommended content by homosexual identity.

0_2490.description: 核心触发词是 gay、homosexual、lesbian，常指同性恋者、社群及相关权利、法律、健康议题；少数旧式文学语境中 gay 表示欢乐或热闹。

patterns.name: 同性恋身份或性取向称谓
patterns.context: 在指称同性恋者、男性或女性同性恋者，或同性恋群体时触发；包括名词、形容词及复合词中的用法。
patterns.domain: 社会议题、法律、新闻评论、网络讨论

patterns.name: gay 作为地点或氛围形容词
patterns.context: gay 修饰地点，表达热闹、欢乐或相关场所含义，而非明确指性取向。

patterns.name: 同性恋相关的权利、社群与公共政策
patterns.context: gay 或 lesbian 出现在权利、支持团体、社群对照或政治立场等相关表达中。
patterns.domain: 社会政治评论、法律、网络讨论

patterns.name: 同性恋与艾滋病或预防
patterns.context: 在讨论艾滋病的历史关联、感染认知或针对同性恋男性的预防方法时出现。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生、影视剧情介绍

patterns.name: 针对同性恋者的法律惩罚与迫害
patterns.context: 称谓出现在刑罚、告发义务或对同性恋者及其家人的压迫性法律情境中。

patterns.name: 同性恋身份作为个人条件或推荐受众
patterns.context: 直接对同性恋读者说话，或以同性恋身份限定所推荐的内容。

en.description: The most prominent common clue is the ku substring inside words across languages, but the specific words and contexts vary. In two passages, there is also a strong response to the homogen stem, referring respectively to homogenization processes and cultural homogenization. Other markers are scattered and have no unified explanation.

patterns.name: ku substring
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the ku substring; it occurs in different words, often internally rather than as a standalone word.
patterns.domain: Math problems, Estonian and Finnish parliamentary text, Spanish chat, Polish text

patterns.name: homogen stem
patterns.context: Occurs in a past participle describing the homogenization of a mixture and in a noun referring to cultural homogenization.

patterns.name: Other sporadic markers
patterns.context: These markers are scattered across passages; no sufficiently consistent local semantic or syntactic condition is apparent, making them difficult to group with the ku or homogen patterns.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, parliamentary records, chat, religious texts, scientific papers, cultural commentary

0_2490.concept: 词片段 ku 与 homogen
0_2490.description: 最突出的共同线索是跨语言词内的 ku 子串，但具体词和语境多变；另在两段中强烈响应 homogen 词干，分别指均质化过程与文化同质化。其余标记分散，尚无统一解释。

patterns.name: ku 子串
patterns.context: 激活集中在 ku 子串；在不同词语中出现，往往是词内部而非独立词。
patterns.domain: 数学题、爱沙尼亚语和芬兰语议会文本、西班牙语聊天、波兰语文本

patterns.name: homogen 词干
patterns.context: 出现在描述混合物均质化的过去分词，以及谈论文化同质化的名词中。

patterns.name: 其他零散标记
patterns.trigger: «bv»、«dir»、«aaa»、«ak»、«akk»、«prob»、« Euro»、«opa»、« k»、« Haiti»、« e»、«else»、« Bar»、« bu»、«G»、«!»、«P»、«Ja»、« %»、« wave»、« worldwide»、« local»
patterns.context: 这些标记分散在各段；未见足够一致的局部语义或句法条件，难以归入 ku 或 homogen 模式。
patterns.domain: 数学、议会记录、聊天、宗教文本、科学论文、文化评论

en.concept: ku string and the homogen word family
en.description: Activations are most prominent on the ku character fragment in Finnish, Estonian, Polish, and Spanish, and also occur in the sequence ku in an English probability problem; strong activations also appear in homogenized/homogenization. The multilingual subword fragments and English word family are difficult to unify; passage 3 remains unexplained.

patterns.name: Finnish ku- subword fragment
patterns.context: Appears inside Finnish words, followed by a stem portion; in context it can form different words meaning “belonging to,” “listen to concerns,” or “held last month.”

patterns.name: English sequence symbol
patterns.context: A probability problem asks for the probability of a specified letter sequence in two draws without replacement; ku is the sequence specified in the problem.

patterns.name: Estonian word-ending fragment
patterns.context: Embedded in an Estonian word near “riikide töök…” and forms part of the word inflection.

patterns.name: Spanish greeting and chat term
patterns.context: In an IRC conversation, the former is a greeting and the latter a nickname; activation falls inside the word or nickname.

patterns.name: Polish phrase fragment
patterns.context: Appears in a Polish phrase in religious song/quotation-style text, where the fragment forms an expression like “my beloved turned toward me.”

patterns.name: English homogen word family
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of mixing steps in materials experiments, and in discussions of the homogenization of local cultures by global commercial civilization.
patterns.domain: ArXiv scientific paper; PhilPapers philosophical/cultural discussion

0_2490.concept: ku 字符串及 homogen 词族
0_2490.description: 激活最显著地落在芬兰语、爱沙尼亚语、波兰语及西班牙语中的 ku 字符片段，也见于英语概率题的序列 ku；另在 homogenized/homogenization 中强烈激活。多语种词片段与英语词族难以统一，段3暂无解释。

patterns.name: 芬兰语 ku- 词片段
patterns.context: 出现在芬兰语词内部，后续接词干部分；在句中可构成“属于”“听取关切”“上个月举行”等不同词。

patterns.name: 英语序列符号
patterns.context: 概率题中两次不放回抽取字母，要求计算指定字母序列的概率；ku 在此是题目所列序列。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语词尾片段
patterns.context: 嵌在“riikide töök…”附近的爱沙尼亚语词中，属于词形的一部分。

patterns.name: 西班牙语问候与聊天词
patterns.context: IRC 对话中，前者是问候语，后者是昵称；激活落在词内部或昵称内部。

patterns.name: 波兰语短语词片段
patterns.context: 出现在宗教歌词/引文式文本的波兰语短语中，词片段构成“我所爱的人转向我”一类表达。

patterns.name: 英文 homogen 词族
patterns.context: 分别出现在材料实验的混合步骤描述、以及讨论全球商业文明与地方文化同质化的论述中。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 科学论文；PhilPapers 哲学/文化论述

en.description: This neuron responds strongly to the homogen stem and its derivatives: most passages concern biological sample homogenization, homogenizers, or homogenates; another passage refers to cultural homogenization caused by commercial civilization.

patterns.name: “homogen” stem: samples are homogenized
patterns.context: Appears in methods descriptions referring to homogenizing samples, tissues, or cells, or mentioning homogenizers or homogenates; often near words such as buffer, tissue, cell, or organ

patterns.name: “homogenization” stem: sociocultural homogenization
patterns.context: Discusses the disappearance of local and regional cultural differences due to the expansion of commercial civilization; activation falls on the homogenization stem
patterns.domain: Sociocultural criticism / architecture and urban theory

0_2490.description: 该神经元强烈响应 homogen 词干及其派生词：多数段落指生物样本均质化、匀浆器或匀浆物；另有一段指商业文明导致的文化同质化。

patterns.name: “homogen”词干：样品被均质化
patterns.context: 出现于方法描述中，指对样品、组织或细胞进行均质化处理，或提及均质器、匀浆物；周围常有缓冲液、组织、细胞或器官等词

patterns.name: “homogenization”词干：社会文化同质化
patterns.context: 谈论商业文明扩张造成地方与区域文化差异消失；激活落在 homogenization 词干上
patterns.domain: 社会文化批评／建筑与城市理论

en.description: Every passage activates on the “homogen” stem, covering homogenization of experimental samples, tissue homogenates, and cultural homogenization; the commonality is homogenization-related word forms rather than a single field or specific procedure.

patterns.name: Homogenization/homogenate processing
patterns.context: In descriptions of experimental methods or processing, refers to mechanically homogenizing a mixture, tissue, cells, or sample, or to the noun form homogenization; context may include instruments, buffers, solvents, temperature, or processing duration.
patterns.domain: Experimental methods, materials science, and biomedical papers

0_2490.description: 所有段落均在“homogen”词干处激活，覆盖实验样品均质化、组织匀浆及文化均质化等用法；共同点是均质化相关词形，而非单一领域或具体操作。

patterns.name: 均质化/匀浆处理
patterns.context: 在实验方法或处理过程描述中，指将混合物、组织、细胞或样品机械均质化、匀浆，或名词形式的均质化；可带仪器、缓冲液、溶剂、温度或处理时长等上下文。
patterns.domain: 实验方法、材料科学及生物医学论文

en.description: All passages contain and activate the homogen stem; most concern experimental homogenization and its products, while a few concern cultural homogenization. One passage also activates ultrapure, local, and regional, corresponding respectively to laboratory water and local-culture contexts.

patterns.name: homogenize forms in scientific text
patterns.context: Activation falls on the subword fragment of the English words homogenize/homogenized/homogenizer/homogenate; usually describes homogenizing samples, tissues, cells, or cultures, and occasionally abstract homogenization.
patterns.domain: Research papers; primarily biomedical experimental methods, with some sociocultural commentary

patterns.name: Subword fragment within ultrapure
patterns.context: Appears before “water from Fluka Chemie AG,” describing laboratory water; homogenized appears later in the same passage.

patterns.name: Local and regional cultural references
patterns.context: Appears near words such as distinctive and cultures, discussing global commercial civilization overshadowing local cultures and their homogenization; not an experimental context.

0_2490.description: 所有段都含 homogen 词干并触发；主要是实验中均质处理及其产物，少数是文化同质化。另有一段同时触发 ultrapure、local、regional，分别对应实验用水与地方文化语境。

patterns.name: 科学文本中的 homogenize 词形
patterns.context: 激活落在英语词 homogenize/homogenized/homogenizer/homogenate 的词干片段；通常描述样品、组织、细胞或培养物的均质处理，偶尔是抽象的同质化。
patterns.domain: 科研论文；以生物医学实验方法为主，另有社会文化评论

patterns.name: ultrapure 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在“water from Fluka Chemie AG”之前，描述实验用水；同段稍后出现 homogenized。

patterns.name: 局部与区域文化表述
patterns.context: 与 distinctive、cultures 等词相邻，讨论全球商业文明压过地方文化及其同质化；不属于实验操作语境。

en.description: All passages activate on the split/splitting word form or a compound term, covering division, classification, mathematical splitting properties, and equipment names; the shared trigger form is clear, while specific meanings vary by field.

patterns.name: Forms of split and meanings related to division
patterns.context: The split root appears in different forms and compounds, referring to separating or partitioning objects, or as part of a technical proper term; surrounding semantics are not fixed

patterns.name: Point-splitting regularization
patterns.context: Uses point splitting to handle divergences produced when a functional second derivative at the same point acts on a local functional

patterns.name: Optimization problem decomposition
patterns.context: Uses information structure to decompose an optimization problem into simpler subproblems

patterns.name: Classifying solutions into even and odd by symmetry
patterns.context: Classifies solutions of the Schrödinger equation by parity according to the equation's symmetry

patterns.name: Mathematical term split rank
patterns.context: A technical mathematical term in the classification of complex geometry of real symmetric pairs, not an ordinary action usage

patterns.name: Static and non-static field decomposition
patterns.context: Divides a field into a nonzero static part and another part for background-field treatment of a one-loop integral

patterns.name: Split-coil magnet
patterns.context: Split modifies coil to form the name of experimental equipment; it is not a verb describing an object being divided in the sentence

patterns.name: Split torus
patterns.context: A mathematical structural term for a real algebraic group, appearing in discussions of embeddings and lattice groups

patterns.name: Splitting property of a group
patterns.context: Split is used as a mathematical predicate describing whether a group has a certain splitting property

patterns.name: Optical beam splitter
patterns.context: Splitter refers to a linear optical component and occurs alongside photon-polarization quantum gates

patterns.name: Vector splitting and processor partitioning
patterns.context: Splits values stored in a vector and involves virtual processor partitioning

0_2490.concept: split 词根及其分割相关术语
0_2490.description: 所有段均在 split/splitting 词形或复合术语中激活，涵盖拆分、分类、数学上的分裂性质及设备名称；共同触发形式明确，具体语义随领域变化。

patterns.name: split 的词形及分割含义
patterns.context: 词根 split 出现在不同词形和复合词中，涉及把对象分开、划分，或作为专名术语组成部分；周边语义并不固定

patterns.name: 点分裂正则化
patterns.context: 以 point splitting 处理同一点处泛函二阶导数作用于局域泛函产生的发散

patterns.name: 优化问题拆分
patterns.context: 利用信息结构，将优化问题拆解成更简单的子问题

patterns.name: 按对称性分成奇偶解
patterns.context: 依据方程的对称性，将薛定谔方程的解按奇偶性分类

patterns.name: 分裂秩的数学术语
patterns.context: 作为实对称对的复几何分类中的技术性数学术语，并非普通的动作性用法

patterns.name: 场的静态与非静态分解
patterns.trigger: “all fields are «split» into a non-zero static and a …”
patterns.context: 将场分成非零静态部分及另一部分，用于一圈积分的背景场处理

patterns.name: 分裂线圈磁体
patterns.context: split 修饰线圈，构成实验设备名称；不是句中对对象执行拆分的动词

patterns.name: 分裂环面
patterns.context: 作为实代数群中的数学结构术语，出现在嵌入与格点群的讨论中

patterns.name: 群的可分裂性

en.description: Strong activations center on two distinct terms: Pale (including forms such as Paleozoic) and discriminate. Other markers are sporadic across domains and lack a unified trigger pattern.

patterns.name: The word “Pale”

patterns.name: The word “discriminate”
patterns.context: Appears in sentences discussing distinguishing different signals or models, or discrimination in law and policy.
patterns.domain: Physics papers, cosmology papers, parliamentary records, court decisions

patterns.name: Other sporadic terms
patterns.context: Each occurs in a different context, with no shared local semantic or syntactic condition; activations may correspond to other word forms, subword fragments, or contextual features.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, Q&A, medical abstracts, scientific papers

patterns.name: Sporadic function words and short fragments
patterns.context: Distributed across various syntactic environments, with no consistent trigger condition; activation strength is also lower than for the primary trigger words.

patterns.name: 其他零散词项

en.description: All passages strongly mark “Belgium,” covering addresses, research locations, people’s activity locations, and organizational locations. A few mathematical terms are also marked, possibly as secondary patterns from nearby context.

patterns.name: Belgium as an address or institutional location
patterns.context: The country name appears in an address, institutional location, or author contact information, usually introduced by a city or institution name.
patterns.domain: Paper author addresses and institutional information

patterns.name: Belgium as a research location or the location of a study population
patterns.context: The country name marks the region where study samples, cases, strains, or social media activity are located.
patterns.domain: Medical and life sciences papers; social media accounts

patterns.name: Belgium as a location where people are active
patterns.context: The country name appears in accounts of people’s experiences or activity locations.

patterns.name: Belgium as an organization’s office location

patterns.name: Activation near mathematical terms or formulas

0_2596.description: 所有段均强烈标记“Belgium”，涵盖地址、研究地点、人物活动地及组织所在地；少数数学词也被标记，可能是邻近上下文的次级模式。

patterns.name: Belgium作为研究地点或研究对象所在地

patterns.context: 国家名标记研究样本、病例、菌株或社交媒体活动所在地区

patterns.name: Belgium作为人物活动地点
patterns.context: 国家名出现在人物经历或活动地点的叙述中

patterns.name: Belgium作为组织办公地点
patterns.context: 国家名与首都连用，说明组织行政办公室所在地

patterns.name: 数学术语或公式邻近激活

en.description: All passages contain strong activation on “Belgium”; most use it in addresses, institution locations, or descriptions related to Belgium. Other marked words are scattered across their respective contexts and do not form stable independent patterns.

patterns.name: Belgian place name and address
patterns.context: The place name occurs in structures such as institutional addresses, author affiliations, sources of experimental materials, or administrative office locations; Belgium often appears at the end of a sentence or address.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, biographies, encyclopedias, and institutional descriptions

patterns.name: Institutional and regional names in Belgian contexts
patterns.context: These words do not share an obvious local form or meaning; they occur respectively in Belgian addresses, social-media narratives, research materials and medical texts, and descriptions of Belgian regions or institutions, and may be weak associative features accompanying the place name.
patterns.domain: Proper nouns, disciplinary terms, and topic words across fields

patterns.name: Individual words and syntactic fragments
patterns.context: Appears only in individual passages, without stable independent trigger conditions across passages; may be sporadic co-activation in their respective contexts.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, social media, paper transitions, music, and encyclopedic narratives

0_2596.description: 所有段落都出现强激活的“Belgium”；多数把它用于地址、机构地点或比利时相关叙述。其他标记词分散于各自语境，难以归为稳定的独立模式。

patterns.name: 比利时地名及地址

patterns.name: 比利时语境中的机构与地区名称

patterns.context: 这些词并不共享明显的局部词形或语义；分别出现在比利时地址、社交媒体叙述、科研材料与医学文本、比利时地区或机构介绍中，可能是伴随地名触发的弱关联特征。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本中的专名、学科词与主题词

patterns.name: 个别词汇与句法片段
patterns.trigger: « rooted»、« Mathematics»、« someone»、« Hence»、« Western»、« Summer»等
patterns.context: 仅在个别段落出现，缺乏跨段稳定的独立触发条件；可能是各自语境中的零散伴随激活。
patterns.domain: 数学、社交媒体、论文衔接语、音乐及百科叙述

en.concept: Recognition of the place name Belgium
en.description: The core response is the country name Belgium, especially in location, address, or institutional-location contexts; Brussels co-occurs with it. Other weaker activations are scattered across fields and lack a unified pattern.

patterns.name: Country name Belgium
patterns.context: The country name Belgium appears in an address, institutional location, study population, or location description; this trigger occurs in every passage.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including academic papers, personal profiles, social media, and encyclopedias

patterns.name: Related location Brussels
patterns.context: The city name Brussels appears with Belgium as the location of an office.

patterns.name: Sporadic accompanying activations
patterns.context: These words appear only in individual passages and belong to different topics, with no stable shared condition; their activation is weaker than Belgium.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, social media, medicine, biology, music, and other fields

0_2596.description: 核心反应是国家名 Belgium，尤其出现在地点、地址或机构所在地语境；Brussels 与之共现。其余较弱激活分散于各领域，缺少统一模式。

patterns.name: 国家名 Belgium

patterns.name: 相关地点 Brussels

patterns.name: 零散伴随激活

patterns.domain: 数学、社交媒体、医学、生物学、音乐等

en.description: All passages strongly activate on the country name “Belgium,” including address affiliations and mentions of locations, research populations, or activity locations in body text; surrounding vocabulary and genres vary.

patterns.name: Country name in Belgian addresses
patterns.context: Belgium occurs as a country name in addresses, institution locations, or contact information; no specific adjacency pattern is required

patterns.name: Belgian locations or populations in body text

0_2596.description: 所有段都强烈激活于国名“Belgium”，涵盖地址署名及正文中的地点、研究人群或活动地点；周边词汇和文体多样。

en.description: Every snippet contains «Bulgaria» in English, and this token is the strongest activation in each case. The preceding text may be a list of neighboring countries, a place description, or an unrelated account; topics and genres vary.

patterns.name: Bulgaria in other contexts

0_2596.description: 所有片段都在英文语境中出现 «Bulgaria»，且该 token 均为最强激活；前文可为邻国名单、地名介绍或无关叙述，题材和文体多样。

patterns.name: 其他语境中的 Bulgaria

en.concept: Austria and its address-related place names
en.description: The strongest responses focus on Austria, especially when the country name appears in institutional addresses, research locations, or descriptions of country relations. The feature also responds to the adjective Austrian and place names such as Vienna, Graz, and Innsbruck, with weaker responses to countries listed alongside it.

patterns.name: Country name Austria
patterns.context: The country name appears in contexts such as addresses, institutional affiliations, research locations, or country lists in sentences; often at the end of a sentence or after a comma

patterns.name: Austria-related adjective
patterns.context: Austrian modifies nouns such as Embassy or Russian, or describes a person’s relation to a country; «Austria»10 also appears later in the same passage

patterns.name: Place name Vienna

patterns.name: Place name Graz
patterns.context: City name in a university address, near the university name and Austrian address information

patterns.name: Place name Innsbruck
patterns.context: City name in a department address, adjacent to a street address and «Austria»10

patterns.name: Japan
patterns.context: Country where a medical institution is located, listed alongside the software source address in Vienna, Austria

patterns.name: Other address countries
patterns.context: Country names appearing with Austrian addresses or alongside Austria; they occur only sporadically in the snippets

0_2596.description: 最强响应集中于 Austria，尤其是国家名出现在机构地址、研究地点或国家关系叙述中；也响应奥地利形容词及 Vienna、Graz、Innsbruck 等地名，并较弱响应并列国家名。

en.description: All snippets reach their strongest activation at the country name «Austria», covering academic addresses, general location references, and historical and political accounts; Vienna often co-occurs. A few other marked words lack consistency across passages.

patterns.name: Austria in general geographical or everyday accounts

patterns.name: Austria in historical and political accounts

en.concept: Recognition of the place name Belgium
en.description: All passages strongly activate on the country name «Belgium», regardless of topic or style; the surrounding context usually presents it as a location, address, or institutional location.

patterns.name: Place name Belgium
patterns.context: The place name Belgium appears in sentences about addresses, institutional locations, research sites, event locations, or where people are active; in these examples it is always the country name itself, often at the end of a sentence or address.

0_2596.description: 所有段落都强烈激活于国家名 «Belgium»，不受主题或文体限制；其周围上下文多将其作为地点、地址或机构所在地。

en.description: The most consistent trigger is the place name “Scotland,” as well as the adjective “Scottish.” Contexts range from history, literature, and news to policy, medicine, sports, and encyclopedias. A few nearby triggers involve lists of UK regions or related institutions and proper nouns.

patterns.name: Place name Scotland
patterns.context: Appears as a place name or location in a sentence, often listed with other parts of the UK or in structures such as “in/of Scotland”; spans the widest range of contexts.
patterns.domain: Literature, history, news, public policy, medicine, sports, encyclopedias, etc.

patterns.name: Listed UK region names
patterns.context: Scotland is listed alongside other countries or parts of the UK in discussions of national representation or per-capita spending.
patterns.domain: Narrative text, statistics, or public affairs

patterns.name: Proper nouns and institutions related to Scotland
patterns.context: Appears in contexts involving Scottish history, governance, or public services, though these words do not all refer to Scotland themselves.

patterns.name: Scotland in bibliographic titles
patterns.context: The place name appears in a poem title rather than ordinary narrative prose.

0_2596.description: 最稳定的触发是地名“Scotland”，也包括形容词“Scottish”；语境从历史、文学、新闻到政策、医疗、体育和百科不等。少数邻近触发涉及英国地区并列或相关机构、专名。

patterns.name: 苏格兰地名

patterns.name: 英国地区名称并列

patterns.name: 与苏格兰相关的专名及机构
patterns.context: 出现在苏格兰相关的历史、治理或公共服务语境中，但这些词本身并非都指向苏格兰。

patterns.name: 书目标题中的 Scotland
patterns.context: 地名出现在诗作标题中，而非普通叙述句。

en.concept: Academic addresses and institutional proper nouns
en.description: Primarily responds to country names in author affiliations, especially France; it also responds to Paris and fragments such as Université and Institut in French institution names. A few activations occur on Germany, the United States, Tel Aviv, and other proper-name fragments.

patterns.name: France in French addresses
patterns.context: At the end of an institutional or author address, usually following a city, postal code, or region; this is the most consistent and strongest trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Place name Paris
patterns.context: Appears in French universities, research institutions, or addresses, often adjacent to Université, Sorbonne, Diderot, and similar terms; in [2], it is Paris 6.

patterns.name: French institutional vocabulary
patterns.context: Inside the names of French universities, research institutes, or laboratories; the triggered portion is sometimes only part of a word.

patterns.name: Germany in German addresses
patterns.context: At the end of an institutional entry with Germany as the country; it follows the same country-name trigger pattern as French addresses, but with a different country.

patterns.name: Other country or place-name fragments
patterns.context: Country or city names in address or institutional entries; each appears only once, so a more specific shared condition cannot be established.

patterns.name: Other institutional proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Partial word segments in institution or personal names, without enough repeated evidence to show that they are independent, stable trigger patterns.

0_2596.description: 主要响应作者单位地址中的国家名，尤其是法国；也响应巴黎及法国机构名称中的Université、Institut等片段。少数激活落在德国、美国、特拉维夫和其他专名片段上。

patterns.name: 法国地址中的 France

patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文作者单位与地址

patterns.name: 巴黎地名

patterns.name: 德国地址中的 Germany

patterns.context: 激活常出现在方括号引用及其前后的括号、标点或引文编号附近；可见于多种专业文本。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文及 LaTeX 风格引文

patterns.name: 术语和专名中的局部词片
patterns.context: 除引文标记外，多个领域术语、专名或普通词的内部词片也有正激活；没有明显统一的语义类别。
patterns.domain: 计算机、物理、材料科学、医学等学术文本

patterns.name: 数学与格式控制符
patterns.context: 数学公式及公式编号、标签的 LaTeX 标记附近出现零散激活。

en.concept: Academic figure and table citation markers
en.description: Primarily responds to table or figure citation markers and their link/type metadata in papers, often near the ends of academic paragraphs; there is also one activation in a Github benchmark document. Other medical vocabulary mostly occurs around citation markers.

patterns.name: Table citation markers
patterns.context: A table is cited at the end of body text or a results paragraph, often accompanied by Markdown/HTML links and citation-type markers
patterns.domain: PubMed Central academic papers; also benchmark descriptions in software documentation

patterns.name: Figure number citation markers
patterns.context: A figure or figure caption is cited at the end of the paper text; links and citation-type markers often follow the number

patterns.name: Benchmark-related words
patterns.context: Software documentation describes benchmarks, executables, or input sizes; this does not occur in other passages

patterns.name: Diversity descriptions
patterns.context: Describes the diversity of research samples in age, location, ethnicity, and education

patterns.name: Research statistics and results near tables
patterns.context: Reports clinical measurements or population mortality results, with a table cited at the end of the paragraph

patterns.name: Research terminology before paper figure or table citations
patterns.context: Background, group descriptions, or inclusion criteria are followed by figure or table citations; the words themselves belong to different topics

patterns.name: Imaging descriptions and figure citations
patterns.context: Describes abdominal imaging findings and organ ectopia, followed by a figure citation at the end of the sentence

0_2796.description: 主要响应论文中的表格或图引用标记及其链接/类型元数据，常出现在学术段落末尾；另有一次 Github benchmark 文档激活。其他医学词汇多是引用标记周边内容。

patterns.name: 表格引用标记
patterns.context: 正文或结果段落末尾引用表格，常伴随 Markdown/HTML 链接及引用类型标记
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 学术论文；另有软件文档中的 benchmark 表述

patterns.name: 图编号引用标记
patterns.context: 论文正文末尾引用图或图注；编号后常接链接与引用类型标记

patterns.name: benchmark 相关词
patterns.context: 软件文档中描述基准测试、可执行程序或输入大小；未见于其他段落

patterns.name: 多样性描述
patterns.context: 描述研究样本在年龄、地点、族裔和教育程度上的多样性

patterns.name: 研究统计结果与表格相邻
patterns.context: 报告临床测量或人口死亡率结果，并在段末引用表格

patterns.name: 论文图表引用前的研究术语
patterns.context: 研究背景、组别描述或纳入标准后接图表引用；这些词本身分属不同主题
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学研究

patterns.name: 影像学描述及图引用
patterns.context: 描述腹部影像征象及脏器异位，并在句末引用图

en.description: Primarily activates on cross-reference markers for tables and figures in scientific papers and nearby formatting symbols; also occurs on GitHub benchmark titles and terminology, section dividers, and several scattered medical and research terms.

patterns.name: Table references
patterns.context: Tables are cited in the main text, often in descriptions of research results or methods; activations focus on table names and their Markdown/HTML cross-reference markers

patterns.name: Figure references
patterns.context: Figures or illustrations are cited in the main text, often in parenthetical citations at the end of a sentence

patterns.name: Benchmark titles and terminology
patterns.context: Titles formatted with divider lines and benchmark-related terms in project documentation; activations involve both title markers and the terms themselves

patterns.name: Results heading divider
patterns.context: The Results heading and the long or short Markdown-style divider beneath it
patterns.domain: Section formatting in scientific papers converted to Markdown

patterns.name: Medical term fragments
patterns.context: Anatomical terms marked by segmentation in imaging descriptions; this example also mentions gastric gas, organ position, and situs inversus
patterns.domain: Medical case reports or imaging reports

patterns.name: Local words in statistical and research text
patterns.context: Appearing separately in descriptions of participant characteristics, hormone results, research reviews, and clinical study enrollment and intervention; no stable shared trigger condition is evident

0_2796.concept: 文档结构与交叉引用标记
0_2796.description: 主要对科学论文中表格、图的交叉引用标记及其周边排版符号激活；另有 GitHub benchmark 标题/术语、章节分隔线，以及若干分散的医学和研究词语。

patterns.name: 表格引用
patterns.context: 正文引用表格，常见于研究结果或方法描述；激活集中在表格名称及其 Markdown/HTML 交叉引用标记

patterns.name: 图示引用
patterns.context: 正文引用图或图示，常位于句末的括号引用中

patterns.name: benchmark 标题与术语
patterns.context: 项目文档中以分隔线呈现的标题，以及 benchmark 相关术语；激活涉及标题标记和术语本身

patterns.name: 结果标题分隔线
patterns.context: Results 标题及其下方 Markdown 风格的长短分隔线
patterns.domain: 科学论文转写为 Markdown 的章节排版

patterns.name: 医学术语片段
patterns.context: 影像描述中被切分标记的解剖术语；该例还出现胃气影、脏器位置及 situs inversus 描述

patterns.name: 统计与研究文本中的局部词语
patterns.context: 分别出现在受试者特征、激素结果、研究综述及临床研究入组与干预叙述中，未见稳定的共同触发条件

en.description: Primarily responds to table and figure cross-reference formatting and link markers in academic text; also includes a benchmark document heading. Other activations are scattered across biomedical research terms and quantitative results, with no unified lexical pattern.

patterns.name: Table citation markers
patterns.context: After presenting data or research characteristics, the paper body immediately includes a table cross-reference; common forms include Table followed by a number, a link anchor, and a table-type marker.

patterns.name: Figure citation markers
patterns.context: After presenting results or case descriptions, the paper body immediately includes a figure cross-reference and link marker.

patterns.name: Benchmark heading and wording
patterns.context: A project document contains a benchmark section heading, separator, and performance testing description.

patterns.name: Research sample diversity descriptions
patterns.context: The methods section explains that the sample is diverse in age, location, ethnicity, and education.

patterns.name: Biomedical results and quantitative measures
patterns.context: Reports changes in measures before and after treatment or population mortality and its variation over time; partly overlaps with the table citation pattern.

patterns.name: Specific word fragments in academic text
patterns.context: These words are scattered across literature reviews, research procedures, patient characteristics, or case imaging descriptions; beyond their shared academic context, no stable lexical or semantic trigger is evident.

0_2796.description: 主要响应学术文本中的表格、图示交叉引用格式及其链接标记；另见基准测试文档标题。其余激活散布于生物医学研究词语与定量结果，缺少统一词汇规律。

patterns.name: 表格引用标记
patterns.context: 正文在陈述数据或研究特征后，紧接表格交叉引用；常见形式为 Table 加编号、链接锚点及表格类型标记。

patterns.name: 图示引用标记
patterns.context: 正文在结果或病例描述后，紧接图的交叉引用与链接标记。

patterns.name: 基准测试标题与措辞
patterns.context: 项目文档中出现 benchmark 章节标题、分隔线及性能测试说明。

patterns.name: 研究样本多样性描述
patterns.trigger: « purpos»ive ... deliberately designed to be diverse
patterns.context: 研究方法中说明样本在年龄、地点、族裔和教育程度方面具有多样性。

patterns.name: 生物医学结果与定量指标
patterns.context: 报告治疗前后指标变化或人群死亡率及其随时间变化；但与表格引用模式部分重叠。

patterns.name: 学术文本中的特定词语片段
patterns.trigger: « Lloyd»；« incorporated»；« Arabidopsis»；« acyl» « lipid»；« typically»；« clinical» « equip»；« independ»ency；« AD»L；« hem»«idi»«aphragm»；« sit»us inversus« total»is
patterns.context: 这些词语分散于文献综述、研究流程、患者特征或病例影像描述中；除共同处于学术文本外，未见稳定的词汇或语义触发条件。

en.concept: Markers and terminology in academic technical text
en.description: Activations are distributed across figure/table cross-references, formula and formatting markers, and technical terms in academic text; software benchmark tests and research-description vocabulary also appear. There is no single stable semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Figure and table cross-reference markers
patterns.context: Cross-references to figures, tables, or their panels in the main text, often followed by automatically generated link anchors and citation-type attributes

patterns.name: Local symbols in numbers and mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Near formulas, equation numbers, and their link markers; paragraph 1 also contains tumor cell potential doubling time
patterns.domain: Mathematical and formatting text in academic papers

patterns.name: Scientific compound terms and material names
patterns.context: Components of technical terms or material names, including “well-enhanced CCA pseudoaneurysm” and “dielectric SiO2”“Polarization Rotator”

patterns.name: Abbreviations and related terms
patterns.context: Near medical or scientific abbreviations and their expanded names; activations are scattered within abbreviations or term phrases
patterns.domain: Medical case reports and materials science papers

patterns.name: Benchmark terminology
patterns.context: Documentation paragraphs describing built-in benchmark functionality and executable programs in a software project

patterns.name: Diversity descriptions
patterns.context: Describes research samples as intentionally diverse in age, region, ethnicity, and education level

patterns.name: Research participation and submission terms
patterns.context: Lists research information provided by a coordinating center, including budget, submission deadlines, and participant information

patterns.name: Metabolism research terminology
patterns.context: Publication descriptions related to Arabidopsis mutants and lipid metabolism research

patterns.name: Ratio and treatment abbreviations
patterns.context: Describes changes in cell ratios in RA patients and outcomes after treatment

patterns.name: Descriptions of time and change
patterns.context: Describes changes in hormone levels and other measures after one year of research follow-up

0_2796.concept: 学术技术文本中的标记与术语
0_2796.description: 激活分布于学术文本中的图表交叉引用、公式/排版标记和专业术语，也见软件基准测试及研究描述词汇；未见单一稳定的语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 图表引用标记
patterns.context: 正文中指向图、表或其面板的交叉引用，常接自动生成的链接锚点与引用类型属性

patterns.name: 数字与数学表达式中的局部符号
patterns.context: 公式、方程编号及其链接标记附近；第1段同时出现 tumor cell potential doubling time
patterns.domain: 学术论文的数学/排版文本

patterns.name: 科学复合术语与材料名称
patterns.context: 专业术语或材料名称的组成部分，包括“well-enhanced CCA pseudoaneurysm”和“dielectric SiO2”“Polarization Rotator”等

patterns.name: 缩写与缩写相关术语
patterns.context: 医学或科学缩写及其展开名称附近，激活点分散在缩写内部或术语词组中
patterns.domain: 医学病例与材料科学论文

patterns.name: 基准测试用语
patterns.context: 说明软件项目内置基准测试功能及可执行程序的文档段落

patterns.name: 多样性描述
patterns.context: 描述研究样本在年龄、地区、族裔和教育程度方面经过有意选择、具有多样性
patterns.domain: 研究方法/样本招募说明

patterns.name: 研究参与与提交事务词汇
patterns.context: 列举协调中心提供的研究信息，包括预算、提交截止时间及参与者信息

patterns.name: 代谢研究术语组合
patterns.context: 与 Arabidopsis 突变体及脂质代谢研究相关的出版物描述

patterns.name: 比率及治疗缩写
patterns.context: 描述 RA 患者细胞比例变化及治疗后结果

patterns.name: 时间与变化描述
patterns.context: 研究随访一年后，对激素水平等指标变化的描述

en.concept: Technical terminology and figure/table citations in academic text
en.description: Activations span terminology in various papers and software documentation; the most consistent recurring pattern is Figure/Fig/Table citations in the body text. Other activations include medical, engineering, research management, and plant biology vocabulary, which do not form a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Figure and table citations in academic prose
patterns.context: After reporting results or introducing content, the body text cites a figure or table using parentheses, link markers, or adjacent text; different citation formats occur.
patterns.domain: Paper body text and structured figure/table citations, mainly in biomedical papers but also engineering papers

patterns.name: Doubling in a mathematical expression
patterns.context: In a formula describing tumor cell potential, doubling modifies time, forming “tumor cell potential doubling time”.
patterns.domain: Mathematical formulas and variable descriptions in oncology papers

patterns.name: Medical term ratio
patterns.context: Describes changes in the ratio of Th17 cells to helper T cells in RA patients after treatment.

patterns.name: CT imaging term tomography
patterns.context: Occurs in the name of the imaging examination “computed tomography (CT) scan”.

patterns.name: Engineering illustration term schematic
patterns.context: Introduces a schematic of a microactuator and a figure number citation.

patterns.name: Materials and optics term dielectric
patterns.context: Describes a single CNP attached to SiO₂ dielectric material as part of a plasmonic device.

patterns.name: Scale descriptor sized
patterns.context: One use describes aneurysm size (well-enhanced、3 × 3 cm sized); another describes input size (reasonably-sized).
patterns.domain: Clinical imaging descriptions and software documentation

patterns.name: Software benchmark heading and terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in a project document’s Benchmarks section, introducing integrated memory benchmarks and their executable files.

patterns.name: Research design description purposive
patterns.context: Explains that participants were deliberately selected to maintain diversity in age, region, ethnicity, and education.
patterns.domain: Social science or public health research methods

patterns.name: Post-treatment timing and total measures
patterns.context: Describes increases in total and free testosterone one year after TRT, adjacent to a table citation.

patterns.name: Research procedures and submission deadlines
patterns.context: Lists information provided to investigators by the coordinating center, including submission deadlines.

patterns.name: Plant lipid metabolism terminology
patterns.context: Discusses annual publication counts on Arabidopsis acyl lipid metabolism mutants.

0_2796.concept: 学术文本中的专业术语与图表引用
0_2796.description: 激活涵盖多种论文术语与软件文档用语；最一致的重复模式是正文中的 Figure/Fig/Table 图表引用，其余包括医学、工程、研究管理及植物生物学词汇，难以归为单一语义类别。

patterns.name: 学术正文中的图表引用
patterns.trigger: «Figure»、«Fig»、«Table»，尤其是紧随其后的编号和括号字母，如“«Figure»1 1(a«)”和“«Table»1 1”
patterns.context: 正文在陈述结果或介绍内容后，以括号、链接标记或邻接文本引用图、表；不同引用格式均出现。
patterns.domain: 论文正文及其结构化图表引用，主要为生物医学论文，也包括工程论文

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的 doubling
patterns.context: 肿瘤细胞潜能的公式说明中，doubling 修饰 time，构成“tumor cell potential doubling time”。
patterns.domain: 肿瘤学论文中的数学公式及变量说明

patterns.name: 医学术语 ratio
patterns.context: 描述 RA 患者治疗后 Th17 细胞与辅助性 T 细胞的比值变化。

patterns.name: CT 成像术语 tomography
patterns.context: 出现在“computed tomography (CT) scan”这一影像检查名称中。

patterns.name: 工程图示术语 schematic
patterns.context: 用于介绍微致动器的示意图，并引出图号引用。

patterns.name: 材料与光学术语 dielectric
patterns.context: 描述单个 CNP 附着于 SiO₂ 介质材料并构成等离激元器件。

patterns.name: 尺度描述 sized
patterns.context: 一次用于描述动脉瘤尺寸（well-enhanced、3 × 3 cm sized），另一次用于描述输入大小（reasonably-sized）。
patterns.domain: 临床影像描述与软件文档

patterns.name: 软件基准测试标题与术语
patterns.context: 出现在项目文档的 Benchmarks 小节，介绍集成内存基准测试及其可执行文件。

patterns.name: 研究设计描述 purposive
patterns.context: 说明研究对象是有意选择的，目的是在年龄、地区、族裔和教育程度上保持多样性。
patterns.domain: 社会科学或公共卫生研究方法

patterns.name: 治疗后的时间与总量指标
patterns.context: 描述 TRT 一年后总睾酮和游离睾酮水平上升，并邻接表格引用。

patterns.name: 研究流程与提交期限
patterns.context: 列举协调中心向研究者提供的信息，其中包括提交期限。
patterns.domain: 临床研究管理与研究协调

patterns.name: 植物脂质代谢术语
patterns.context: 讨论拟南芥酰基脂质代谢突变体的年度研究发表数量。

en.concept: Structure and citation markers in scientific text
en.description: Primarily responds to links and citation metadata markers for tables and figures in papers, as well as heading dividers and GitHub document link formatting; also includes scattered medical and botanical terms, with no consistent semantic theme.

patterns.name: Table cross-reference markers
patterns.context: A table number is followed by a Markdown/HTML-style link anchor and citation metadata; common in paper text or table references.

patterns.name: Figure cross-reference markers
patterns.context: A figure number appears next to a link anchor and citation metadata as a figure reference in a paper.

patterns.name: Link anchors and code formatting in documents
patterns.context: Project documentation contains Markdown links and bold benchmark names; this differs from scientific paper citation formatting.

patterns.name: Markdown heading dividers
patterns.context: Continuous equals signs or hyphens indicate heading levels; nearby body text also includes “for” and “lung”.

patterns.name: Scattered terms in medical statistics or clinical descriptions
patterns.context: These words are scattered across descriptions of research subjects, hormone results, and study coordination, with no shared local semantic condition; some occur in the same paragraph as table references.

patterns.name: Plant lipid research terms
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of Arabidopsis lipid metabolism mutant research, near figure reference markers.

patterns.name: Lung cancer research terminology
patterns.context: Appears in a sentence comparing lung cancer and normal-sample datasets, near a heading divider and table reference.

patterns.name: Stroke study group terminology
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of stroke patient inclusion criteria and intervention/control group assignment, near figure references.

patterns.name: Imaging and anatomical terminology
patterns.context: Describes diaphragm position and situs inversus; “sit” occurs within the word situs, near a figure reference.
patterns.domain: Medical case reports or imaging papers

0_2796.concept: 科学文本的结构与引用标记
0_2796.description: 主要响应论文中表格/图形引用的链接与引用元数据标记，也响应标题分隔线和GitHub文档链接格式；另有多组分散的医学、植物学词项，未形成一致语义主题。

patterns.name: 表格交叉引用标记
patterns.context: 表格编号后接 Markdown/HTML 风格的链接锚点及引用元数据；常出现在论文正文或表格引用处。

patterns.name: 图形交叉引用标记
patterns.context: 图号与链接锚点、引用元数据相邻，作为论文中的图形引用。

patterns.name: 文档中的链接锚点与代码格式
patterns.context: 项目说明文档中出现 Markdown 链接和加粗的 benchmark 名称；与科学论文引文格式不同。

patterns.name: Markdown 标题分隔线
patterns.context: 标题下方用连续等号或连字符表示层级；附近还出现“for”和“lung”等正文词。
patterns.domain: 科学论文的 Markdown/转换文本

patterns.name: 医学统计或临床表述中的零散词项
patterns.context: 这些词分散在研究对象描述、激素结果及研究协调说明中，未见共同的局部语义条件；部分与表格引用同段出现。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 医学研究论文

patterns.name: 植物脂质研究词项
patterns.context: 出现在拟南芥脂质代谢突变体研究的描述中，邻近图形引用标记。

patterns.name: 肺癌研究用词
patterns.context: 出现在比较肺癌与正常样本数据集的句子中，邻近标题分隔线和表格引用。
patterns.domain: 生物医学数据分析论文

patterns.name: 卒中研究分组用词
patterns.context: 出现在卒中患者纳入标准及干预组/对照组划分的描述中，邻近图形引用。

patterns.name: 影像学与解剖术语
patterns.context: 描述膈肌位置及内脏反位；“sit”嵌在 situs 一词中，附近有图形引用。
patterns.domain: 医学病例或影像学论文

en.concept: Headings and cross-reference markers in structured documents
en.description: Primarily responds to table and figure cross-references and their link metadata in academic text, especially Table/Fig markers; it also responds to GitHub benchmark headings and Markdown separators beneath results subheadings.

patterns.name: Table citation markers
patterns.context: Table cross-references in paper body text following data, results, or explanations, especially near link markers

patterns.name: Figure citation markers
patterns.context: Markers near figure or figure-caption links cited in paper body text

patterns.name: Benchmark heading
patterns.context: A benchmark section heading and nearby benchmark description in project documentation

patterns.name: Results section heading separators
patterns.context: A separator line below a Markdown-style results heading or subheading
patterns.domain: Markdown or structured text in academic papers

0_2796.concept: 结构化文档中的标题与交叉引用标记
0_2796.description: 主要响应学术文本中的表格、图形交叉引用及其链接元数据，尤其是Table/Fig标记；另响应GitHub基准测试标题，以及结果小标题的Markdown分隔线。

patterns.name: 表格引用标记

patterns.context: 法律文本中判断某行为、法规、证据或程序是否侵犯权利、违反法律或构成违规；常见于 “would violate”“does not violate” 等句式
patterns.domain: 判例、刑法、民权与法律论证；段4–10

patterns.name: 物理学中的守恒律违反
