patterns.name: 物理学中的对称性违反
patterns.context: “violate”以对称性为宾语，说明相互作用拉格朗日量中的项不保持同位旋对称性

patterns.name: 量子不等式违反
patterns.context: 讨论量子态、部分转置与局域现实描述时，判断某状态是否违反不等式；此处出现在否定结构 “do not violate” 中

en.description: Strongly responds to the word “violate”: in legal contexts it refers to violating rights, laws, or procedural protections; in physics, to violating conservation laws, symmetries, or inequalities. Both affirmative and negative uses occur.

patterns.name: “violate” in legal contexts
patterns.context: “violate” is followed by a right, law, regulation, principle, or legal provision; common constructions include “violate X” and “would/not violate X”.
patterns.domain: Legal rulings, litigation materials, and parliamentary legal debates

patterns.name: “violate” in physics
patterns.context: Describes a physical theory or mathematical condition that fails to satisfy a conservation law, inequality, or symmetry; sometimes negated, as in “do not violate the inequality”.
patterns.domain: Theoretical physics and quantum information papers

0_2977.description: 对 violate 一词强烈响应：法律语境中指违反权利、法律或程序保障；物理语境中指违反守恒律、对称性或不等式，肯定与否定用法均出现。

patterns.name: 法律语境中的 violate
patterns.context: violate 后接权利、法律、法规、原则或法律规定；常见结构包括 “violate X” 与 “would/not violate X”。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、诉讼材料及法律议会辩论

patterns.name: 物理学中的 violate
patterns.context: 描述物理理论或数学条件不满足守恒律、不等式或对称性；有时带否定，如 “do not violate the inequality”。
patterns.domain: 理论物理与量子信息论文

en.description: The core trigger is “violate,” covering breaches of legal provisions, procedures, or rights, as well as violations of physical constraints, symmetries, and freedoms. Most examples are negated legal judgments, but affirmative legal, physical, and political contexts also occur.

patterns.name: Legal violation/non-violation
patterns.context: In legal judgments, common forms include the negated “did not violate,” “would violate,” or “in violation of”; objects include rights, laws, statutory provisions, and procedural protections.
patterns.domain: Case law, litigation materials, and legal argumentation

patterns.name: Violation of physical or mathematical constraints
patterns.context: Describes a definition, state, or theoretical result that fails to satisfy constraints such as conservation laws or inequalities, often with “not”.
patterns.domain: Physics, quantum information, or mathematical physics papers

patterns.name: Violation of symmetry
patterns.context: The subject is a physical object such as an interaction Lagrangian term, and the object is “the isospin symmetry”.

patterns.name: Infringing freedom or human rights
patterns.context: The subject is a regulation or policy measure, and the object is freedom or a right; here it criticizes the consequences of a proposed policy.
patterns.domain: European Parliament politics / human rights argumentation

0_2977.description: 核心触发词是 violate，涵盖违反法律条文、程序或权利，也用于违反物理约束、对称性及自由；多数例子是否定法律判断，但也有肯定的法律、物理和政治语境。

patterns.name: 法律上的违反／不违反
patterns.context: 在法律判断句中，常见否定结构“did not violate”“would violate”，或“in violation of”；宾语是权利、法律、法条、程序保障等。
patterns.domain: 判例、诉讼材料及法律论述

patterns.name: 物理或数学约束被违反
patterns.context: 描述某种定义、状态或理论结果不满足守恒律、不等式等约束，常与 not 连用。
patterns.domain: 物理、量子信息或数学物理论文

patterns.name: 违反对称性
patterns.context: 主语是相互作用拉格朗日项等物理对象，宾语为“the isospin symmetry”。

patterns.name: 侵犯自由或人权
patterns.context: 主语是法规或政策措施，宾语为自由、权利；此处是对拟议政策后果的批评。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会政治／人权论述

en.description: All excerpts activate on “violate,” whether followed by a conservation law, symmetry, inequality, freedom, statutory provision, or procedural right. It commonly appears in judgments about whether something breaches a norm; negated forms and “in violation of” also trigger activation.

patterns.name: Violating/infringing legal norms
patterns.context: The core trigger is “violate”; it is often preceded by the negation “not,” but negation does not prevent activation. Its object can be a right, statutory provision, regulation, principle, or physical conservation law.
patterns.domain: Legal rulings, regulatory argumentation, and academic papers

patterns.name: Syntactic and argumentative contexts of “violate”
patterns.context: Activation centers on “violate” itself; the context is often a statement or dispute about whether an action, rule, or theory violates a norm. Paragraph 5 also contains the nominal phrase “in violation of,” indicating a response to another form of the same word root.
patterns.domain: Primarily legal argumentation, also physics and quantum information papers

0_2977.description: 所有片段都在“violate”处激活，包括其后接守恒律、对称性、不等式、自由、法条或程序性权利；常见于判断某事是否违反规范的语境，否定式及“in violation of”也触发。

patterns.name: 违反/侵害法律规范
patterns.trigger: “violate”及其后接宾语，如“violate current conservation”“violate the isospin symmetry”“violate freedom”“violate section 137”“violate the defendant's due process rights”“violate former section 1366”“violate ... right of confrontation”“violate ERISA”“violate ... right to a public trial”
patterns.context: 核心触发词是“violate”；前面常有否定词“not”，但否定不阻止激活。其宾语可以是权利、法律条文、法规、原则或物理守恒律。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、法规论述及学术论文

patterns.name: violate 的句法与论证环境
patterns.trigger: “would ... violate”“does not violate”“held that ... did not violate”“in violation of”；常与“not”“would”“did”“the defendant's”共现
patterns.context: 触发点集中在“violate”本身；上下文常为判断某行为、规则或理论是否违反某项规范的陈述或争议。第5段另出现名词性短语“in violation of”，显示对同一词根形式也有响应。
patterns.domain: 法律论证为主，兼及物理学与量子信息论文

en.description: Activation primarily falls on the Fle string in mixed-case text: it occurs mostly in various surnames, as well as in the pattern name Fleur de lys and the software name Fleck. The commonality is more a character substring than a unified meaning.

patterns.name: Fle- string in personal names
patterns.context: Occurs within personal names, usually as part of a surname; activation centers on the Fle-initial substring, with varying subsequent spelling.
patterns.domain: Paper authors, legal document signatures, literary acknowledgments, encyclopedia entries about people

patterns.name: Fleur- in a pattern name
patterns.context: Occurs in the name of a glass pattern or decorative design, rather than in a personal name; associated with spellings such as fleur-de-lys.

patterns.name: Software name Fleck
patterns.context: Appears as the name of software or a tool, compared with a Scheme shell.

0_2977.description: 激活主要落在大小写混合文本中的 Fle 字符串：多见于各类人名姓氏，也见于花纹名 Fleur de lys 和软件名 Fleck；共同点偏向字形片段而非统一语义。

patterns.name: 人名中的 Fle- 字符串
patterns.context: 出现在个人姓名内部，通常是姓氏的一部分；激活集中在姓氏的 Fle 开头片段，后续拼写各异。
patterns.domain: 论文作者、法律文件署名、文学致谢、百科人物条目

patterns.name: 花纹名称中的 Fleur-
patterns.context: 出现在玻璃花纹或装饰图案名称中，而非人名；与 fleur-de-lys 等拼写相关。

patterns.name: 软件名称 Fleck
patterns.context: 作为软件或工具名称出现，并与 Scheme shell 作比较。

en.description: Activation centers on the consecutive letters “él”: it includes él- within Hungarian and French words, as well as the independent accented Spanish pronoun él; it also appears in the French medical measurement phrase éléments/mm^3. The commonality is primarily orthographic, while grammatical function and meaning vary.

patterns.name: él within Hungarian words
patterns.context: Activation falls on the word-initial string él-, which continues into a complete Hungarian word; it does not represent a unified meaning of an independent word.

patterns.name: él within French words
patterns.context: Activation falls on the string él within French words; subsequent letters form words such as élus, élaborées, and éléments.

patterns.name: Spanish pronoun él
patterns.context: The independent stressed masculine third-person singular pronoun él, referring to a person or object mentioned earlier and written with an accent.

patterns.name: French medical measurement term él
patterns.context: A measurement phrase in a French medical test result, referring to the number of cells per cubic millimeter; the marked portion is the beginning of éléments.
patterns.domain: French case reports in PubMed Central

0_2977.description: 激活集中在连续字母串“él”：既包括匈牙利语、法语词内的 él-，也包括西班牙语带重音的独立代词 él；另见法语医学计量短语 éléments/mm^3。共同点主要是拼写形态，语法功能与语义并不一致。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词内 él
patterns.context: 激活落在词首的 él- 字符串上，后面继续组成完整匈牙利语词；不是独立词的统一语义。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 匈牙利语议会发言

patterns.name: 法语词内 él
patterns.context: 激活落在法语词中的 él 字符串；后续字母使其分别成为 élus、élaborées、éléments 等词。

patterns.name: 西班牙语代词 él
patterns.context: 独立的重读阳性第三人称单数代词 él，指代前文提及的人或对象，带书写重音。
patterns.domain: PhilPapers 西班牙语学术文本

patterns.name: 法语医学计量词 él
patterns.context: 法语医学检验结果中的计量单位短语，指每立方毫米的细胞数；所标部分是 éléments 的开头。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 法语病例报告

en.concept: In-word fragments containing indeterm- and reign
en.description: The most consistent trigger is the indeterm- word family (indeterminate, indeterminacy, etc.), appearing across domains, word forms, and syntax. There is also high activation for the sovereign word family, as well as sporadic Ind, st, and times fragments, which are difficult to group into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: indeterminate / indeterminacy word family
patterns.context: The indeterm- stem appears in different word forms, with copulas, nouns, or modifiers nearby; no particular syntax or meaning is required.
patterns.domain: Law, mathematics, philosophy, political commentary, and general discourse

patterns.name: sovereign word family
patterns.context: Embedded in sovereign / sovereignty forms; refers to a bank name, a legal concept, or a political claim, with no fixed meaning or domain.

patterns.name: Other weakly associated collocations
patterns.context: Sporadic in-word fragments: Ind in Indus., st in ordinal abbreviations, and the mathematical notation p«times»6; no consistent shared context is evident.

0_2977.concept: 含 indeterm- 与 reign 的词内片段
0_2977.description: 最稳定的触发是 indeterm- 词族（indeterminate、indeterminacy 等），跨领域、词形与句法均多样；另有 sovereign 词族的高激活，以及零散的 Ind、st、times 片段，难归为统一语义模式。

patterns.name: indeterminate / indeterminacy 词族
patterns.context: 词干 indeterm- 出现在不同形态的词中，周围可有系词、名词或修饰语；不要求特定句法或含义。
patterns.domain: 法律、数学、哲学、政治评论及一般论述

patterns.name: sovereign 词族
patterns.context: 嵌在 sovereign / sovereignty 词形内部；指银行名称、法律概念或政治主张，语义和领域并不固定。
patterns.domain: 法律、银行叙述、政治评论

patterns.name: 其他弱关联搭配
patterns.context: 零散的词内片段：Indus. 中的 Ind、序数缩写中的 st，以及数学记号 p«times»6；未见稳定的共同上下文。

en.concept: Substring from the determination word family
en.description: Every excerpt activates within the determination, indeterminate, or indeterministic word family; the family spans legal, computer science, philosophical, physics, and code contexts. The trigger centers on the shared substring “eterm,” with prefixes and suffixes determining the specific meaning.

patterns.name: Determination word family
patterns.context: Activation falls within words such as determination / indeterminate / indeterministic; prefixes and suffixes vary, and the family includes both ordinary and technical terms.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: computer science, law, philosophy, physics, software code, and general discussion

patterns.name: Indeterminacy and variants
patterns.context: The word family appears in contexts describing indeterminacy, an undetermined state, or variables; examples involve graph algorithms, transaction ordering, quantum processes, philosophical concepts, and XML attributes.
patterns.domain: Computer science, physics, philosophy, and software configuration

patterns.name: Redetermination in law
patterns.context: Occurs in “petition for redetermination,” describing a petition for redetermination filed with a tax court.

patterns.name: Determinism and predetermination of life
patterns.context: In discussions of the effects of heredity, environment, and circumstances on life and behavior, indicates that life is predetermined or constrained.
patterns.domain: General Hacker News discussions, often philosophical

0_2977.description: 所有段都在 determination、indeterminate 或 indeterministic 词族内部激活；词族跨法律、计算机、哲学、物理和代码语境。触发点集中在共享的“eterm”片段，前后缀决定具体含义。

patterns.name: determination 词族
patterns.context: 激活落在 determination / indeterminate / indeterministic 等词的内部片段；词前缀和后缀不同，既包括普通词，也包括技术词。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：计算机科学、法律、哲学、物理、软件代码及一般讨论

patterns.name: 非确定性及其变体
patterns.context: 词族出现在描述非确定性、未定状态或变量的上下文中；涉及图算法、事务排序、量子过程、哲学概念和 XML 属性。
patterns.domain: 计算机科学、物理、哲学与软件配置

patterns.name: 法律中的重新裁定
patterns.context: 出现在 petition for redetermination 中，描述向税务法院提交的重新裁定申请。

patterns.name: 决定论与人生预定
patterns.context: 在谈论遗传、环境、处境对人生及行为的影响时，表示人生受到预先决定或制约。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 一般讨论、偏哲学议论

en.description: Primarily activates on the in-word substring eterm, commonly found in nondeterministic, redetermination, predetermination, and indeterminacy/indeterminate; spans technical, legal, philosophical, and code contexts. This substring does not appear in segment 10, so it cannot be interpreted.

patterns.name: Character string containing determ
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the substring eterm across word boundaries; full word forms and meanings differ, and the substring may occur within a word or after its initial characters.
patterns.domain: Across academic papers, legal documents, forum discussions, and code

patterns.name: The term nondeterministic
patterns.context: Discusses randomness, nondeterminism, or allowing nondeterministic reordering; the word form has segmented annotations.
patterns.domain: Computer science, software development, quantum physics

patterns.name: Legal use of determination
patterns.context: Appears in the legal context of filing a petition for redetermination with the United States Tax Court.

patterns.name: predetermination
patterns.context: Discusses life being predetermined by heredity, environment, and circumstances.

patterns.name: indeterminacy / indeterminate
patterns.context: Refers respectively to uncertainty in philosophy, ambiguous identity or ontological indeterminacy, and the value false in an Android layout attribute.

patterns.name: eterm in isolated substrings or truncated text
patterns.context: Appears in isolation in code/forum snippets, without enough context to determine the full word form; it may result from truncation of adjacent text.

0_2977.description: 主要激活词内子串 eterm，常见于 nondeterministic、redetermination、predetermination、indeterminacy/indeterminate；横跨技术、法律、哲学及代码语境。第10段未见该子串，无法解释。

patterns.name: 含 determ 字母串
patterns.context: 激活集中在跨词边界的子串 eterm；完整词形及其含义不同，子串可位于词中间或词首后的部分。
patterns.domain: 跨学术论文、法律文书、论坛讨论与代码

patterns.name: 术语 nondeterministic
patterns.context: 讨论随机性、非确定性或允许非确定性重排；词形有分段标注。
patterns.domain: 计算机科学、软件开发、量子物理

patterns.name: determination 法律用语
patterns.context: 出现在向美国税务法院提交 petition for redetermination 的法律语境。

patterns.name: predetermination
patterns.context: 谈论人生受到遗传、环境和处境影响而具有预先决定性。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、哲学性社会议题

patterns.name: indeterminacy／indeterminate
patterns.context: 分别指哲学中的不确定性、模糊身份或本体不确定性，以及 Android 布局属性值 false。

patterns.name: 纯子串或截断文本中的 eterm
patterns.context: 孤立出现于代码/论坛片段，缺少足够上下文判断其完整词形；可能与相邻文字截断有关。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to strings spelled with eterm, especially in indeterminate, nondeterministic, predetermination, redetermination, and indeterminacy; these occur across several fields. Paragraph 10 also activates on the surname Judge, which is difficult to explain within the main pattern.

patterns.name: Stems and word forms containing determ
patterns.context: The trigger is the consecutive letter string eterm in English spelling; word forms, meanings, and syntactic contexts vary, and it can occur within a word or be split by line breaks or formatting.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: computer science, philosophy, law, everyday discussion, XML

patterns.name: Word-internal segmentation variants of eterm
patterns.context: In the legal document word redetermination, eterm is the high-activation segment; red and eterm are marked separately.

patterns.name: Surname Judge
patterns.context: Activates separately within the name Peter and Judge, with no apparent semantic connection to the surrounding solar chromosphere research.

0_2977.description: 主要对拼写含 eterm 的字符串强烈响应，尤见于 indeterminate、nondeterministic、predetermination、redetermination、indeterminacy 等词；跨多个领域出现。第10段另有 Judge 姓氏激活，难与主模式解释。

patterns.name: 含 determ 的词干与词形
patterns.context: 触发点是英语拼写中连续字母串 eterm；前后词形、词义和句法环境不同，既可出现在词内，也可能被换行或格式切分。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：计算机科学、哲学、法律、日常讨论、XML

patterns.name: eterm 的词内切分变体
patterns.context: 在法律文书中的 redetermination 一词里，eterm 是高激活部分；red 与 eterm 分开标记。

patterns.name: Judge 姓氏
patterns.context: 在人名 Peter and Judge 中单独激活，与周围的太阳色球层研究内容无明显语义联系。

en.concept: The title and form of address President
en.description: Strong activation primarily occurs on President and related title forms: these include national leaders and corporate officers in news, as well as the formal address for the presiding officer in parliamentary settings; related forms also include Presidential, Vice-President, and Presidenta.

patterns.name: Title for a head of state or government
patterns.context: In news or political reporting, President is a title noun preceded by a country, name, or other modifier; it also appears with Vice and in the related form “Presidential candidates”.

patterns.name: Corporate executive title
patterns.context: In company announcements, President is paired with CEO as part of an executive title.

patterns.name: Addressing the parliamentary presiding officer
patterns.context: In parliamentary speeches or debates, speakers address the presiding officer as President (including the Spanish feminine form Presidenta); it also appears in the title Vice-President.
patterns.domain: European Parliament records, formal speeches in multiple languages

0_2977.description: 主要对 President 及相关职衔词形强烈激活：既包括新闻中的国家领导人、公司职务，也包括议会对会议主席的正式称呼；还涉及 Presidential、Vice-President 和 Presidenta。

patterns.name: 国家元首或政府首脑称谓
patterns.context: 新闻或政治报道中，President 作职务名词，前接国家、姓名或其他限定语；也见与 Vice 连用，以及“Presidential candidates”这一相关词形。

patterns.name: 公司高管职称
patterns.context: 公司公告中，President 与 CEO 并列，作为高管职务的一部分。

patterns.name: 议会发言称呼主席
patterns.context: 议会发言或辩论中，发言者以 President（含西班牙语阴性形式 Presidenta）称呼主持会议的主席；也出现在 Vice-President 职衔中。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会记录，多语种正式发言

en.concept: Use of the string Lt and its abbreviations
en.description: Primarily responds to the string “Lt,” most often in military rank abbreviations followed by a name or rank; also appears in the financial rating “Lt Buy.” In one instance, it activates “reasons” in a materials paper, which is difficult to explain together with the other cases.

patterns.name: Military rank abbreviation Lt.
patterns.context: Appears after a name or rank, usually followed by an officer’s name, another rank abbreviation, or a position; common forms include “Lt. Edward,” “Lt. Gen.,” and “Lt. Karl.”
patterns.domain: Legal records, military history, ship/naval materials, film and television credits

patterns.name: Stock rating abbreviation Lt
patterns.context: Appears in the financial rating change phrase “Downgraded to Lt Buy from Buy,” where Lt modifies Buy and may abbreviate a rating label; distinct from the military rank usage.

patterns.name: Localized sporadic activation
patterns.context: In an academic sentence about boride materials and synthesis mechanisms, activation falls on a phrase explaining the reason; this is inconsistent with the Lt string patterns in other passages.

0_2977.description: 主要响应字符串“Lt”，多见于军衔缩写，后接姓名或军衔；也见于金融评级“Lt Buy”。另有一次在材料论文中激活“reasons”，难与前者统一解释。

patterns.name: 军衔缩写 Lt.

en.description: All passages strongly activate on the paper section heading “INTRODUCTION” and its underscore-style divider. patterns.context: 该词出现在法律文书、社交媒体帖子或图片/网页描述中；通常指案件标题、帖子说明或图注。
patterns.domain: 法律、社交媒体、网页与图像标记

patterns.name: 法院意见文体标记
patterns.context: 法院意见的标题或开头，常与上诉、巡回法院法官等格式化信息相邻。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦法院法律文书

patterns.name: machine translation 相关词
patterns.context: 讨论注意力机制缺陷及其在机器翻译中的表现。

patterns.name: image captioning 相关词
patterns.context: 论文语境中提及图像描述任务；激活落在 captioning 的词干部分。

patterns.name: 法律中的裁判与诉讼词
patterns.context: 法律论述中涉及判例、法院或亲子关系裁定，但这些词并非各段共有。

en.description: The most stable trigger is caption: it is used for image descriptions, post descriptions, gallery captions, and legal-document case captions. Two other passages are scientific texts where activation falls on several unrelated subword fragments, with no clear shared meaning.

patterns.name: Image caption
patterns.context: Refers to explanatory text for an image, social media post, or gallery; sometimes serves as the case-caption field in a legal document.
patterns.domain: Computer vision, social media, web development

patterns.name: Legal meanings near caption
patterns.context: In legal opinions or complaints, caption refers to the case or document heading; legal terms may co-occur with activation but are not present in every passage.

patterns.name: English word-final fragment tion
patterns.context: Scientific papers contain mathematical physics or particle physics terms; this may reflect a word-form fragment rather than a unified meaning.

0_2977.description: 最稳定的触发是 caption：用于图像说明、帖子说明、画廊图注，也用于法律文书的案件标题。另有两段科学文本，激活落在若干不相干的词片段上，未见清晰共同语义。

patterns.name: 图像说明文字 caption
patterns.context: 指图片、社交媒体帖子或画廊中的说明文字；有时作为法律文书中的案件标题字段。
patterns.domain: 计算机视觉、社交媒体、网页开发

patterns.name: caption 周边的法律含义
patterns.context: 法律判决或诉状中，caption 指案件标题或文书标题；法律术语也可能与激活同现，但并非每段都出现。

patterns.name: 英语词尾片段 tion
patterns.context: 科学论文中出现数学物理或粒子物理术语；可能反映词形片段，而非统一语义。

en.description: All fragments activate strongly on the LaTeX square-root command «sqrt» in diverse formula contexts, including gravitational action, collision energy, quantum optics, Hamiltonians, mathematical sets, and plasma frequency. A few fragments also activate on the aligned environment.

patterns.name: Square-root symbol
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical formulas, especially in denominators, actions, energy scales, or frequency expressions; surrounding fields vary.
patterns.domain: Formulas in physics and mathematics papers

patterns.name: LaTeX alignment environment
patterns.context: Formulas are typeset in an aligned environment, often with line breaks and equation numbers; this trigger is not present in every passage containing sqrt.

patterns.name: Geometric or field-theory quantities in formulas
patterns.context: The expression under the square root is the negative determinant of the metric, appearing in actions or gravitational constraint expressions.
patterns.domain: Gravity, scalar fields, and field theory

patterns.name: High-energy physics energy scales
patterns.context: The square root applies to the Mandelstam variable s and is associated with GeV or collision-reaction contexts.

patterns.name: Square-root factor of 2
patterns.context: The formula contains √2, associated respectively with signal-to-noise ratio or effective Hamiltonian normalization; the specific uses differ.

patterns.name: Square roots in other formulas
patterns.context: The square root contains model parameters or integrals, rather than appearing in metric or energy-scale expressions.

patterns.name: Plasma frequency relation
patterns.context: Associated with discussion of bulk plasma frequency, susceptibility, and poles.

0_2977.description: 所有片段都强烈激活于 LaTeX 平方根命令 «sqrt»；涉及引力作用量、碰撞能量、量子光学、哈密顿量、数学界及等离子体频率等不同公式语境。少数片段也激活 aligned 环境。

patterns.name: 平方根符号
patterns.context: 出现在数学公式中，尤其是分母、作用量、能量尺度或频率表达式里；周围领域并不相同。
patterns.domain: 物理与数学论文中的公式

patterns.name: LaTeX 对齐环境
patterns.context: 公式以 aligned 环境排版，常伴随换行和公式标号；不是所有含 sqrt 的段落都有此触发。

patterns.name: 公式中的几何量或场论量
patterns.context: 平方根下为度规行列式的负值，出现在作用量或引力约束表达式中。

patterns.name: 高能物理能量尺度
patterns.context: 平方根作用于 Mandelstam 变量 s，并与 GeV 或碰撞反应语境相连。

patterns.name: 平方根因子 2
patterns.context: 公式中出现 √2，分别关联信噪比或有效哈密顿量归一化，具体用途不同。

patterns.name: 其他公式中的平方根
patterns.context: 平方根包含模型参数或积分量，不属于度规或能量尺度表达式。
patterns.domain: 物理公式及数学不等式

patterns.name: 等离子体频率关系
patterns.context: 与 bulk plasma frequency、极化率及 pole 的讨论相连。

en.description: All passages activate on the substring sqrt: mathematical expressions and simplification problems, code functions and calls, statistics and signal processing examples, and LaTeX sqrt in physics formulas. There is also activation on Simplify in math problems and one instance in the ending of dilaton.

patterns.name: sqrt function name
patterns.context: A square root function/command in mathematical expressions, code, or formulas; may appear in a function definition, function call, or LaTeX formula.

patterns.name: Simplify instruction
patterns.context: Appears before a complex expression as an instruction to simplify it; adjacent to sqrt numerical expressions.
patterns.domain: Math problems or automatically generated mathematical text

patterns.name: atan word ending
patterns.context: Appears in the word “dilaton,” adjacent to sqrt{-g} in a LaTeX gravitational action; the activated fragment is a substring within a word, not a square root function.

0_2977.description: 各段均激活 sqrt 子串：数学算式与化简题、代码函数及调用、统计和信号处理示例、物理公式中的 LaTeX sqrt；另在数学题中激活 Simplify，在 dilaton 词尾也有一次激活。

patterns.name: sqrt 函数名
patterns.context: 作为数学表达式、代码或公式中的平方根函数/命令；可能位于函数定义、函数调用或 LaTeX 公式中。

patterns.name: Simplify 指令

patterns.name: atan 词尾

en.description: All passages contain the marked LaTeX square-root symbol \sqrt; some also contain the aligned equation environment. Other activated terms are sporadic and heterogeneous, with no stable shared meaning or contextual condition.
